Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Hiring: Field Officer / Centre Manager Microfinance
Position: Field Officer / Centre Manager
Industry: Microfinance / Financial Services
Location: Bihar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 0–3 years (Freshers can also apply for Field Officer roles)
Job Description
We are looking for Field Officers / Centre Managers to join our microfinance operations in Bihar. The candidate will be responsible for managing customers/groups, conducting field visits, ensuring timely loan repayments, and supporting business growth while maintaining high service and compliance standards.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct regular field visits and customer meetings.
Identify and onboard new customers and form JLG/SHG groups.
Explain loan products, repayment schedules and company policies to customers.
Conduct customer verification and ensure proper KYC/documentation.
Manage centre meetings and maintain customer relationships.
Ensure timely collection of loan instalments.
Follow up on overdue accounts and maintain portfolio quality.
Monitor customer repayment behaviour and identify potential risks.
Resolve customer queries and complaints professionally.
Maintain accurate records and submit daily/weekly reports.
Achieve assigned business and collection targets.
Follow company policies, ethical collection practices and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Candidate Profile
Minimum 12th pass / Graduate preferred.
Experience in microfinance, banking, NBFC, sales or field collection will be an advantage.
Freshers with good communication skills may apply for Field Officer positions.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Basic knowledge of smartphones and mobile applications.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.
Knowledge of Hindi and local language/dialect preferred.
Candidates should be target-oriented, responsible and comfortable working in rural/semi-urban areas.

SUMMARY
Job Description
Title : Field Sales Executive
Location : Patna ( Bhagalpur)

Job Type : Contract (For more than 1 year)
Industry : Paint - Chemical
Summary :
This field sales role is pivotal in driving business growth by building strong relationships with key stakeholders such as painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets through proactive customer engagement, daily site visits, and active presence at assigned retail locations. By organizing regular shop meetings, maintaining accurate sales records, and leveraging a strong understanding of the market, the sales representative will play a critical role in expanding market reach and enhancing brand visibility. The position requires a self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
Responsibilities :
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
Develop and nurture long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key customers.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
Spend at least two hours daily at the assigned store to engage customers and support sales activities.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to drive product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports via the online portal.
Requirements :
Valid two-wheeler is mandatory for field operations.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and driven by performance targets.
Minimum qualification: Graduation preferred.
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with sales aptitude are also encouraged to apply.
Benefits :
Net Take Home: 16K-18K (Negotiable)
MWA 5000/ -
Lucrative Performance driven Incentives.
Absorption after 1 year on performance basis.
Travel allowance up to 2000- 5000 per month based on profile.
Other pointers regarding this job:
Location:Patna. ( Work from Office only).
Age Criteria: 18years old to 30years old are eligible
Gender : Only Male can apply
Eligibility: Minimum 6months to 1 years experience in field sales, channel sales, banking, or insurance sales can apply.
Location: Only candidates based in Patna are eligible.
Qualification: Graduate (Preferred).
Work Details: Day shift role with third-party payroll (2coms).
Language Skills: Must know the local language of Patna.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channeling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.

Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry.
Experience in Sales & Marketing

Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.

6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants, building materials).

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sit at the PMJAY help desk and welcome patients and attendants, explaining the scheme, its benefits, and the cashless treatment process in simple Hindi and the local language.
2. Verify beneficiary eligibility through the Beneficiary Identification System (BIS) using Aadhaar, ration card, PMJAY e-card, or other approved documents.
3. Help eligible patients obtain or generate their Ayushman card through the approved process, or guide them to the nearest enrolment centre.
4. Register patients on the Transaction Management System (TMS) and carry out pre-authorization requests for packages that need it.
5. Coordinate with treating doctors and clinical staff to select the correct package and collect required documents, investigation reports, and clinical notes.
6. Upload treatment records, photographs, and discharge summaries, and follow up on claim submission, queries, and approvals within the stipulated timelines.
7. Make sure eligible patients receive cashless treatment, and report any case of illegal charging or denial of service to the hospital management.
8. Counsel patients and families on treatment coverage, the documents they need, expected stay, and what to do at discharge.
9. Support the hospital's PMJAY nodal officer and billing team in tracking claim status, rejections, and recovery of pending claims.
10. Keep daily records of patients counselled, registered, and discharged under the scheme, and submit MIS reports as required.
11. Take part in health awareness and enrolment drives, and refer patients to other government schemes where relevant.
12. Handle patient grievances politely and escalate them to the hospital management or the State Health Agency (SHA), Bihar helpline when needed.
13. Protect patient confidentiality and follow all National Health Authority (NHA) guidelines, SOPs, and data security rules.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in Social Work, Public Health, Hospital Administration, Nursing, or Health Sciences is preferred.
Experience of at least 2-5 years in a hospital help desk, insurance desk, TPA, or health scheme setting (freshers with training may be considered).
Preferably certified or trained as a Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM) / Ayushman Mitra by the NHA or State Health Agency.

Description:
Location: Madhepura
Company: Alstom
Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Material Planner in Madhepura were looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your material planning and supply chain expertise in a cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative and detail-oriented teammates.
Youll play a critical role in ensuring seamless material planning and supply chain processes, directly impacting production efficiency and supplier delivery performance. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business, including Manufacturing and Testing, Industrial Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, and Logistics, as well as collaborate with external vendors and business partners. Youll also proactively resolve supply issues, update material planning documents, and drive continuous improvement initiatives in supplier delivery performance.
Youll specifically take care of creating and updating Material Planning documents, such as Call-offs and Schedule Agreements, but also ensure the accuracy of material planning master data and resolve goods receipt issues.
Well look to you for:
Managing purchase requisitions until Material Planning document creation for internal suppliers
Following up with Procurement on purchase requisition maturity for external suppliers
Ensuring and updating the accuracy of material planning master data in compliance with stock and logistic constraints
Communicating delivery plans and purchase orders to suppliers and following up on their confirmations
Analyzing supplier confirmations versus Alstom needs and evaluating risks/impacts on production/projects
Identifying priorities, setting up recovery actions, and organizing regular reviews with suppliers to monitor delivery performance
Resolving supply chain issues, including managing MRP exception messages and goods receipt issues
Driving supplier OTIF (On-Time In-Full) improvement initiatives
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
B. Tech in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering
6+ years of experience in scheduling and inventory management within a manufacturing environment
Proficiency in SAP (PP/MM) modules
Knowledge of industrial planning, logistics, inventory management, material planning, and supplier relationship management
Familiarity with tools such as ASCOT, ARIBA, CELONIS, and QlikSense
Strong data analysis and reporting skills
Cross-functional team management and collaboration skills
Agility and adaptability in a dynamic environment
Entrepreneurial mindset and problem-solving abilities
Proficiency in English and Hindi
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!

The role is mainly in the field: visiting our corporate and government tie-up clients, keeping their beneficiaries informed, and resolving issues at the hospital end throughout all the Districts of Bihar.

Job Description -
1 Talent Acquisition and Onboarding
Manage hiring for all on-roll and contractual roles as per the approved manpower plan.
Coordinate with contractors for daily/weekly manpower availability and ensure the same.
Drive joining formalities, documentation, ID creation, induction and plant orientation.
2. Employee Life Cycle Management (End-to-End)
Maintain employee records, personal files, contract staff muster, shift rosters.
Ensure timely confirmation, transfers, promotions, increments, and separations.
Drive exit formalities, full & final settlement coordination, and attrition control.
3. HR Operations & Payroll Coordination
Ensure accurate inputs for attendance, incentives, weekly off etc.
Verify contractor bills and ensure compliance with MW and Payment of wages & PF/ESIC etc.
Coordinate with the payroll team for timely disbursal and issue resolutions if any.
4. Contract Labour Management
Oversee onboarding, attendance, wage compliance and statutory records for all off-roll employees.
Conduct monthly contractor audits: PF/ESIC challans, wage slips, muster, bonus, leave etc
Ensure CLRA license, RC, and documentation are valid.
5. Statutory Compliance & Audits
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, CLRA, Minimum Wages Act, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, and other state-specific regulations.
Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for inspections.
Support external audits: FSSAI etc
6. Industrial Relations & Discipline
Handle shop floor discipline issues, grievances, counselling, and issue of notices/charge sheets where needed.
Support healthy employee relations in close coordination with the Factory Manager and Area HR Head.
Maintain harmonious relations between staff, operators, contract workforce, and contractors.
7. Training & Capability Building
Identify unit-level training needs (food safety, GMP, safety, HR policy awareness).
Conduct daily/weekly briefing talks or coordinate functional training.
Maintain training records and skill-matrix for operators.
8. Employee Engagement & Welfare
Drive engagement calendar: festivals, R&R, skip-levels, suggestion programs.
Ensure availability of welfare facilities: drinking water, rest area, washrooms, PPE, first-aid, canteen.
Monitor hygiene, safety and morale on the shopfloor.
9. HR MIS, Analytics & Reporting
Prepare and maintain monthly HR dashboards:
Attendance, attrition, overtime, contractor compliance score, open positions, training records, statutory status.
Share daily/weekly MIS with Factory Manager & Area HR Head.
10. Support to Business & Operations
Partner with production, quality and shift leads to ensure manpower efficiency.
Support productivity, food safety and operational performance through timely HR interventions.
Drive culture of discipline, safety, responsibility and performance.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.

Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Position: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12Years
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Gandhinagar
Interview Type: Face-to-Face
Date:10-OCTOBER-2026

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant with 4 to 10 years of SAP Sales and Distribution experience. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAP SD business processes, S/4HANA implementations, configuration, integrations, and support projects.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Configure SAP SD modules including:
Sales Order Processing
Pricing
Billing
Shipping & Transportation
Output Management
Credit Management
Returns & Rebate Processes
Participate in S/4HANA implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
Work on integrations with MM, FI, WM/EWM, TM, and PP modules.
Conduct fit-gap analysis and prepare functional specifications.
Support testing activities including Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Go-Live.

Collaborate with technical teams for enhancements, reports, forms, interfaces, and workflows.

6 to 10 years of SAP SD consulting experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation project.
Strong configuration knowledge in:
Enterprise Structure
Sales Document Types
Item Categories
Schedule Lines
Pricing Procedures
Output Determination
Partner Determination
Copy Controls
Batch Management
Experience with S/4HANA SD simplifications and business processes.
Knowledge of APIs, IDOCs, EDI, and interfaces.
Strong understanding of OTC (Order-to-Cash) processes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with SAP Fiori applications.
Exposure to SAP EWM, TM, GTS, or SAP CAR.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in AMS support and global rollout projects.
SAP SD or S/4HANA certification is preferred

This is with reference for AWS Data Engineer Professionals

PFB the Job Description

Key responsibilities
Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
Design and build Gluebased ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
Build automated dataquality gates, reconciliation checks, and sourcetoreport lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of businesscritical reports
Implement IAM, AWSnative encryption, Secrets Manager and Goldlayer RBAC/leastprivilege access.
Establish Dev/Test environments, Gitbased CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

Mandatory skills
10+ years in data engineering with 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and handson medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
Python (primary) PySpark for Glue jobs.
MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
dbt must be able to read, reverseengineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
Dataquality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
Git,CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

Nice to have
Dagster orchestration for ASIS discovery and migration.
Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.
Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
Tableau, Metabase servinglayer knowledge.
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
Datagovernance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).

Total Overall Experience-10-15years

Job Description
Overview
The project management opportunities we have are varied in size and responsibility levels, from delivering our consultancy services, to working for the client organisation delivering their projects and programmes.
You ll have exceptional stakeholder communication and people management skills and thrive on working within a dynamic and diverse project delivery environment.
Your Role
Working within our Nuclear business sector in our Bangalore or Gurgaon office, you will lead the delivery of AtkinsRealis technical design and engineering projects or work directly for our key clients.
You must be able to appreciate complex practical, technical, and commercial issues and to work constructively with a broad range of stakeholders; leading project teams that are either local to you or distributed across multiple sites.
The opportunities we have are varied in size and nature, and particularly suit an agile project management style, where the work is particularly discovery in nature. To help us grow the future of our business we are particularly keen to speak to individuals who are building a career as a professional project manager, who are delivery focused, and enjoy being customer focused.
Other aspects of the role will include supporting the growth of our capabilities through building a reputation for excellence, mentoring others, supporting business development and bidding activities.
About You
You ll have excellent communication, listening, stakeholder management and influencing skills. You ll be able to manage client relationships, engage constructively with multiple stakeholders and lead delivery teams. Through your work you will also help support and shape the development of future business.
You ll enjoy turning your hand to new challenges and will be keen to learn, whilst also wanting to support others within our diverse multi-disciplinary teams. You must also be able to successfully manage the commercial and quality performance of projects and proactively deploy a range of techniques to control delivery, cost, manage risk and change.
Your experience in working collaboratively with teams spread across multiple geographical locations.
Engineering professional with 20 or more years of experience
Direct and demonstrable experience of successfully managing one or more of the following types of projects to agreed time, cost and quality requirements:
Consultancy services supplying engineering advice, or
Engineering design
Must be an Engineering Professional
Experience of leading and directing teams and resources. Able to motivate self and teams, deal with conflict and create a collaborative team culture to meet client requirements
A strong element of client relationship management and people leadership. Excellent communication skills.
Willingness to travel as necessary.
Willing to work flexibly with occasional out of hours work to accommodate project and client requirements.
Nuclear industry experience. Applications from candidates from other high hazard, or highly regulated industries such as process, Oil and Gas, Defense, and Aerospace would be welcomed.
Rewards & Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsR alis
Were AtkinsR alis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the worlds infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Were committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.

Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Job Summary
Infrastructure Engineer
Job Location: India (Bangalore)
Maersk is achieving an unprecedented transformation in the growth of our business, rethinking the way we engage with customers and partners, and how the world's trade flows across our global network. From the farm to your refrigerator, or the factory to your wardrobe, we are developing solutions in-house that meet customer needs across the whole Supply Chain E2E. Joining Maersk you will join a global leader in Container Logistics as we embark on an industry-defining digital transformation that will revolutionize trade.
You'll play a vital part in our success, helping us re-think what technology can do by using the latest technologies, and building the experience to advance your career. If you are passionate about working in an entrepreneurial environment supporting an ambitious, culturally diverse team of 3000 People within Maersk Technology - on a great transformation journey - then apply today!
The role of the Infrastructure Engineer
As an Infrastructure Engineer within our Technology Services Engineering Team, you will be a key driver and doer in a fundamental shift in how we architect and host our application estate to ensure that we can take our platform operating model to the next level. You will be an advocate to enable a composable technology foundation which will enable our Product development teams in building our digital foundation of the future to help delivering for our global customer base.
Your focus will be on both assisting in the ideation and realisation of what our next generation platform will encompass, as well as then helping our Product teams in implementing products that are aligned to this long-term Platform vision.
To realise Maersk's "One Customer Journey", a consistent and resilient platform is essential. You will be key in helping promote 'the right way' in how we utilise technology in delivering on this promise.
To help to make our next generation platform successful, we are looking for key individuals to join our Technology Services Engineering team to help shape this vision and be pivotal in transforming how we do business with customers and vendors.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will demonstrate the following characteristics:
You have proven background in delivering complex, high performance, highly available solutions
You are creative and come up with innovative approaches to projects and any issues that arise.
You are a "do'er". You get things done.
Sharing expertise and insight with other engineers
Currently the tech stack is not 100% fixed but we have a strong preference for commercial experience of opensource plus cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have a background that spans development, architecture, and operations. We are looking for full stack engineers with preference for staff that can provide expert coverage over three primary areas, plus some ability across all areas.
DevOps - Github, Terraform, Ansible
Cloud - AWS, Azure, GCP
Operational System - RHEL, Windows
Hypervisor - KVM, AHV, VMWare
Database - Oracle, Microsoft SQL, PostgreSQL
Patch management - Redhat Satellite WSUS
Config management - AWX
Domain driven design experience and understand how to create composable microservices and API's
Opensource - Track record of community activity and contribution
Key Responsibilities
Execute technical, engineering practices, and engineering methodologies.
Work on our problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs and help drive our platform vision forward
Execute technology roadmap with the associated release goals. Participate in POCs for new and upcoming strategic technology solutions.
Handling and automating day to day administration tasks including systems reporting and system tuning
Good understanding of programming and scripting, with the ability to create targeted, ad-hoc custom solutions to specific problems the ability to design and write larger-scale applications able to function on a large server estate
Contribute to documentation and team routines
Works in collaboration with other engineers
Representation of Maersk in external technology events and conferences.
Key Skills
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering
5+ years of experience of engineering experience at scale
Experience with diverse operational systems both on prem (virtual and physical) and in Cloud (Azure and Google)
Develop and implement solutions using Python (or other programming language), CLI, PowerShell, GPOs
Experience in system performance analysis, tuning, and troubleshooting experience including network, system, and hardware optimization for low latency.
Experience with High Availability, clustering, failover, and load balancing
Red Hat and/or Microsoft Windows Server certification is a plus
Knowledge of programming languages, operating system principles, networking, and software development best practices.
Experience of working with offshore teams
Experience of Test-Driven Development approaches

Key Responsibilities
Act as the primary bilingual liaison between Japanese client stakeholders (HQ and regional teams) and the Oracle Cloud delivery team across requirement workshops, CRP/UAT cycles, and steering committee updates.
Support supply chain process workstreams planning, order management, procurement, inventory, and manufacturing — and, where relevant experience exists, contribute to configuration, testing, and rollout activities on the Oracle Cloud platform.
Translate and localise functional specifications, process flows, test scripts, and training materials between Japanese and English, ensuring technical accuracy is preserved.
Facilitate real-time interpretation during design workshops, CRP demonstrations, and issue-resolution calls with Japanese business and IT stakeholders.
Support fit-gap analysis and solution design for Japan-specific statutory, tax, and reporting requirements within Oracle Cloud (e.g. consumption tax, Japan GAAP nuances, e-invoicing).
Coordinate with onshore Japan-based teams and offshore delivery teams to manage cultural and time-zone alignment, escalations, and status reporting.
Contribute to test scenario validation, data migration reviews, and cutover planning for multi-country, multi-plant Oracle Cloud implementations in the automotive sector.
Support change management and end-user training delivery for Japanese-speaking plant and business teams.

Required Qualifications
Japanese Language Proficiency (Primary requirement): JLPT N3 minimum; N2 or above strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience using Japanese in a professional/business context (client calls, documentation, workshops).
Industry Background (Primary requirement): Prior experience on automotive OEM or Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier programmes — familiarity with JIT/JIS manufacturing, multi-plant/multi-country rollouts, and automotive-specific supply chain processes.
Oracle Cloud Knowledge (Good to have, not mandatory): Exposure to Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules — Supply Planning, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, Manufacturing, Product Hub/PLM — will be viewed favourably but is not a prerequisite.
Consulting Experience: Prior experience with a Big 4, global systems integrator, or automotive-industry consulting/coordination role; comfortable working in client-facing delivery roles.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field; any ERP or Oracle Cloud certification is a bonus, not expected.
Willingness to travel to client sites (India and potentially Japan) as required by programme milestones.

Preferred / Good to Have
Prior experience specifically supporting Japanese automotive clients (e.g. DENSO, Toyota Group, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, or their Tier-1 supplier ecosystem).
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules from prior implementation, support, or super-user experience.
JETRO or other formal bilingual business-communication certification.
Prior experience as a bridge engineer, IT coordinator, or business analyst in a Japanese-client environment — candidates strong on language and automotive-industry fit will be considered even without direct Oracle exposure, with structured platform training provided on the job.

Ansible

BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Ability to troubleshoot complex deployment and infrastructure issues.

About the Role:
We are looking for an Associate level legal professional who can act as a trusted business advisor who works collaboratively across business, sales, and other functions and has the knowledge and experience required to take on a variety of legal assignments, such as employment law advisory, intellectual property advisory and portfolio management, transactional support and assistance, SaaS Agreements with potential customers of Zeta, and agreements with SaaS Vendors who provide SaaS to Zeta for internal consumption or integration within Zetas SaaS Offerings.
Responsibilities
Drafting, negotiating, managing internal and external stakeholders, as well as managing external legal advisors assisting the company on such assignments.
Provide legal advice and opinions on all legal matters that impact the business and provide innovative solutions to minimize/manage the legal risks involved with the companys business operations in various jurisdictions around the world
To communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (such as management, leadership teams, Finance, HR, Information Security etc) and external stakeholders (customers/clients, vendors, investor representatives, industry association representatives).
To constantly improve and evolve the drafts and templates created by the legal team, from learnings from each customer. Strive to simplify drafting in order to achieve quicker turn-around-times and to make legal agreements easier for non-legal stakeholders to understand.

Skills
The candidate must have an excellent grasp of laws and market practices pertaining to a variety of technology agreements such as SaaS Master Service Agreements, Professional Services Agreements, Software Development Agreements; data protection laws and issues under a contract, intellectual property and other affiliated areas.
The candidate should have the ability to work independently and within a team as and when required and must have unimpeachable integrity, honesty and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills in order to communicate with persons across different walks of life and cultures and in order to understand business requirements and communicate the required solutions.
Ability to explain contract risks and obligations to non-lawyers.
Attention to detail, speed, and efficiency in reviewing and drafting documents.

Experience and Qualifications
7 year BA.LLB (Hons) degree from a reputed national law university/college. (Mandatory Requirement) LLM or postgraduate degree in law from a reputed international law university specifically in the field of technology law. (Optional Requirement).
Post Qualification Experience: 4 years In a top tier law firm, preferably within the technology law practice of the firm or at the least some level of experience in technology contracts; and/or As an in-house counsel in a Technology Company (preferably, SaaS however Non-SaaS technology company experience will also be accepted) People with prior experience in law firms, but currently working as in-house counsel will be preferred over people with no prior law firm experience.

Department: Supply Chain Finance Counter-party Team.

Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, Chandigarh, Lucknow, and Hyderabad.


Role Summary

Own endtoend onboarding of vendors, dealers and other counterparties under anchorled Supply Chain Finance programs. Ensure fast, compliant onboarding, smooth activation and strong earlystage engagement to drive utilization and portfolio hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

Engage with vendors/dealers to explain SCF products, benefits and onboarding process.
Manage complete onboarding workflow: KYC, documentation, risk checks, approvals and limit setup.
Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Ops, Legal and Tech for frictionless onboarding and compliance.
Drive activation: ensure counterparties utilize limits and monitor your portfolio growth and quality.
Monitor counterparty-level ageing/overdue, flag early warning indicators, follow-up for payments, support Collections on early bucket resolution, and ensure anchor alignment on disputes.
Resolve operational issues, documentation gaps and onboarding bottlenecks.
Maintain MIS, funnel trackers and adherence to onboarding TATs.
Support Anchor Relationship Managers with utilization, reactivation and earlycycle portfolio hygiene.

Key KPIs

Counterparties onboarded
Onboarding TAT (Pre-sanction documentation Approval post-sanction documentation Golive)
Documentation quality / monitor deferrals.
Firstdrawdown % and utilization support

Candidate Profile

Experience: 4 to 10 years in SCF, Working Capital, Trade Finance, MSME lending or onboarding roles.
Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.

Job Title: AI/ML Researcher Data Science

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 57 Years | Freshers can also apply

Job Family: Technology

1. Key Purpose of the Role

We are looking for a research-oriented Data Scientist with strong expertise in Python, Applied Statistics and Machine Learning. The role involves analysing complex datasets, applying statistical techniques, developing predictive models and generating data-driven insights to solve business, research and R&D challenges, particularly in the colour and coatings domain.

The ideal candidate should have strong fundamentals in Data Science, statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms and hands-on Python programming, with the ability to conduct research, experiment with different methodologies and develop reliable analytical models.

2. Roles & Responsibilities

Analyse, clean, process and interpret large datasets to identify patterns, trends and meaningful insights.
Apply statistical techniques, hypothesis testing, probability and predictive analytics to solve research and business problems.
Develop, train, test and validate machine learning and statistical models using Python.
Work on supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, including regression, classification and clustering.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), feature engineering, model selection and performance evaluation.
Apply statistical modelling and experimental data analysis to support research and decision-making.
Work with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, SciPy and TensorFlow/PyTorch.
Work with Databricks and structured datasets for data exploration and analytical modelling.
Collaborate with research, R&D and technical teams to understand problems and develop data-driven solutions.
Interpret model outcomes, validate findings and communicate analytical insights to stakeholders.
Document research methodologies, statistical findings, modelling approaches and results.

3. Role Requirements

Educational Qualifications

Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or Statistics with strong Data Science knowledge may also be considered.

Experience

57 years of relevant experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, Machine Learning or Research Analytics preferred.
Freshers with a Master's degree and strong academic knowledge or hands-on project experience in Data Science, Statistics and Machine Learning are also encouraged to apply.
Candidates should demonstrate strong fundamentals in statistical analysis, Python programming and model development.

Mandatory Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of Python programming.
Hands-on knowledge of Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn.
Good understanding of Applied Statistics, Probability and Statistical Modelling.
Knowledge of Regression, Classification and Clustering techniques.
Understanding of Machine Learning algorithms and model-building methodologies.
Experience or academic exposure to Data Analysis, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Feature Engineering and Model Validation.

Good to Have

Exposure to TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Knowledge of Databricks.
Familiarity with SciPy, Statsmodels and MLflow.
Exposure to research-oriented, industrial or manufacturing datasets.
Knowledge of Computer Vision and Deep Learning.
Familiarity with Colour Science, spectral data or R&D analytics.

4. Ideal Candidate Profile

A research-oriented Data Scientist with strong statistical fundamentals, excellent Python knowledge and practical experience in developing predictive and statistical models.

The candidate should be comfortable working with complex datasets, conducting independent analysis, experimenting with different modelling techniques and deriving meaningful insights.

Core Focus Areas: Data Science | Applied Statistics | Python | Machine Learning | Statistical Modelling | Model Building

Freshers with relevant Master's qualifications, strong coursework and practical Data Science projects are welcome to apply.

Success Factors Time Management Consultant (Offshore)

Job Description
The Time Management Consultant is responsible for the end-to-end design, configuration and delivery of the SuccessFactors Time Management workstream. Working as part of an offshore delivery team under Lead Consultant oversight, the consultant owns Time Off configuration, Time Tracking, Consolidated Time Recording (CTR), Time Valuation rules, Overtime configuration and the integration between SuccessFactors and external workforce management systems such as UKG Pro or Kronos.
This is a hands-on configuration and delivery role. The consultant must be able to advise on and configure both positive and negative time management models, design CTR to aggregate all time data correctly before it reaches payroll, and ensure that Time Valuation rules produce the correct wage type outputs for every category of time entry. Advisory experience without direct configuration capability does not meet the requirements of this role.
The consultant is also responsible for configuring the integration between SuccessFactors and external workforce management systems, and for building Story Reports that give HR, management and payroll teams visibility of absence balances, accrual positions, overtime exceptions and timesheet status.
Primary Skills
Strong consulting and advisory skills.
Strong client stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
Solution oriented.
Problem solving skills combined with a can-do attitude. Takes ownership.
Strong teamworking and collaboration skills.
Experience
Minimum 8 years SAP SuccessFactors EC & Time Management functional consultancy experience across process design, configuration, testing (Unit, SIT, E2E), trial data migration and deployment
Referenced experience of leading at least 5 successful SuccessFactors EC TM implementations full lifecycle including trial data migration validation and reconciliations.
Experience in implementing innovative, robust and future-proof SAP SuccessFactors EC TM solutions.
Experience of successfully deploying SuccessFactors EC TM and migrating from ECC HCM to EC TM in large complex critical infrastructure operations including public sector.
Experience of implementations covering mixed workforces where some populations are on positive time management and others are on negative time management.
Strong, hands-on design, configuration, test and technical skills in SuccessFactors EC TM. This includes but is not limited to Timesheet configuration, Time Off configuration, Overtime rules, Timesheet & ECP integration, Automatic break deduction, Pay type generation rules.
Experience configuring Consolidated Time Recording (CTR) – attendance, overtime, absences, breaks, allowances and imported time entries from external systems.
Experience configuring Time Valuation rules for all time input types: regular hours, overtime, shift premiums, absence valuation and imported time from external workforce management systems.
Intimate knowledge of complex EC & TM integration to KRONOS and or UKG PRO is required to be successful in this role.
Experience designing the integration boundary between SuccessFactors and an external workforce management system and defining which employees are managed in which system, the data format, import frequency and error handling process.
SuccessFactors EC, TM and Story Reporting certification required.
Experience of native integration (EC to TM and S/4HANA) and non-native integration to satellite systems via BTP Integration Suite, APIs and Flat Files.
Experience of Integration methods: BIB, BTP Integration Suite, CGI, API and Flat File transfer.
Experience of communicating effectively to stakeholders at all levels in workshops, workstream meetings, daily standups and governance.
Strong negotiation, persuasion and influencing skills.
Ability to plan and lead client workshops and deliver successful design outcomes.
Knowledge and experience to guide clients on SuccessFactors EC TM best practice and innovations.
Up to date knowledge of the SuccessFactors EC TM and Story Reporting roadmap.
Experience working in an offshore delivery model under Lead Consultant oversight with defined quality gate checkpoints.
Experience and willingness to work flexibly both onsite and remotely.
Experience of solution delivery across multiple geographies – desirable.
Experience and ability to demonstrate the SF system to challenging customer stakeholders.
Experience of SF ONB (Onboarding), SF RCM (Recruiting) – nice to have.

Techno Functional Competencies
Configure Role-Based Permissions for Time Management – ensuring employees can request absences and view balances, managers can approve absences and view team time data, and administrators can perform corrections and override approvals.
Configure Time Types and Time Accounts for all absence categories – Annual Leave, Sick Leave, Maternity, Paternity, Public Holiday and any organisation-specific absence types.

Detailed JD:

The Multi-Cloud DevOps, DevSecOps & Platform Engineer will design, build, automate and support modern software delivery and cloud platform solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role requires strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, cloud platforms, observability and automation. The engineer will collaborate with application, cloud, security and operations teams to build secure, scalable and reusable deployment solutions while improving release reliability and engineering efficiency.
Candidates should have strong expertise in at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP). Exposure to additional cloud platforms and multi-cloud environments is preferred.
1. CI/CD & DevOps Engineering
Design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and/or Jenkins.
Implement Git-based workflows, reusable pipeline templates, artifact management, environment promotion, approvals and rollback mechanisms.
Implement GitOps deployment practices using Argo CD and Helm for Kubernetes workloads.
Integrate automated testing, code-quality checks and security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures and improve build and release efficiency.
Build reusable pipeline components and automation to support consistent software delivery.
2. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Build reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, versions, variables and environment configurations.
Implement IaC validation, testing and configuration/drift-management practices.
Use Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation where required.
Develop Python and Shell/Bash automation for infrastructure provisioning, API integration and Day-2 operational activities.
Automate repeatable infrastructure and platform activities to reduce manual intervention.
3. DevSecOps & Security Automation
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning, container/image scanning and secrets detection.
Implement secure artifact, container image and dependency-management practices.
Integrate secrets-management and key-management solutions with pipelines and application deployments.
Apply appropriate access controls and least-privilege principles for pipeline and runtime identities.
Work with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
Support automated security and compliance validation within the software delivery lifecycle.
4. Multi-Cloud & PaaS Engineering
Implement DevOps and deployment solutions across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Work with relevant PaaS and serverless services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions.
Support application teams with standardized approaches for build, deployment, configuration, secrets, networking and monitoring.
Leverage cloud-native services while maintaining reusable and consistent DevOps practices.
Support hybrid and multi-cloud deployment requirements where applicable.
5. Containers, Kubernetes & GitOps
Build, deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with managed Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Implement Kubernetes application packaging and deployments using Helm and Argo CD.
Configure deployments, autoscaling, ingress, secrets, configuration and application upgrade strategies.
Integrate container/image scanning and Kubernetes security controls into CI/CD processes.
Troubleshoot application deployment, container and Kubernetes platform issues across environments.
6. Observability & SRE Practices
Implement monitoring and observability across applications, infrastructure and Kubernetes using Datadog, Dynatrace and/or cloud-native monitoring tools.
Configure and manage metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts.
Support SLI/SLO-based monitoring, incident management and operational runbooks.
Automate common operational, monitoring and remediation activities.
Analyze telemetry to improve application reliability, deployment stability and platform performance.
Participate in incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous reliability improvements.

Position: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Program Manager- DevOps-Cloud Platform Engineering
Experience: 12+Years
Shift: General Shift (Flexibility required for global stakeholder engagements)

Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12 years of relevant experience.
Technical Program Manager accountable for delivering the CCOE transformation program: an Operations Control Plane, The role is AI-first by mandate: the TPM is expected to design, prove, and scale AI-assisted operations across the program. It combines hands-on technical credibility someone who still builds, prototypes, and reviews code with large-scale program leadership across engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders, and a demonstrated bias for speed and measurable outcomes.
Your future duties and responsibilities
• Plan and run PI cadences: scope, dependencies, capacity, exit criteria, and transparent re-planning across all CCOE workstreams.
• Drive wave-based rollouts (e.g., observability across multi-tenant AKS estates) within client change windows and government compliance constraints.
• Build funding and business cases spanning multiple internal organizations; force decisions through steering with stated cost of delay.
• Referee build-vs-buy and competing-architecture decisions against written criteria; time-box debates and document decisions with revisit conditions.
• Lead vendor evaluation and enterprise contract negotiation for platform tooling — pricing, support SLAs, security and compliance terms.
• Report program outcomes without spin: MTTR, escalation rate, automation coverage, and SLA adherence.
• Partner with operations leadership on workforce transition: reskilling, redeployment, and adoption of new tooling and workflows — including AI literacy and safe, governed use of AI tooling.
• Own the AI roadmap for operations: LLM-assisted triage, RAG over runbooks, tickets, and telemetry, agentic remediation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows — from prototype through production with evaluation, guardrails, and cost controls.
• Define AI governance with security and compliance: data residency, PII handling, prompt and output logging, human-in-the-loop gates, and model/version change control for government clients.
• Drive urgency through time-boxed delivery: bias to 2–4 week proof points, kill or scale decisions on evidence, and visible burn-down of the riskiest unknowns first.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must to Have Skills:
• Azure platform depth (primary cloud): AKS at multi-tenant production scale, Azure networking (VNet, Private Link, Front Door, App Gateway), Entra ID, Azure Policy and landing-zone/Well-Architected design, autoscaling, tenancy isolation, and cost management (FinOps, reservations, tagging, chargeback).
• Azure services breadth: Azure Monitor and Log Analytics (KQL), Managed Grafana, Key Vault, Storage, API Management, Functions and Container Apps, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Azure SQL, and DevOps/GitHub integration. • Observability: Understanding of OpenTelemetry-based stacks (traces, logs, metrics), sampling and retention economics, and alert tuning at scale.
• CI/CD and GitOps: Understanding of GitHub Actions, Argo CD, incremental builds, and policy-as-code gates (OPA, Kyverno, Conftest) with container signing and scanning.
• Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management: Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible, and configuration-in Git with drift detection.
• Identity and security: Understanding of SSO, RBAC, and JIT access patterns (Entra ID, Keycloak); secrets and certificate lifecycle automation (Key Vault, cert-manager, ACME).
• AI and GenAI fundamentals: LLM capabilities and limits, prompt engineering, context engineering, structured output and function/tool calling, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs, token and inference cost management, and latency/quality trade-offs.
• RAG and knowledge systems: chunking and embedding strategies, vector and hybrid search (Azure AI Search, pgvector, or equivalent), re-ranking, grounding and citation, retrieval evaluation, and mitigation of hallucination and data leakage.
• Agentic and AI-assisted operations: multi-step agents and orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent), Model Context Protocol (MCP) style tool integration, and evaluation and observability of AI systems (eval harnesses, golden datasets, tracing, drift monitoring).
• Understanding of Azure AI stack: Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model deployment and quota management, private networking for AI endpoints, content safety, and responsible-AI controls.
• Hands-on engineering ability: comfortable in Python (and/or Go or TypeScript), Git-based workflows, SQL/KQL, and shipping working prototypes without waiting for a team to be assigned.
• Program tooling fluency: PI and agile planning at scale, RICE or equivalent prioritization, and dependency and risk management.

• 12+ years in technology, including 5+ years running multi-team technical programs (8–15 initiatives) as a TechPM, program lead, or platform delivery lead.
• Operations transformation: moving support and operations organizations from reactive firefighting to problem management and SRE practices.
• FOSS-biased platform strategy with explicit commercial buy triggers; hands-on vendor MSA negotiation.
