Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics
Existing responsibilities plus:
Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.
Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.
7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain
Existing responsibilities plus:
Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
Establish robust governance for:
BOM
Material master
Routings
Lead times
Planning parameters
Purchase orders
Production orders
Inventory records
Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.
Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities.
Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch.

8. Risk Management & Business Continuity
Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity.
Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions.
Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics.
Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks.

9. Continuous Improvement
Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving.
Improve:
Planning accuracy
Inventory turns
Supplier OTD
Material availability
Production plan adherence
Lead time
OTIF
Supply Chain cost
Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization.

10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs.
Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases.
Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness.
Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable.

Candidate Profile
Education :
Bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent.
Masters degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred.
Experience
10-15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment.
Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred.
Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization.

Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage
Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment.
Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment.
Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up.
Technical Competencies
Existing competencies plus:
S&OP / IBP
MPS / MRP
Production Planning & Control
Material Planning
Procurement
Inventory Management
Warehouse Management
Supplier Management
Capacity Planning
ERP / MRP / PLM systems
Advanced Excel / Power BI or equivalent analytics tools
Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma
Greenfield Plant Launch & Start-Up
Industrialization & Manufacturing Ramp-Up
Project Management
Program Management
Change Management
ERP Deployment & Go-Live
Master Data Governance
Launch Readiness & Operational Readiness Reviews
New Product Introduction (NPI)

Leadership Competencies
Existing competencies plus:
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
Ability to manage cross-functional teams
Strong stakeholder-management skills
Ability to operate in a high growth / high-pressure manufacturing environment
Strong execution discipline
Data-driven decision making
Excellent communication and escalation management
Ability to build and develop Supply Chain teams
Proven ability to build Supply Chain organizations, processes and governance from the ground up.
Experience recruiting, developing and scaling Supply Chain teams during periods of rapid growth.
Strong project leadership and cross-functional execution capabilities.
Ability to lead through uncertainty, ambiguity and changing business priorities typical of greenfield environments.

Strong capability to balance launch objectives with operational performance requirements.

Description:
We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.

Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role type- IC
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.
Mandatory Skills
Microsoft Azure
Terraform
Azure Bicep
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
CI/CD Deployment Automation
Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations
What You'll Love About Working Here
We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.
You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies like cloud and AI.

Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.

Ericsson is looking for a skilled Engineer with hands-on expertise in Ericsson IN Charging Systems to support telecom operations, system integration, ICP upgrades, audits, and implementation of customer/network changes across critical IN and charging nodes.

Perform integration, configuration, commissioning, and O&M activities on Ericsson Charging System nodes.
Execute ICP upgrades and CR-based configuration changes across CS nodes such as SDP, CCN, OCC, AIR, NELS, ADPLMN, and NGCRS.

7–10 years of overall telecom experience.

Strong knowledge of Ericsson Charging platforms including CIS, SDP, AIR, OCC, CCN, NELS, ADPLMN, and NGCRS.
Good understanding of charging, rating, balance management, and telecom network fundamentals.
Strong Unix/Linux, Shell/Python scripting, SQL/database, log analysis, troubleshooting, and networking skills.
Knowledge of cloud-native technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and microservices is preferred.
Understanding of ITIL, Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Request Management, SLA and RCA processes.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
Experience in critical incident management, RCA, automation, and service improvement.
Ability to take end-to-end ownership and work effectively in a dynamic telecom environment.
Willingness to learn, adapt, and work on evolving technologies and network solutions.

We are hiring Customer Support Executives for the E-Commerce process. The role involves assisting customers with order-related queries, delivery updates, returns, refunds, cancellations, and other shopping-related concerns through customer support channels.

* Resolve concerns regarding missing, damaged, or incorrect products.
* Address payment failures and transaction-related issues.
* Coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve customer complaints.
* Maintain accurate customer interaction records in the system.
* Follow company policies and meet productivity and quality targets.
* Ensure professional communication and customer satisfaction.

Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Join our Team
About this opportunity
We are looking for a Storage and Backup Engineer to design, implement, and support enterprise storage and data protection solutions across on-premises and cloud environments. You will play a key role in ensuring data availability, integrity, backup reliability, and disaster recovery readiness, with a strong focus on Rubrik Backup Administration and Management.
What you will do

Administer, configure, upgrade, and maintain Rubrik CDM clusters, including networking, security, replication, archival, and cloud integrations.
Manage backup and recovery operations, monitor backup jobs, and ensure successful data protection and restoration.
Implement and test disaster recovery strategies, conduct DR drills, and support data retention and compliance requirements.
Perform storage provisioning, capacity planning, performance optimization, and system health monitoring.
Troubleshoot storage, backup, and recovery issues in critical production environments.
Collaborate with virtualization, cloud, and infrastructure teams to deliver integrated backup solutions.
Automate operational tasks using scripting tools and maintain accurate technical documentation.

You will bring

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, with 5-7 years of experience in storage and backup administration.
Strong expertise in Rubrik Backup Administration and Management (mandatory), including Rubrik CDM architecture, cluster operations, distributed filesystem, metadata management, snapshots, and scale-out architectures .
Experience with enterprise backup technologies such as Veeam, Veritas NetBackup, or Commvault.
Good understanding of backup methodologies, disaster recovery concepts (RPO/RTO), storage management, and data protection best practices.
Familiarity with VMware, Hyper-V, Windows, Linux, networking fundamentals, and cloud backup solutions (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Knowledge of automation and scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to support mission-critical environments.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification".

As an Experience Manager, you will be responsible for creating a warm, professional, and efficient experience for walk-in customers. You all handle front-desk responsibilities while actively coordinating with internal Relationship Managers to ensure a seamless buying experience.

About Spinny:
Founded in 2015, Spinny is a used car retailing platform that aims to bring about transparency and convenience in the car buying and selling process in India. Spinny operates across the entire value chain of pre-owned cars, embedding superior technology and processes to deliver a premium experience to customers. As a testimony of Spinny's commitment to transparency and quality, every car on the Spinny platform comes with a 200-point inspection checklist, 5-day no questions asked money-back guarantee, and 1-year after-sales warranty. Truebil operates independently as a sister brand, aiming to capture the under-penetrated market of value-conscious car buyers.

What Will You Do?

Customer Greeting & Walk-in Handling:
Greet and welcome all walk-in customers professionally, creating a strong first impression of Spinny.
Understand customer needs and direct them to the appropriate Relationship Manager or team.
Customer Engagement:
Ensure a warm, personalized, and proactive experience during the customer entire hub visit.
Capture feedback and share insights for continuous improvement in customer service delivery.
Front Desk & Admin Operations:
Manage the front desk area, ensuring cleanliness and readiness at all times.
Maintain accurate logs of customer visits, queries, and escalations.
Support basic hub documentation and administrative tasks as required.

Eligibility & Requirements:
Experience in customer-facing roles (front desk, hospitality, or relationship management).
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and remain calm under pressure.
A proactive and customer-first mindset, aligned with Spinny's mission of creating trust and transparency.

Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and driven Manager - Talent Acquisition (Leadership Hiring) to lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership-level positions across the organization. This is currently an Individual Contributor (IC) role, requiring strong stakeholder management, executive search capabilities, market intelligence, and a consultative hiring approach. Based on business needs and performance, the role may evolve into a people management position with team leadership responsibilities in the future.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership Hiring
Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions across business functions.
Partner with senior business leaders to understand talent requirements, organizational priorities, and succession needs.
Develop and execute targeted search strategies to identify and engage high-caliber leadership talent.
Build and maintain strong leadership talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence research.
Stakeholder Management
Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.
Drive hiring discussions, calibration meetings, and offer negotiations for senior-level hires.
Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Influence hiring decisions through data-driven insights and market trends.
Talent Acquisition Excellence
Design and implement innovative sourcing strategies, including executive search methodologies.
Track and report key recruitment metrics and leadership hiring effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with internal hiring policies and recruitment governance.
Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders on workforce planning initiatives.
Employer Branding & Market Intelligence
Strengthen the organization's leadership hiring brand through networking and industry engagement.
Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor movements.
Build strong external networks with industry leaders, executive search firms, and professional associations.
Future Team Leadership Opportunities
Mentor and guide recruiters as needed on leadership hiring best practices.
Support capability building within the Talent Acquisition function.
Potentially lead and manage a team of recruiters based on business growth and organizational requirements.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with significant exposure to leadership and niche hiring.
Proven experience in hiring for Director, VP, AVP, General Manager, and other leadership positions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement.
Preferred Skills
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strong negotiation and offer management capabilities.
Data-driven decision-making and analytical mindset.
Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
High level of ownership, accountability, and business acumen.
Experience in technology, product, digital, consulting, or corporate leadership hiring is preferred.
Key Competencies

Executive Presence
Strategic Thinking
Stakeholder Management
Consultative Hiring
Talent Market Intelligence
Decision Making
Communication & Influencing
Relationship Management
Problem Solving
Results Orientation
Success Measures
Leadership hiring closure rate and quality of hire.
Time-to-fill and stakeholder satisfaction.
Leadership talent pipeline strength.
Candidate experience and offer-to-join ratio.
Contribution to strategic workforce planning and talent acquisition initiatives.

Role & Responsibilities
About the role: The incumbent is responsible for driving training, quality, and process excellence across Central Kitchens by ensuring adherence to SOPs, conducting audits and evaluations, and building team
capability.
The role focuses on maintaining product consistency, supporting new product launches, developing training resources, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance operational standards and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
Train, evaluate, and ensure standard operating procedures (SOPs) are adhered to.
Train kitchen staff on the production and finishing of new product launches, ensuring they align with company standards.
Conduct evaluations to ensure kitchen staff have a firm grasp of the foundational principles set by the SOP or previous training.
Carry out periodic quality checks and process audits in each CK to guarantee product consistency and adherence to company standards.
Collaborate with the Corporate Chef Culinary Excellence, Training and Quality, AVP and GM.
Production, NPD & I head, SCM and Operations to relay feedback, areas of improvement, and training needs identified during site visits.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. CNC Machine Operation
Operate CNC roll-turning and machining equipment safely and efficiently as per approved operating procedures.
Carry out roll turning, dressing, grooving, machining and finishing operations as per approved roll pass drawings and machining instructions.
Select appropriate CNC programs, tools, inserts and machining parameters according to roll material and profile requirements.

2. Roll Pass Machining
Perform accurate machining of roll passes, grooves, collars, radii and other required profiles.
Ensure correct pass dimensions, groove depth, roll diameter and profile geometry as per drawing/pass schedule.
Maintain required surface finish and dimensional accuracy.

3. Roll Inspection
Inspect rolls before and after CNC machining for:
Roll diameter
Groove dimensions
Pass profile
Collar dimensions
Radius
Surface condition
Cracks/chipping and other abnormalities
Use vernier caliper, micrometer, profile gauges and other measuring instruments correctly.

4. Roll Dressing & Reconditioning
Carry out scheduled roll dressing/reconditioning to restore required pass geometry.
Ensure proper removal of worn, damaged or cracked portions before machining.
Follow defined roll-dressing frequency and tonnage-based maintenance requirements.

5. CNC Program & Parameter Control
Use approved CNC programs and ensure correct program selection for each roll/pass.
Verify tool offsets, work offsets, zero setting and machine parameters before starting machining.
Report any abnormality in CNC program, machine movement or machining parameters to the supervisor.

6. Dimensional Accuracy & Quality
Ensure machining is carried out within specified dimensional tolerances.
Verify critical pass dimensions at appropriate stages of machining.
Prevent over-machining and maintain maximum possible roll/pass life.
Ensure proper identification and traceability of each roll after machining.

7. Machine Maintenance
Carry out routine inspection of CNC machine, lubrication system, hydraulic system, coolant system, chuck/fixtures and other accessories.
Check machine condition before starting the shift.
Immediately report abnormal vibration, noise, temperature, leakage, spindle/tool issues or CNC alarms.
Maintain basic operator-level preventive maintenance activities.

8. Tool & Consumable Management
Ensure proper selection and handling of cutting tools, inserts, holders and measuring instruments.
Monitor tool wear and replace tools at appropriate intervals.
Maintain minimum required stock of critical CNC tools and consumables.

9. Safety
Follow all SPM safety procedures, PPE, LOTO and machine guarding requirements.
Ensure proper clamping and securing of rolls before machining.
Never enter the machining zone while the machine is running.
Maintain safe handling practices for heavy rolls using EOT crane/Hydra/Farana as applicable.
Report unsafe conditions, near misses and equipment abnormalities immediately.

10. Roll Identification & Traceability
Verify roll identification, grade, serial number and machining requirement before starting work.
Maintain proper records of roll diameter before/after machining.
Record machining details, pass number, tonnage, dressing quantity and final dimensions.
Ensure proper marking and storage of completed rolls.

11. Coordination with Roll Shop & Mill
Coordinate with Roll Shop, Guide Shop and SPM Operations for timely availability of rolls.
Prioritize roll machining according to the rolling schedule and upcoming section changes.
Ensure emergency roll dressing/machining requirements are attended promptly to minimize mill downtime.

12. Troubleshooting
Identify machining abnormalities such as chatter, vibration, poor surface finish, dimensional deviation, tool breakage and incorrect profile.
Take immediate corrective action within the defined operating procedure.
Escalate major machine or quality issues to the CNC Supervisor/Shift In-Charge.

13. 5S & Housekeeping
Maintain excellent housekeeping around the CNC machine and work area.
Ensure proper collection and disposal of chips, coolant and machining waste.
Keep tools, gauges and fixtures properly identified and stored.
Follow 5S standards and workplace organization practices.

14. Continuous Improvement
Participate in TPM, 5S, Kaizen and productivity-improvement initiatives.
Suggest improvements in machining cycle time, tool life, roll utilization and pass life.
Support reduction of CNC machining time and improvement of roll-shop productivity.

Required Competencies
1. Temp. above 30C .
2. Proximity to Heat, Noise & Temperature.

Description:
Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Area Incharge-Mechanical
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to lead the mechanical operations within the Pellet Plant department. This role demands a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for overseeing the maintenance, reliability, and performance of all mechanical equipment and systems in the pellet plant. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize plant productivity. This position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, mechanical engineering principles, and team leadership within a heavy industrial environment.
Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the mechanical maintenance team to ensure optimal performance and reliability of pellet plant machinery and equipment.
Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.
Coordinate with production and quality teams to align mechanical operations with plant production goals and quality standards.
Monitor and analyze mechanical equipment performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.
Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols and regulatory compliance within the mechanical department.
Manage budgeting, procurement, and inventory control for mechanical spare parts and tools.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on mechanical efficiency, cost reduction, and process optimization.
Oversee root cause analysis of mechanical failures and lead troubleshooting efforts to prevent recurrence.
Mentor and develop mechanical engineering staff, fostering a culture of technical excellence and teamwork.
Collaborate with engineering and project teams on equipment upgrades, installations, and modifications.

Mechanical Equipment Maintenance
Predictive and Preventive Maintenance
Root Cause Analysis
Team Leadership and Development
Budgeting and Cost Control
Safety and Regulatory Compliance
Performance Monitoring and Data Analysis
Project Management
Process Optimization
Inventory and Spare Parts Management
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; a Masters degree is preferred.
Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in mechanical maintenance and operations within the steel manufacturing or heavy industrial sector.

About the team :
EDC & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

Were looking for a dynamic Team Leader to drive EDC device sales under the Railway Transit. You will be responsible for managing a team of field executives, driving distribution, and ensuring consistent growth in merchant onboarding and transaction volumes.

5. Monitor daily productivity, quality of acquisitions, and incentive earnings
6. Train, guide, and motivate team to perform and scale
7. Analyze market trends and competitor activities
8. Regular reporting and MIS handling using Excel and sales tools

Requirements / Expectations :
1. Must have a smartphone, bike, and helmet
2. Minimum 3 years of experience in channel sales & distribution
3. Proven experience in leading field sales teams
4. Strong knowledge of merchant onboarding, incentives, and field sales operations
5. Experience in POS/EDC device sales will be preferred
6. Familiar with metrics-based sales tracking and incentive planning

Education :
Graduate (mandatory); Post-Graduation preferred

Description:
Group Company: Bharat Aluminium Company Limited (VAML)
Position: Lead Electrical Maintenance
Department: Maintenance
Office Location: Korba
Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Bachelors degree in electrical engineering.
1-7 years of hands-on experience in electrical maintenance.
Required Functional Skills:
Preventive Maintenance:
Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules for electrical equipment.
Perform routine inspections to identify and address potential issues before they become major problems.
Troubleshooting:
Diagnose and resolve electrical faults and breakdowns in a timely manner.
Utilize diagnostic tools and equipment to identify root causes of electrical issues.
Repair and Replacement:
Perform repairs or replacements of faulty electrical components.
Ensure that all repairs comply with safety and operational standards.
Electrical Testing:
Conduct electrical tests and measurements to ensure equipment functionality.
Analyze test results to make necessary adjustments or repairs.
Compliance and Safety:
Adhere to all safety regulations and protocols to maintain a safe working environment.
Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
Documentation and Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs.
Prepare detailed reports on maintenance issues and corrective actions taken.
Technical Support:
Provide technical support and guidance to other maintenance personnel.
Assist in the training of new team members on electrical maintenance procedures.
Inventory Management:
Monitor and manage inventory of electrical spare parts and tools.
Ensure timely procurement of necessary materials to avoid downtime.
Emergency Response:
Respond promptly to emergency situations to minimize downtime and ensure safety.
Develop and participate in emergency preparedness drills and exercises.
Required Behavioural Skills:
Attention to Detail:
Meticulously follow maintenance procedures and protocols.
Ensure precision in all maintenance tasks to avoid errors and accidents.
Problem-Solving:
Approach electrical issues with a logical and analytical mindset.
Develop innovative solutions to complex electrical problems.
Team Collaboration:
Work effectively with colleagues and other departments to achieve common goals.
Share knowledge and expertise to support team development and success.
Communication:
Clearly communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
Provide regular updates to supervisors and team members on maintenance activities.
Adaptability:
Quickly adapt to changing work conditions and priorities.
Embrace new technologies and methods in electrical maintenance.
Time Management:
Prioritize tasks efficiently to ensure timely completion of maintenance activities.
Balance multiple responsibilities and projects simultaneously.
Safety Consciousness:
Prioritize safety in all aspects of electrical maintenance work.
Encourage and promote a culture of safety among team members.

JOB SUMMARY
The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for proactively soliciting and managing large group/catering related opportunities with significant revenue potential. Manages group/catering opportunities not handled by an Event Booking Center (EBC). Actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenue opportunity. Achieves personal and team related revenue goals. Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience. Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
  CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities & Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
  Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.
  Additional Responsibilities
- Utilizes intranet for resources and information.
- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Position Overview
We are looking for an energetic and result-oriented Sales Representative to develop sales and distribution in the assigned territory.
The candidate will be responsible for appointing and developing Stockists/Distributors, generating Primary & Secondary Sales, increasing retail coverage, opening new outlets, and achieving monthly sales targets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop potential Stockists / Distributors in the assigned territory.
Assist in appointment and activation of new Stockists/Distributors.
Generate Primary Sales from Stockists/Distributors as per assigned targets.
Drive Secondary Sales through regular retailer and market visits.
Visit retailers, wholesalers and dealers according to the assigned beat plan.
Generate regular orders from existing and new retail outlets.
Open new retail outlets and increase numerical distribution in the territory.
Ensure availability and visibility of company products at retail outlets.
Develop new markets, towns and sales opportunities within the assigned area.
Build strong relationships with Stockists, Distributors, Wholesalers and Retailers.
Ensure adequate stock availability with Stockists/Distributors.
Implement company schemes, promotions and new product launches in the market.
Monitor competitor products, pricing, schemes and market activities.
Follow up with distributors for orders, supplies and payments where required.
Maintain daily market visit, order booking and sales reports.
Achieve monthly Primary Sales, Secondary Sales, Outlet Coverage and New Outlet Opening targets.
Candidate Profile
* Experience: fresh or 1-2 years in Field Sales / General Trade / Distribution Sales.
* Experience in FMCG / Food / Consumer Products / General Trade preferred.
* Good understanding of Primary and Secondary Sales.
* Experience in retailer/dealer development and stockist handling preferred.
* Good knowledge of the local market and surrounding areas.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Target-oriented and willing to travel extensively in the assigned territory.
* Candidate should be comfortable with daily field visits.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will primarily be measured on:
* Primary Sales Achievement
* Secondary Sales Achievement
* New Stockist / Distributor Development
* New Outlet Opening
* Productive Calls / Daily Market Coverage
* Retailer Order Generation
* Product Availability & Visibility
* Achievement of Monthly Sales Targets

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Description:
Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, , Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.

7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
