Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Effective and consistent follow-up skills

Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development

Description:
The Team Leader - ESSCO will spearhead the sales team s efforts to position Essco as a leading brand in the value market segment. This role requires strategic oversight and hands-on management to drive revenue growth across Essco s product lines, including faucets, sanitaryware, cisterns, and H.W.S. The Team Leader will take personal ownership of key Regional Distributors (RDs), ensure effective training of the sales team, and achieve substantial dealer growth. This role is pivotal in executing market strategies, enhancing dealer performance, and leading a high-performing team to meet and exceed targets.
Key Responsibilities
Sales Team Performance: Oversee and drive the performance of the Essco sales team to meet or exceed revenue targets across all product lines: ESSCO Faucets, ESSCO Sanitaryware, ESSCO Cisterns, and ESSCO H.W.S.
Key Account Management: Take personal ownership of select top RDs, ensuring they meet their sales targets and contribute to overall revenue performance
RSD Management: Manage and coordinate with Regional Sub-Distributors (RSDs) to ensure alignment with sales strategies and optimal performance
RD Recruitment & Selection: Identify and recruit suitable Regional Distributors (RDs) in consultation with the HOD/ZH
Dealer Growth: Drive dealer growth, ensuring a minimum of 85% of the dealer universe shows measurable expansion and increased productivity
Sales Team Training: Conduct and oversee targeted training sessions for the RD/RDS sales team to enhance their skills and performance, ensuring all training goals are met
Market Development: Develop and implement strategies to expand Essco s market presence, including penetrating new markets and increasing the brand s footprint in existing areas
Performance Monitoring: Monitor and analyze sales performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions as needed
Dealer Relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers to foster growth, resolve issues, and enhance dealer satisfaction
Reporting: Provide regular reports to senior management on sales performance, market trends, and team progress, including insights and recommendations for strategic adjustments
Operational Efficiency: Ensure efficient and effective execution of sales operations, including compliance with company policies, pricing strategies, and promotional activities
Brand Visibility and Hygiene: Maintain high standards of brand visibility and hygiene across all dealer showrooms and points of sale
Issue Resolution and Coordination: Address and resolve any issues related to supplies, sales policies, and customer care in coordination with the relevant departments
Market Analysis: Conduct market surveys and analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Inventory Management: Ensure effective inventory management and supply chain operations to meet market demands
Promotional Activities: Lead the implementation of promotional activities and marketing campaigns to boost brand visibility and sales
Dealer and Customer Pipeline: Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of potential new dealers and customers
Compliance and Ethics: Ensure compliance with company policies and ethical standards in all business operations
OC & Factory Visits: Plan and facilitate visits to Orientation Centers (OCs) and the factory for potential external customers
Supply & Sales Issue Resolution: Address and resolve issues related to supplies, sales, and customer care for dealers and specifiers
Key Attributes
Proven ability to lead and motivate a sales team to achieve and exceed targets
Strong understanding of the building materials industry
Demonstrated success in managing key accounts and driving dealer growth
Effective training and development skills with a focus on enhancing team performance
Strategic thinking with the ability to implement tactical plans for market expansion and revenue growth
Strong analytical skills for monitoring performance and identifying improvement opportunities
Competencies
Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development
Qualifications and Experience
Education:
Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
An MBA or equivalent is preferred
Experience:
10-12 years of experience in sales within the building materials industry or a related sector
3-4 years of experience in a team leadership or managerial role, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving team performance
Skills:
Excellent leadership and team management skills
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
Proficiency in strategic planning and execution
Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive decision-making
Effective training and mentoring skills
Proactive problem-solving attitude and adaptability
Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Responsible for doing village surveys, getting new customers, do CGT, house verification and income assessment, do quality sourcing, ensure collections and recoveries are done as per the group/centre meeting schedule. Maintain Healthy Customer Relationships on ground in the location

Ensure recovery disposition reconciliation is done with Credit and Ops Officer as per schedule.
Ensuring critical parameters like lead to login are executed as per matrix .
Maintain centre meeting discipline, follow SOPs and code of conduct
Major Challenges
Quality sourcing and achieving targets as defined
Regular collections and maintaining customers in current bucket, regularizing and normalizing delinquent customers
Compliance on all business parameters, zero audit findings on his / her sourced customer segment / portfolio

Position Details
Position Name: Manager - Project Safety
Division: Safety & Fire Services
Location: Vijayanagar Works


Purpose of the Position
To advise, coordinate, and support Project Management in implementing effective health and safety systems, preventing injuries, ensuring statutory compliance, managing risks, and promoting safe working practices across project activities.


Organization Structure
Reports To: GM (Safety & Fire Services)
Peers: Safety Officers
Positions Reporting To: Outsourced / Contract Safety Supervisors
Organization Chart: To be attached as Annexure.


Key Result Areas (KRAs)
Project Safety: Identify hazards, conduct risk assessments, and advise on safety measures for project activities.
Safety Audits and Inspections: Conduct inspections, identify unsafe conditions, and monitor corrective actions.
Incident Management: Investigate incidents, identify root causes, maintain records, and prevent recurrence.
Training and Awareness: Conduct safety training, campaigns, and awareness programs for employees and contractors.
Statutory Compliance: Monitor applicable legal requirements and periodic examinations of lifting tools and tackles, pressure vessels, and nucleonic gauges.
Project Modifications: Provide safety inputs for modifications and expansion activities through Management of Change (MOC).
Safety Committees: Coordinate with departments, contractors, safety committees, DIC, subcommittees, and High Risk Standards.
Fire and Emergency Management: Coordinate emergency response, mobilize resources, communicate with management, and support fire incident investigations.
Continuous Improvement: Drive injury reduction, Kaizen, SAM, and other safety improvement initiatives.


Critical Tasks
Reduce injury incidents.
Conduct employee safety training.
Carry out safety audits and inspections.
Conduct risk assessments.
Monitor corrective and preventive actions.
Implement Kaizen and SAM initiatives.


Decision-Making Authority
Coordinate fire emergency response and mobilize resources within delegated authority.
Initiate or recommend immediate measures to control unsafe conditions.
Identify root causes of fire incidents and recommend preventive actions.
Communicate emergencies promptly to senior management and the Emergency Control Room.
Recommend stoppage of unsafe activities as per established procedures and delegated authority.


Educational Qualifications and Experience
Academic Qualification
BE or Diploma in any branch of Engineering.
Professional Qualification
Post Diploma in Industrial Safety from RLI, CLI, or a government-recognized institute.
Experience
Minimum 8-10 years of Project Safety experience in the steel, cement, or aluminium industries.


Competencies
Accident and incident investigation.
Hazard identification and risk assessment.
Knowledge of safety legislation, Acts, and Rules.
Safety auditing and inspection.
Emergency response and root cause analysis.
Public speaking and communication.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Good planning, organizational, and time management skills.
Working knowledge of MS Office.
Ability to work independently and adapt to changing situations.
Ability to coordinate with teams and implement improvements.


Working Relationships
Internal
HOD (Safety & Fire Services).
Other Department Heads.
Line Managers.
Contractors.
Divisional I/C (Safety & Fire Services).
Safety Officers.
External
Factory Inspectors.


Key Success Factors and Challenges
Managing human behaviour and promoting safe work practices.
Ensuring safety of unskilled manpower.
Managing risks during unplanned breakdowns and non-routine activities.


Other Responsibilities
Perform any other duties assigned by management in line with organizational requirements.

Description:
Job Summary
To ensure effective monitoring, maintenance and management of refractory systems across SMS operations, including converters, steel ladles, RH vessels, KR ladles, LHF and VLD areas. The role is responsible for ensuring refractory performance, timely maintenance, material availability, equipment readiness and adherence to safety and housekeeping standards to support uninterrupted steel plant operations.
Position Details
Position Name: Shift Engineer - Refractory SMS
Location: Vijayanagar
Reports To: Section Incharge
Organization Chart
Attach the Organization Chart as an Annexure.
Position Reports To: Section Incharge
Positions Reporting: As applicable
Key Responsibilities
Converter Monitoring: Monitor converter refractory condition and performance to ensure operational reliability and identify maintenance requirements.
Maintenance Planning: Plan and coordinate refractory maintenance activities in consultation with the Operations Department.
Miscellaneous Activities: Execute and coordinate miscellaneous refractory-related activities across SMS areas.
Sleeve Changing Activity: Coordinate and carry out sleeve-changing activities as per operational requirements.
Material Arrangement: Ensure timely arrangement and availability of refractory materials required for maintenance and operational activities.
Converter Campaign Management: Monitor and coordinate converter campaign activities to ensure optimum refractory life and performance.
Steel Ladle Maintenance: Coordinate steel ladle lining, ladle pit activities and ladle dismantling in the slag yard in coordination with Operations and Mechanical teams.
Ladle Preparation - LP Bay: Monitor ladle preparation activities, including slide gate and purging plug maintenance, running ladle observation and necessary corrective maintenance.
Purging Plug Monitoring: Monitor purging plug performance and ensure timely identification and resolution of operational issues.
LHF and VLD Activities: Coordinate miscellaneous refractory activities in LHF and VLD areas, including ladle top cover casting and heat shield maintenance across different locations.
RH Vessel Maintenance: Coordinate RH vessel dismantling and refractory lining activities.
Running RH Monitoring: Monitor running RH vessels and coordinate necessary refractory maintenance activities.

ole & responsibilities
Production Planning & Scheduling: Develop and execute production schedules to meet customer demands, including managing batch sizes, color changes, and scheduling different paint types (e.g., water-based (mainly) and solvent-based).
Process Optimization & Technical Control: Specialize in specialized paint manufacturing processes like grinding, thinning, mixing, and dispersion to improve efficiency.

Raw Material & Inventory Management: Collaborate with purchasing departments to ensure timely availability of raw materials (pigments, solvents, resins, and additives etc).

Coordinate and manage the production on a day-to-day basis. Ensuring the best utilization of production capacity, deployment of manpower, and other resources.

Ensuring all safety protocols are followed.
Ensuring proper maintenance of all the norms as per the departmental operating procedures and guidelines.
Ensure that the discharge parameters of all the equipment in the plant are within the statutory limits and the health and hygiene of the plant personnel are well maintained.
Adherence to PPE usage of the plant personnel and the work permit system is properly followed.
Process development, closely coordinating with quality control
Cost control in operations by controlling the use of utility items and implementation of the same in the cost sheet of products, ensuring better profitability.
Control of the outflow of effluent from the process block.
Preparation of MIS every month and preparing and executing an action plan as per the need.
Facing audits & corrective actions
Six Sigma approach & completion of improvement projects as per the target.

Knowledge of Paint Formulation: Understanding of the ingredients and chemical processes involved in making paint.

Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze production data and troubleshoot quality or machine issues.
Safety Consciousness: In-depth knowledge of safety protocols, specifically for hazardous material handling. Review of the safety, health, and environment system of the plant concerning people and equipment.
Leadership: Strong team management abilities to lead staff efficiently.
Bring in new ideas in your work area and implement kaizens.
Identify the training needs and co-ordinate with HR for training.

Description:
Job Summary
This role is for an Investigation and CAPA Governance Lead, responsible for overseeing incident management, deviation investigations, and CAPA execution across manufacturing and quality operations. The position ensures structured, timely, and compliant investigation practices, drives cross-functional collaboration, and maintains audit readiness through robust documentation and proactive risk management.
Roles & Responsibilities
• You will be responsible for ensuring all team members have the necessary tools and resources for accurate and timely incident logging, with periodic reviews to verify correct categorization and immediate correction of discrepancies.
• You will be responsible for supervising risk assessments to identify the potential impact of each incident on batches, equipment, facilities, calibrations, and validations, including patient safety and compliance status.
• You will be responsible for facilitating prompt escalation of critical events such as FARs or recalls, while coordinating with Compliance and Regulatory Affairs teams to evaluate broader regulatory implications.
• You will be responsible for leading cross-functional brainstorming sessions to identify potential causes and coordinating comprehensive data collection including batch records, interviews, quality data, and SOPs.
• You will be responsible for guiding data verification, analysis, and root cause identification using statistical tools, hypothesis testing, and literature research, ensuring well-supported and scientifically sound conclusions.

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYOs hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:

Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

The Warehouse Manager is responsible for overseeing daily operations of a warehouse handling direct-to-consumer distribution. This role ensures seamless order fulfillment, inventory accuracy, and efficient warehouse operations while meeting customer satisfaction goals and adhering to safety and compliance standards. The role also ensures timely sorting, grading, transformation, and distribution of products to dark stores while maintaining quality, cold chain integrity, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities Operations Management
Oversee all warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, order picking, packing, and shipping.
Implement and optimize processes to meet daily order fulfillment goals.
Ensure timely sorting, grading, transformation, and delivery while maintaining stock availability for all dark stores.
Handle complete day-to-day warehouse operations, including cold chain management, within defined cut-off timelines while ensuring quality and SOP adherence.
Inventory Control
Maintain accurate inventory records through regular cycle counts and audits.
Manage inventory accuracy and share daily stock audit reports.
Collaborate with procurement and sales teams to forecast and manage stock levels.
Ensure timely inventory liquidation (damaged and expired) as per SOP and customer SLA.
Team Leadership
Supervise, train, and motivate warehouse staff, including pickers, packers, and inventory personnel.
Manage shift schedules to ensure adequate staffing during peak periods.
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of resources such as contract associates, security staff, and transportation.
Technology Utilization
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS) to track inventory and orders efficiently.
Ensure staff are properly trained on WMS and other operational technology tools.
Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP.
Customer Experience Vendor Management
Ensure all orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time to maintain high customer satisfaction.
Address and resolve any order discrepancies or operational issues promptly.
Manage relationships with third-party vendors and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are consistently met.
Review vendor invoices thoroughly to ensure accuracy in calculations, rates, and supporting documentation, verifying alignment with contracts, SLAs, or purchase orders.
Safety Compliance
Enforce adherence to safety standards and operational regulations within the warehouse.
Ensure compliance with labor laws, health standards, and cold chain handling requirements.
Reporting KPIs
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as order accuracy, delivery timelines, inventory turnover, and productivity.
Ensure daily KPIs agreed with the customer are achieved and presented during daily operational reviews.
Track productivity across warehouse processes and minimize process waste to control variable costs.
Use operational data and insights to identify improvement opportunities.
Required Experience Skills
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
Proven experience of 10+ years managing grocery or FMCG warehouse operations, preferably involving fresh produce or cold chain logistics.
Strong experience in warehouse management systems (WMS), SAP, and inventory control processes.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendor relationships and SLA-driven operations.
Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational abilities.

 Job Title – Senior Engineer / Engineer - Commissioning (VB)
 What will you be doing?

Testing / Commissioning
• Liaises with relevant site personnel to ascertain state of lift. Posts notices on lift and communicate with the others who may be affected
• Ensures that the lift is electrically safe
• Commissions the lift in accordance with the agreed specification parameters
• Tests the lift in accordance with the relevant test document and KONE standard interpretation of EN81, Lift Directive and/or Design (Essential Health & Safety Requirements compliance)
• Takes measurements and completes the necessary documentation
• Records any abnormalities for corrective action or inclusion in H&RA for the lift/site
• Carries out final inspection and signs the Final inspection document
• The Tester reports the condition of the lift to the Installation Supervisor who is responsible for all the site activities. The Tester will give snagging items list to the Fitter and a copy to the Installation Supervisor. The Tester should not make any other communication outside the company without permission from the supervisor.
• Takes part in meetings and work groups related to quality and technical issues
• Is responsible for the lift well security (safe for other trades and public etc) and safety of all persons involved in the installation activities during commissioning and testing of the lift (or escalator)
 Are you the one?
       Candidate from Electrical Engineering background
       Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience in Elevator Testing / Commissioning (VB)
       Good understanding of Elevator & Escalator products and Site Safety
       Self-Driven professional with great enthusiasm
       Excellent Communication skills, Interpersonal skills and Presentation Skills

What do we offer?
       Career progression and opportunities within a global organization
       Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work
       Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills
       You are surrounded by fun colleagues and a lively working environment within Business Services team and KONE Front Line. The best part is all leaders are great and open-minded

We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.

At KONE, we believe in fair and competitive pay that recognizes performance and supports employee engagement. Our approach covers a comprehensive total rewards package, including both financial and non-financial benefits. We are committed to fostering a culture of fairness, respect, equity, diversity, and inclusion.

Job Description
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
With Swiggys New Supply and the recent launches of Swiggy Instamart, Swiggy Genie, and Guiltfree, we are consistently making waves in the market, while continually growing the opportunities we offer our people.

Initiate partnerships with new accounts and actively manage existing relationships, being their P.O.C. for Swiggy Sustaining and growing the relationships which translates to a growth in revenue for the city
Maintaining a strong relationship with restaurant owners (Specifically Key Accounts of the City Country) and advising them on issues related to the market and offering solutions on the same
Conduct promotional events marketing activation, primarily BTL, in conjunction with the internal teams Manage the sales administration function, and operational performance reporting, streamlining processes and systems wherever possible and advising senior management on maximizing business relationships and creating an environment where customer service can flourish, also managing a huge team
Responsible for training new recruits, especially Sales Managers, and mentoring them

Graduate with 5-6 years of experience in Business Development, Sales or Account Management
A competent decision-maker with the ability to develop, own and build a strategic plan for ensuring the best restaurants partner with us
Effective communication skills with Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life Should be able to lead and mentor the team
Identifies builds and uses a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach
Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence for change to increase the effectiveness and success on campaigns
Creativity Initiative - demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward Qualifications

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to identify inconsistencies and errors in formatted text.
Ability to follow detailed guidelines and apply them consistently.
Basic computer skills and a reliable internet connection.
Ability to work independently and meet quality and productivity targets.
Previous experience in transcription, proofreading, quality control, annotation, or linguistic projects is a plus.
Training and project guidelines will be provided before the project starts.

Flexible project-based work.

Group Company: Marks and Spencer Reliance India Private Limited

Designation: Commercial Manager

Office Location:

Position description: As a Commercial Manager, your main goal is to lead your team, drive sales, and manage the store's overall performance. Your key responsibilities include:

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Team Leadership:

? Build a Strong Team: Develop a motivated and high-performing team that is committed to achieving goals.

? Lead by Example: Encourage your team and create opportunities to boost sales through positive leadership.

? Manage Performance: Oversee Section Managers and store staff, offering guidance and coaching to improve performance.

2. Sales Store Operations:

? Drive Sales: Promote sales growth by analyzing trends like footfall, customer conversion rates, and average purchase value (UPT).

? Achieve Sales Targets: Ensure the store meets its sales targets and adjust strategies when needed to stay on track.

? Seasonal Planning: Make sure the store is prepared for seasonal events and has the right staffing levels in place.

3. Store Presentation Competition:

? Implement Brand Guidelines: Follow and enforce guidelines for visual merchandising (VM) and marketing to maintain the brand image.

? Stay Competitive: Keep an eye on local competitors and take steps to gain an advantage in your market.

4. Customer Experience:

? Connect with Customers: Build strong relationships with customers by understanding their needs and preferences.

? Respond to Feedback: Listen to feedback from both customers and staff, and share valuable insights with relevant departments for improvement.



5. Stock Management Operations:

? Efficient Stock Management: Ensure smooth and accurate stock processes to keep the store well-organized and prepared.

6. Staff Engagement Communication:

? Regular Briefings: Keep your team updated with regular meetings, sharing important information and recognizing their achievements.

? Employee Development: Provide timely feedback to help your team improve and conduct performance appraisals to track growth.

Description:
Position: Sales Executive - General Trade

Location: Silchar/Karimganj

Job Responsibilities:

Drive primary and secondary sales across the assigned territory in line with brand, SKU/pack, and monthly sales objectives.
Conduct daily market visits and execute planned sales calls as per the assigned route and beat plan.
Visit retail outlets regularly, generate orders, and drive sales volume, distribution, and outlet productivity.
Manage front-end sales activities across the General Trade channel, ensuring effective execution of sales plans.
Identify and onboard new retail outlets to expand market coverage and strengthen distribution.
Ensure effective product placement, visibility, merchandising, and promotional execution at retail outlets.
Achieve assigned daily, monthly, and periodic sales targets as communicated by management.
Develop strong relationships with retailers and distributors to improve sales, distribution, and market penetration.
Coordinate with the Distributor and Operations/Logistics teams to ensure timely product availability and delivery.
Handle retailer/distributor queries and resolve customer complaints promptly to maintain strong business relationships.
Support distributor management, including primary sales, stock availability, claims, and related commercial coordination.
Monitor market activities, competitor presence, pricing, schemes, and customer feedback, and share relevant updates with the reporting manager.
Ensure timely and accurate daily sales reporting, market visit reports, order booking, and other required MIS.
Execute promotional activities and company initiatives effectively within the assigned territory.
Perform any other sales or market-related responsibilities assigned by the Management/Reporting Manager.

Desired Candidate Profile:

Graduate or equivalent qualification; MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.
Fresher or 2-4 years of experience in General Trade, FMCG, Consumer Goods, or a similar field-sales role.
Candidates with experience handling retailers, distributors, and market/beat sales will be preferred.
Good understanding of the local market and retail network in Roha/Mangaon and surrounding areas will be an advantage.
Strong track record of achieving sales targets and expanding market coverage.
Willingness to undertake extensive field travel and daily market visits.
Should be self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working independently in a target-driven environment.

Description:
Responsible for providing short-term, specialized patient care, diagnostic monitoring, and minor surgical procedures that do not require overnight hospitalization.

Clinical & Patient Care
Outpatient Consultations (OPD): Conduct primary medical examinations, take comprehensive patient histories, and assess acute or chronic illnesses.
Daycare Management: Supervise and manage short-stay patients undergoing procedures like IV fluid therapies, chemotherapy sessions, dialysis, blood transfusions, or prolonged diagnostic monitoring.
Minor Procedures: Perform or assist in minor surgical or medical procedures such as wound suturing, dressings, incision and drainage (I&D), foreign body removal, and catheterization.
Diagnostic Interpretation: Order and evaluate basic clinical investigations (e.g., blood tests, X-rays, ECGs) to formulate quick and accurate treatment plans.
Emergency & Stabilization
Acute Care & Triage: Identify critical shifts in a patient's vital signs or general condition during their short stay.
Emergency Management: Administer first-line emergency medical care and stabilize patients experiencing sudden medical crises before coordinating transfers to higher care centers.
Operations & Administration
Multidisciplinary Liaison: Coordinate closely with nursing staff, specialist consultants, and administrators to ensure seamless patient care and timely discharges.
Medical Documentation: Maintain highly precise Electronic Medical Records (EMR), including admission notes, procedure records, drug charts, and discharge summaries.
Referrals & Follow-ups: Structure comprehensive discharge guidelines and schedule routine outpatient follow-up care.

Qualifications & Licensing
Degree: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from a recognized medical council.
Licensure: Valid and active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or National Medical Commission (NMC)

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.

Description:
GROWTH MANAGER
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Growth Manager plays a pivotal dual role at the intersection of new customer acquisition and long-term partner success. This role is responsible for driving expansion through data-driven sales and marketing strategies, while ensuring the deep engagement, retention, and growth of existing school partners. By combining the outreach excellence of an Area Manager with the relationship depth of a Customer Success Manager, the Growth Manager ensures that LEAD's mission of excellent education for every child is delivered - from the very first demo to sustained, on-ground academic impact.
ROLES RESPONSIBILITIES
Build and manage a strong sales pipeline; deliver compelling demos and close high-value school partnerships.
Align LEAD solutions to school owner needs; negotiate contracts and ensure seamless onboarding.
Collaborate with marketing for lead generation and stay updated on competitor and industry trends.
Manage and nurture existing partner schools to ensure strong, long-term relationships and satisfaction.
Grow base business revenue through targeted upsell and cross-sell initiatives across the school portfolio.
Identify opportunities to improve school NPS; drive timely renewals and support admissions growth.
Support the Academic team in implementing academic processes effectively at partner schools.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding dues from partner schools.
Conduct training for teachers and staff; track implementation quality in coordination with Academic and Sales teams.
Maintain accurate CRM records, execute BTL campaigns, and share periodic progress reports.
EXPERIENCE
Educational Background:
Graduate in B.Tech, B.Com, B.Sc, or MBA.
Professional Experience:
46 years of experience in EdTech or other industries, particularly in B2B, institutional, or corporate solution sales.
Demonstrated top quartile performance with formal recognition.
Strong ability in sales pipeline management, lead generation, contract negotiation, and client onboarding.
5+ years in customer-facing roles in EdTech (field sales, account management, or key accounts).
Experience in collections, upselling, and school relationship management.
Fluent in local language and open to travel to partnered schools.
Graduate; MBA/BTech or math background preferred.
COMPETENCIES REQUIRED
Proficient in CRM tools, product pitching, stakeholder management, and academic solution selling.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; strong customer orientation and training ability.
High ownership, solutions-driven, and collaborative with strong interpersonal skills.
Curious, resilient, and tech-savvy; thrives in fast-paced environments with a proactive approach.

Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.

Role Overview
The Senior Resident General Surgery is a full-time, post-MS/DNB clinical and academic position in the Department of General Surgery of a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university. The role combines hands-on operative surgery, round-the-clock emergency and trauma care, ward and outpatient management, and structured teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of Department and works under the supervision of Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors, while supervising Junior Residents, interns and the unit's clinical team. The position bridges postgraduate training and an independent teaching-faculty career, building the Senior Residency experience recognised under National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations.

Work Mode
Work from hospital (on-site at the teaching hospital), duty days per NMC norms, including rostered on-call, night and emergency duties; no regular travel is expected.

Key Responsibilities
Perform elective general surgical procedures as primary surgeon or first assistant, including hernia repair, appendicectomy, cholecystectomy, and breast, thyroid and soft-tissue surgery, with consultant supervision as appropriate.
Manage acute surgical emergencies and polytrauma, including resuscitation, primary and secondary survey, emergency laparotomy and timely escalation to consultants.
Conduct surgical outpatient clinics, evaluating new and follow-up patients and planning investigations, conservative treatment or surgery.
Lead daily ward rounds, preoperative assessment and optimisation, and postoperative care, with early recognition and management of complications.
Obtain valid, documented informed consent and counsel patients and families on diagnosis, procedure, risks and expected outcomes.
Perform and assist in laparoscopic procedures, such as diagnostic laparoscopy, laparoscopic appendicectomy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy, progressively building minimal access skills.
Carry out bedside and minor procedures, including incision and drainage, biopsies, chest tube insertion, central venous access and suprapubic catheterisation.
Teach and assess MBBS students and postgraduate residents through bedside clinics, lectures, case presentations, skills-lab sessions and competency-based medical education (CBME) activities.
Supervise and mentor Junior Residents and interns, overseeing clinical decisions, handovers, duty rosters and logbook entries.
Maintain accurate and timely case records, operative notes, discharge summaries and medico-legal documentation in the hospital information system.
Apply and promote patient safety, infection prevention and control, the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, antimicrobial stewardship and accreditation standards.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology and other specialities for multidisciplinary care of complex surgical patients.
Contribute to clinical audits, morbidity and mortality meetings, journal clubs, research projects and publications of the department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MS (General Surgery) from an NMC-recognised institution, or DNB (General Surgery) awarded by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), recognised as per prevailing NMC regulations.
Permanent registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and eligibility to register with the Sikkim Medical Council.
Age within the NMC upper limit for Senior Residents in broad specialities, currently 45 years.

Required Experience
Experience range: 03 years of post-MS/DNB experience in General Surgery; freshly qualified MS/DNB General Surgery graduates are eligible. Preferred: 1–3 years as Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist in General Surgery at an NMC-recognised medical college or a tertiary-care multispeciality hospital. Relevant experience includes a documented operative logbook with procedures performed as primary surgeon, independent first-line management of surgical emergencies and trauma, and exposure to undergraduate teaching. Experience in high-volume emergency surgical services is valued.

Technical and Functional Skills
Open general surgery: inguinal and ventral hernia repair, appendicectomy, breast and thyroid surgery, excision of soft-tissue swellings and wound management.
Emergency surgery: laparotomy for perforation, obstruction and abdominal trauma, bowel resection and anastomosis, and stoma creation.
Minimal access surgery at basic to intermediate level: safe port placement, diagnostic laparoscopy, and laparoscopic appendicectomy and cholecystectomy.
Trauma care aligned with ATLS principles, including primary and secondary survey and bedside FAST interpretation.
Perioperative care: fluid and electrolyte balance, surgical nutrition, sepsis management, thromboprophylaxis and pain control.
Interpretation of ultrasound, CT, MRI and laboratory investigations for surgical decision-making.
Working knowledge of infection prevention and control, biomedical waste management, medico-legal procedures and hospital information systems.
CBME-based teaching, logbook supervision and formative assessment of students and residents.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Sound clinical judgement and composure under pressure; clear, empathetic communication with patients and families, including breaking difficult news; teamwork and leadership within the surgical unit; commitment to teaching and mentoring; ethical, professional conduct with medico-legal awareness; disciplined time management across clinical, academic and on-call duties; resilience during demanding rosters; and respect for a culturally diverse patient population.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
ATLS or an equivalent trauma course, and current BLS/ACLS certification; FMAS, FIAGES or other structured laparoscopic training; completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME); MRCS or FRCS examination progress; membership of the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI); thesis-based or indexed-journal publications and conference presentations; prior teaching experience in a medical college; and the ability to communicate in Hindi, with working knowledge of Nepali an advantage.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate trained at an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited teaching hospital with substantial elective and emergency surgical volumes, and shows a consistent academic record through MBBS and MS/DNB. Prior Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist tenure at a reputed government or private medical college or a tertiary-care hospital strengthens the application. The career trajectory should point towards academic surgery or a teaching-faculty role, with stable tenures and verifiable references.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is competitive and aligned with the candidate's qualifications, experience and institutional norms for Senior Residents. The role offers broad elective, emergency and teaching exposure in an academic setting. Leave, academic support and any other benefits follow institutional policy and NMC norms, and will be detailed at the offer stage.

Application Instructions
Send your updated resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – General Surgery", by email to careers@execvera.com, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include your MBBS and MS/DNB details, medical council registration number, a summary of your operative logbook, current employer and notice period in days, current and expected annual CTC in , and any certifications or publications. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and document verification.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Senior Resident

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Resident Medical Officer (Teaching Hospital)

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.
Must complete or be willing to complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) during the tenure.
Preference for candidates seeking to fulfill NMC-recognized SR experience for future Assistant Professor eligibility.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Forensic & Clinical Skills
Forensic sample collection & handling
Toxicology sample preservation & dispatch
Chain of custody maintenance
Mortuary supervision & safety
Post-mortem assistance & documentation
Medico-legal record keeping

Academic & Technical
UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Practical demonstration skills
NMC regulatory awareness
Medical documentation & reporting
Forensic laboratory procedures
Biomedical research basics

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Detail-oriented & organized
Ethical & professional conduct
Team collaboration skills
Composure in forensic environments

Job Summary
ATREE is seeking an Analyst to work closely with the Policy Lead to review, analyses, study, conduct consultations, and draft recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States.
You will be a key member of a team led by the Director -The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE to external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
Responsibilities
Support the Policy Lead in delivering the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including timely reporting and tracking of success indicators.
Review rangeland, forest, and agroforestry policies and identify opportunities to strengthen mountain-specific approaches across the three landscapes.
Support development and advocacy of state-level policy action plans on restoration and agroecology (Sikkim), OECM/CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Ladakh).
Support the Policy Lead in mapping key stakeholders in policy-making and comparing existing policies to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific needs across the three landscapes, keeping the analysis current.
Conduct FGDs, expert interviews, and workshops on mountain-specific policies, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and supporting equitable participation of women and marginalized groups.
