Job Summary
Lead - Policy
ATREE is seeking an experienced professional to lead reviews, analyses, studies, consultations, and recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States. The policy vision will be guided by global, regional, national, and state mountain policies from IHR.
You will be a key member of a versatile team led by the Director - The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE with external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
In the Himalaya, ATREE s strategy is to work towards a future where resilient mountain and downstream societies sustainably enjoy the natural endowment of the Indian Himalayan Region (IHR) while protecting and preserving its rich biodiversity. ATREE has developed a 10-year strategy called The Himalaya Initiative (THI), focused on the IHR amid increasing biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and climate change.
Project AMP-Himalaya is funded by the Rural India Supporting Trust (RIST), co-financed by Conservation International and Global Conservation, within the THI strategy, for a 5-year project period. The project aims to conserve biodiversity, restore landscapes, and foster human well-being in the Indian Himalayan Region. Three key areas prioritized to achieve the goal in the IHR are: 1) Assessment, Monitoring, and Conservation of Biodiversity; 2) Restoration of Multi-functional Landscapes; and 3) Nature-based Rural Livelihoods and Climate Change Resilience. Integral to these priorities are: creating digital knowledge commons to accelerate participatory management and local stewardship; strengthening human resources through training programs for local youth leaders and expanded environmental education opportunities; and creating conditions to develop and implement multi-level, mountain-specific policies that prioritize biodiversity conservation and natural resource management at scale.
The project is being implemented in 3 distinct landscapes located in 3 states and 1 union territory of IHR, namely: the Khangchendzonga Landscape covering the Darjeeling hills of North Bengal and Sikkim state; the Trans-Himalayan Landscape representing a high dependence on rangelands with agro-pastoral and pastoral systems in Ladakh; and Arunachal Pradesh with the largest, greenest, ethnically diverse and most biodiversity-rich landscapes.
Responsibilities
Develop and lead the roadmap and strategy, in collaboration with the THI Director, for the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including annual workplans, timely donor and project reporting, and tracking policy outcomes and success indicators.
Lead and drive the process of reviewing existing policies related to biodiversity, forests, rangelands, agroforestry, restoration, bioresource use, nature-based livelihoods, and climate resilience, including stakeholder mapping to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific policy approaches across the three project landscapes.
Develop and advocate state-level policy action plans across all three landscapes, restoration and agro-ecology (Sikkim), OECM and CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Trans-Himalaya, Ladakh), ensuring balanced policy engagement across landscapes.
Lead in conducting FGDs, expert interviews, and multi-stakeholder workshops, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and ensuring equitable participation of women and marginalized groups; use findings to flag policies/practices harmful to climate and ecosystem resilience and document successful mountain-specific case studies.
Develop and lead a roadmap for presentation of policy recommendations and briefing papers for key stakeholders for validation, and compile a comprehensive IHR policy report and toolkit for dissemination to stakeholders.
Create and lead the development of Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECM/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, partnering with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE for specialized legal drafting where required.
Develop and lead policy engagement and advocacy campaigns to raise awareness and strengthen capacity, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and the project s digital knowledge commons to align policy work with ongoing research, fellowships and knowledge generation.
Contribute to the learning and reporting plan; provide technical guidance to Policy Analysts and Consultants; coordinate with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
PhD in a related field, i.e., social sciences, environmental/natural sciences/natural resources management, public policy, law, economics, or a related interdisciplinary field.
A background in law, public policy, or economics is preferred in addition to the environmental/natural sciences; where specialized legal drafting is required (e.g., the Legal-Institutional Framework for OECMs/CCA), this will be carried out in partnership with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE.
Experience Required
5-6 years of professional experience in policy development and analysis, with substantial experience in mountain policy frameworks and a strong focus on the Himalaya.
Strong networking skills and demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Demonstrated understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to help ensure equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate teams, motivate colleagues and engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Experience working with nonprofits in the Conservation / Environment / Sustainability / Biodiversity space highly desirable.
Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across teams and geographies to deliver on a set of goals.
Strong organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills with the ability to motivate and lead small teams.
Desirable Skills
Working knowledge of international and regional mountain and biodiversity frameworks, including the CBD Global Biodiversity Framework, ICIMOD/Hindu Kush Himalaya frameworks, and UNFCCC/NDC processes.
Experience in grant management, resource mobilization, proposal writing, and donor engagement.
Experience using digital knowledge and communication tools, including data visualization and dashboards, to translate technical findings into accessible briefs and toolkits.

A Sales Advisor is responsible for delivering the best customer experience that contributes to the store s sales and profit. Previous experience within retail, merchandising and/or customer service.
Effective time management - being stress-resistant and good at prioritisation.
Have a customer service mindset where you always prioritise the customers needs while serving as a brand ambassador.
Being fashion knowledgeable and have a genuine interest in fashion trends.
Have a selling mindset with the ability to approach and fulfil customer needs.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Assistant Professor

Department Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super

Speciality Teaching Hospital,

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Assistant Professor in the Department of Dermatology, Venereology, and Leprosy will serve as a key teaching and clinical faculty member at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The role requires a committed medical professional capable of delivering quality undergraduate medical education while managing a robust clinical workload across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings. The incumbent will also contribute to research and publication activities as mandated by the National Medical Commission (NMC). This is an entry-level faculty appointment with strong scope for academic growth within the institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and clinical classes in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy as per university curriculum.
Conduct bedside clinical demonstrations, practical sessions, and case-based discussions for MBBS students and interns.
Participate in departmental seminars, journal clubs, and academic activities to foster a learning environment.
Assist in evaluation and assessment of undergraduate students including internal and university examinations.
Cover duties of other Assistant Professors when required to ensure continuity of academic programmes.

B. Clinical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots, ensuring evidence-based clinical care.
Provide comprehensive inpatient (IPD) dermatology care manage cases admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments.
Diagnose and manage common skin diseases, sexually transmitted infections, and leprosy cases.
Attend to emergency dermatology patients during assigned on-call duties.
Participate in scheduled Operation Theatre duties perform and oversee procedures and assist postgraduate trainees.
Maintain accurate clinical documentation and comply with hospital protocols, NABH standards, and patient safety requirements.

C. Research & Publications
Publish research articles in indexed journals as per current NMC requirements.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media on a regular basis.
Assist senior faculty and postgraduate students in ongoing research projects, data collection, and analysis.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe if not already completed.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in routine departmental administrative tasks and planning.
Participate in hospital quality improvement initiatives and NABH accreditation activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes and professional development activities.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the HOD or institutional authorities.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy from a recognized institution.

Teaching / Clinical Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a) One year as Senior Resident in Dermatology at a recognized medical institution; OR
Note: Tutor experience in a medical institution (with PG degree) is considered equivalent to Senior Resident experience; OR
(b) Armed Forces Specialist Medical Officer with at least 1 year teaching experience OR 2 years clinical experience post-PG qualification in the relevant specialty; OR
(c) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 2 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (Basic Course in Biomedical Research must be completed within 2 years of appointment); OR
(d) Diploma holders appointed as Senior Residents in a recognized medical institution before 08.06.2017, with total 4 years of SR experience; OR
(e) Diploma holders working as Specialist / Medical Officer in a government medical institution (NMC-recognised teaching programme) with cumulative 6 years of experience.

Professor - Department of Ophthalmology - Job Description

Department: Ophthalmology.

Employment Type: Full-time faculty position.

Role Overview
The Professor of Ophthalmology is a senior faculty position at a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university, uniting patient care, teaching and research. The role combines evidence-based general and subspeciality eye care with delivery of the Competency Based Medical Education (CBME) curriculum prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC). The Professor mentors junior faculty, residents and interns, guides postgraduate theses, and strengthens the department's research output and academic standing. The position reports to the Head of the Department of Ophthalmology, or to the Dean and Medical Superintendent where the Professor heads the department, as per institutional structure.
Work Mode

Work mode: Work from office, on-campus at the teaching hospital, with working days and on-campus attendance as per teaching hospital and NMC norms, including NMC-mandated faculty attendance recording. No routine travel requirement has been specified; occasional academic, examiner or community outreach duties may be assigned as per institutional needs.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) Ophthalmology teaching through lectures, small-group sessions, clinical postings and skills-lab training as per the NMC CBME curriculum, including AETCOM components.
Lead postgraduate training of MS Ophthalmology residents through seminars, journal clubs, case presentations, wet-lab sessions and supervised surgical training, where the programme is offered.
Guide and co-guide postgraduate theses, ensuring sound methodology, ethics committee approval and timely submission.
Perform and supervise cataract surgery, including phacoemulsification and manual small incision cataract surgery (MSICS), with documented outcomes and complication audits.
Manage general and subspeciality cases across glaucoma, retina, cornea, oculoplasty, paediatric ophthalmology, strabismus and neuro-ophthalmology, co-managing or referring as clinically appropriate.
Conduct outpatient clinics, inpatient rounds and ophthalmic emergency care, including ocular trauma, with accurate and complete clinical documentation.
Supervise and interpret ophthalmic diagnostics such as slit-lamp biomicroscopy, perimetry, optical coherence tomography (OCT), fundus imaging, biometry and B-scan ultrasonography.
Initiate, conduct and publish original research in indexed journals, and pursue intramural and extramural research funding.
Design and conduct formative and summative assessments, and serve as internal or external examiner for university examinations as assigned.
Ensure departmental compliance with NMC Minimum Standard Requirements, faculty norms and documentation for NMC and university inspections.
Mentor and appraise junior faculty, senior residents, postgraduate residents and interns to support their academic and professional growth.
Contribute to community eye-care activities aligned with the National Programme for Control of Blindness and Visual Impairment (NPCBVI), including screening camps where organised.
Uphold patient safety, infection control, informed consent and quality standards, and participate in clinical audits, morbidity reviews and accreditation activities.
Participate in institutional committees, continuing medical education (CME) programmes and departmental planning, including equipment and service development.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a recognised institution, with valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and registration with the State Medical Council of the work-location state as required by norms.
MS Ophthalmology, MD Ophthalmology or DNB Ophthalmology recognised by the NMC; DNB holders must meet NMC equivalence conditions for teaching appointments. A Diploma in Ophthalmology (DO) alone does not qualify for this position.
Eligibility for the post of Professor under the prevailing NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications (TEQ) regulations, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in Ophthalmology in an NMC-recognised or permitted medical college.
At least four research publications in indexed journals (PubMed/Medline, Scopus, Embase, Science Citation Index or DOAJ) as first, second, third or corresponding author, with at least two published as Associate Professor, as per NMC criteria.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and the Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME), as required by the NMC.

Required Experience
Experience range: 820 years of post-PG teaching experience in Ophthalmology in NMC-recognised or permitted medical colleges. Minimum: 8 years of post-PG teaching experience, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in Ophthalmology. Preferred: 12–20 years combining teaching, high-volume surgical practice and postgraduate thesis guidance; experience as Professor or Head of Department is an advantage. Relevant experience includes faculty roles (Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor) in medical colleges and university teaching hospitals; senior consultant service in NBEMS-accredited teaching departments of government institutions counts only where it meets NMC equivalence norms.

Technical and Functional Skills
Cataract surgery: phacoemulsification and MSICS, including complicated cataracts and management of intraoperative complications.
Glaucoma: gonioscopy, perimetry interpretation, trabeculectomy and laser procedures such as YAG peripheral iridotomy.
Retina: diabetic retinopathy and retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) screening, retinal laser photocoagulation and intravitreal injections.
Cornea and oculoplasty: infective keratitis and ocular surface disease, familiarity with keratoplasty, and lid, lacrimal (such as DCR) and ocular trauma procedures.
Diagnostics and other: paediatric, strabismus and neuro-ophthalmology evaluation; OCT, fundus photography, automated perimetry, biometry, B-scan ultrasonography and corneal topography.
Medical education: CBME delivery, competency-based assessment, logbook supervision, and skills-lab and wet-lab teaching.
Research: study design, biostatistics, ethics committee processes, Good Clinical Practice and scientific writing.
Regulatory: NMC Minimum Standard Requirements, TEQ regulations, inspection documentation and NPCBVI norms.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Academic leadership and the ability to build a cohesive, high-performing teaching department.
Clear, compassionate communication with patients, families and multidisciplinary teams.
Mentorship and constructive feedback for students, residents and junior faculty.
Ethical judgement, professionalism and sound decision-making in surgical and emergency settings.
Collaboration with other departments, administration and research teams, and effective time management across clinical, teaching and research duties.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Subspeciality fellowship (glaucoma, vitreoretina, cornea, oculoplasty or paediatric ophthalmology) from a reputed eye institute.
Prior experience as Head of Department or as a university-recognised postgraduate guide.
Advanced Course in Medical Education (ACME), Curriculum Implementation Support Program (CISP) training or a recognised medical education fellowship.
Funded research as principal or co-investigator, publications beyond the NMC minimum, and peer-review or editorial roles.
Experience preparing departments for NMC or university inspections, and membership of professional bodies such as the All India Ophthalmological Society (AIOS).

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate will show a progressive academic career from Senior Resident to Assistant Professor, Associate Professor and Professor (or eligibility for Professor) in Ophthalmology, with stable tenures in NMC-recognised medical colleges, university teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary eye-care institutes. Candidates from government, deemed-university and established private medical colleges with active postgraduate programmes are well suited. A consistent record of surgical volume, documented publications and postgraduate guidance is expected, and career gaps or frequent short tenures should be explained in the application.

Compensation and Benefits
The compensation package is competitive and commensurate with qualifications, academic seniority and experience, in line with norms for senior medical faculty. Benefits are as per institutional policy, within an academic environment that supports teaching, research and professional growth. Compensation details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Application Instructions
Send an updated CV mentioning the role "Professor – Ophthalmology" to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. The CV should list qualifications with year and institution, NMC or State Medical Council registration number, designation-wise teaching experience with dates, indexed publications with author position, BCBR and BCME completion, annual surgical volumes, theses guided, current and expected annual CTC in , and notice period in days. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

Description:
Job descriptionfor Food and Beverage On Job Trainee - Steward
A Food and Beverage On Job Trainee -Steward is responsible to assist the senior steward inensuring that the kitchen and dining areas are clean and well-organized, servingfood and beverages to guests, and guests' needs and requests are met promptlyand efficiently. On job trainee is responsible for ensuring that all necessarycutlery, crockery, and glassware are available to the guests. It is alsoexpected to learn and follow all health and safety guidelines, includingmaintaining personal hygiene, ensuring food is stored properly, and maintaininga clean and sanitary work environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Welcome the guests by greeting them asper the standards. Respond to customer queries by resolving issues in a timelyand efficient manner to ensure customer satisfaction.
Serving food and drinks: assist in servingfood and drinks to guests. This includes taking orders, delivering food totables, and ensuring that guests have everything they need.
Learning the facilities of the hotel /casino and the daily events and functions in order to satisfy guest enquiries.
Handling guest requests andcomplaints: handle guest requests and complaints. This includes addressing anyissues they may have and providing them with a satisfactory solution.
Learning and following safety andhygiene procedures: required to learn and follow safety and hygiene proceduresto ensure that the kitchen and dining areas are safe and sanitary for guestsand staff.
Learning and following companypolicies: learn and follow the company policies and procedures, including thoserelated to dress code, attendance, and customer service standards.
Attend training sessions to learn new skills and improve existing ones.
Qualifications:
Min HSSC pass, diploma or equivalent required; additional training or certification in food service or hospitality may be preferred.
Strong knowledge of food service operations, including hygiene and sanitation practices.
Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem solving skill with the ability to prioritize tasks.
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Throughout training period, on job trainee will be supervised byexperienced stewards or captains, who will guide in performing dutieseffectively and efficiently. Hence performance will be evaluated regularly, andwill be provided with feedback and support to help to improve skills andknowledge. Overall, the role of an on-the-job trainee steward in the food andbeverage service department is an important one that requires attention todetail, excellent customer service skills, and a strong commitment to teamworkand collaboration.

Description:
Role: Consultant Nephrologist

Organization Overview
This position is with a nationally accredited, 500-bed, multi-super speciality teaching hospital located in a major regional capital city. Established decades ago, the facility stands as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region, housed in a nine-storied structure with over 300,000 square feet of floor space. The institution is academically affiliated with a prominent, decades-old University renowned for excellence in medical education and healthcare.

The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 13 general specialities, multiple super-speciality departments, and 12 dedicated operation theatres. It provides comprehensive 24x7 services, including a fully equipped trauma care unit and advanced diagnostic imaging featuring 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64-slice CT scan, and digital X-ray facilities. Critical care capabilities are extensive, supported by 46 well-equipped ICU beds (covering ICU, SICU, NICU, PICU, CCU, and ITU) and round-the-clock emergency services.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Nephrologist to join our team as a Clinical Practitioner. The successful candidate will manage the diagnosis and treatment of kidney-related diseases, providing expert care to inpatients and outpatients. While the role is primarily clinical and does not require an extensive academic portfolio, the institution places a high priority on candidates who possess relevant work experience within recognized university or medical college hospital settings.

Key Responsibilities
Clinical Management: Provide comprehensive clinical care for patients with acute and chronic kidney diseases, electrolyte imbalances, hypertension, and other renal disorders.
Dialysis Services: Oversee and manage the Dialysis Unit, which is equipped with modern hemodialysis machines (currently 8 units, including isolation facilities) and expertise in Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD).
Critical Care Nephrology: Collaborate with the intensive care team to manage complex cases requiring renal replacement therapy (CRRT, SLED) in the 46-bed ICU setup.
Patient Consultation: Conduct regular outpatient consultations, providing holistic treatment plans that include lifestyle modification and dietary guidance in coordination with nutritionists.
Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with General Medicine, Cardiology, Urology, and other specialities to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to patient care, particularly for diabetic and hypertensive nephropathy.
Procedures: Perform necessary nephrological procedures such as renal biopsies and placement of temporary vascular access for dialysis.
Quality Assurance: Adhere to national accreditation standards (NABH protocols) and hospital policies to ensure the highest quality of patient safety and care delivery.

Qualifications and Experience
Essential Post-Graduate Qualification: M.D. or DNB in General Medicine or Paediatrics from a recognized institution.
Required Super Speciality Qualification: D.M. in Nephrology (Recognized by the National Medical Commission) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience: 1 to 4 years of experience post-completion of the super specialization (D.M.) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience Preference: Crucially, priority will be given to candidates who have gained their experience in recognized university or teaching hospital settings.
Note: Experience is strictly counted only after the completion of the super specialization.

Compensation
Salary Range: INR 3.5 Lakhs to INR 4.5 Lakhs per month.
Determination: Final offer will be commensurate with the candidate's specific post-DM / M.Ch experience and expertise.

Additional Information
Nature of Role: This is a full-time Clinical Practitioner position.
Academic Profile: While an academic profile (publications, research) is not mandatory, the clinical expertise gained in an academic environment is highly valued.
Facility Highlights: The selected candidate will practice in a facility that acts as a tertiary care referral centre for the entire state and neighbouring regions, backed by comprehensive support services including a 24-hour central laboratory and blood bank.

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - General Surgery is an early-career faculty and clinical role combining undergraduate teaching, supervised postgraduate training, patient care, operative practice, academic contribution, and departmental service. The position reports to the Head of the Department of Surgery and supports safe, evidence-informed surgical care across outpatient, inpatient, emergency, and operation-theatre settings. A NABH-accredited tertiary teaching hospital integrating patient care, undergraduate education, postgraduate training, research, and multidisciplinary surgical services. The appointee is expected to model professional conduct, strengthen learner competence, contribute to service continuity, and accept responsibilities assigned within the scope of General Surgery.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver structured undergraduate lectures, tutorials, demonstrations, and case-based sessions aligned with the approved curriculum and departmental teaching plan.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes using bedside, outpatient, ward, skills-laboratory, and discussion-based methods while protecting patient dignity and consent.
Assess learner progress through appropriate formative and summative activities, provide actionable feedback, and maintain accurate academic records as assigned.
Manage scheduled outpatient consultations by obtaining focused histories, examining patients, planning investigations, documenting decisions, and arranging follow-up or admission when indicated.
Evaluate inpatients admitted under the assigned unit, review clinical progress, coordinate treatment plans, and respond promptly to referrals from other departments.
Attend emergency surgical patients during rostered on-call periods, support timely stabilization and escalation, and document assessment, consent, treatment, and handover decisions.
Perform and assist surgical procedures within demonstrated competence, granted privileges, institutional protocols, and the supervision arrangements applicable to the case.
Attend assigned operation-theatre schedules, complete preoperative preparation, participate in operative decision-making, and ensure appropriate postoperative review and continuity of care.
Supervise postgraduate trainees in theatre and clinical areas, matching responsibility to competence while maintaining patient safety and accountable faculty oversight.
Coordinate multidisciplinary care with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology, nursing, rehabilitation, and other specialties when patient needs require collaborative management.
Maintain complete, timely, and confidential clinical documentation and follow applicable requirements for infection prevention, surgical safety, quality assurance, ethics, and incident reporting.
Cover the defined duties of other Assistant Professors during approved leave, subject to departmental rosters, clinical competence, workload, and safe service arrangements.
Develop accurate public-education articles on surgical health topics for approved media channels, using evidence-based language and appropriate institutional review processes.
Undertake other academic, clinical, administrative, research, quality-improvement, and departmental responsibilities assigned by the Head of Surgery within the role's lawful scope.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical institution recognised for registration and practice in India.
MS in General Surgery or DNB in General Surgery from a recognised awarding body, with equivalence documentation where applicable.
Eligibility for appointment as Assistant Professor under the Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, 2025 and subsequent applicable NMC directions.
Current, valid registration with the National Medical Commission or the relevant State Medical Council, with no unresolved restriction affecting the proposed duties.
Documentary evidence supporting qualifications, registration, experience, appointments, relieving dates, and the specific NMC eligibility pathway claimed.

Required Experience
Minimum experience: The candidate must meet an applicable NMC Assistant Professor pathway. Under the standard pathway, this includes 1 year as Senior Resident in General Surgery in a recognised medical institution after the relevant postgraduate qualification. Candidates relying on another permitted pathway must provide complete evidence satisfying the conditions attached to that pathway; institutional verification remains mandatory.

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - Forensic Medicine & Toxicology is a full-time academic faculty position responsible for teaching, assessment, medico-legal practice, research, and departmental service. The role supports undergraduate MBBS students, postgraduate medical students, and interns through competency-based instruction, supervised practical learning, and reliable academic evaluation. Reporting to the Head of Department, the incumbent will contribute to autopsy services, expert opinions, court duties, curriculum delivery, and institutional responsibilities. The position requires sound professional judgment, ethical conduct, accurate documentation, and the ability to connect forensic principles with clinically and legally relevant practice.

Key Responsibilities
a. Deliver structured lectures, practical demonstrations, tutorials, seminars, and supervised training for MBBS, postgraduate medical students, and interns.
b. Design teaching schedules, lesson plans, learning resources, competency maps, and assessment activities aligned with the approved curriculum and applicable NMC standards.
c. Conduct medico-legal autopsies and related examinations within authorized scope, maintaining accuracy, dignity, biosafety, evidence integrity, and complete contemporaneous records.
d. Prepare clear post-mortem reports, medico-legal opinions, certificates, and advisory inputs for authorized public authorities when formally required.
e. Attend court proceedings, present impartial medical evidence, explain findings within professional competence, and maintain secure case documentation.
f. Develop and administer internal assessments, practical examinations, viva voce evaluations, university examinations, feedback processes, and remediation plans.
g. Guide student research, dissertations, presentations, and scholarly projects while ensuring ethical approval, methodological rigor, and responsible research conduct.
h. Undertake independent and collaborative research, contribute to publications, and participate in seminars, webinars, conferences, workshops, and continuing professional development.
i. Maintain the departmental museum, specimens, displays, registers, inventories, teaching aids, and associated documentation in accordance with safety and ethical requirements.
j. Coordinate assigned departmental activities, academic records, accreditation evidence, timetables, examination duties, and other responsibilities delegated by authorized institutional leadership.
k. Complete or maintain applicable faculty-development requirements, including biomedical research and medical-education training prescribed by current regulations or institutional policy.
l. Uphold confidentiality, impartiality, chain-of-custody controls, professional ethics, infection prevention, quality systems, and respectful interprofessional collaboration.

Required Qualifications
MBBS and MD/DNB in Forensic Medicine and Toxicology from institutions and programmes recognized for faculty eligibility under current National Medical Commission requirements are mandatory. The candidate must hold active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or NMC-recognized registration authority, as applicable. DNB candidates must satisfy any additional teaching-equivalence or Senior Residency requirement applicable to the awarding institution and prevailing regulations. All degrees, registrations, experience records, and equivalence documents must be valid and independently verifiable.

Required Experience
The minimum requirement is one year of qualifying post-PG experience in the concerned subject, normally as a Senior Resident in a recognized medical institution, or another pathway expressly recognized under current NMC regulations. Recognized alternatives may include eligible postgraduate Tutor experience, qualifying Armed Forces experience, or qualifying government-hospital service, subject to documentary verification and the conditions prescribed for that pathway. Candidates should demonstrate relevant exposure to medical teaching, medico-legal autopsy work, report preparation, court processes, and departmental administration. A total of 2-4 years of relevant post-PG teaching or medico-legal experience is preferred.

Technical and Functional Skills
The role requires working knowledge of forensic pathology, toxicology, thanatology, medical jurisprudence, autopsy technique, injury interpretation, preservation and dispatch of samples, chain of custody, medico-legal documentation, expert opinion, and courtroom testimony. The candidate should be able to apply competency-based medical education, curriculum planning, student assessment, feedback, research methodology, ethics, scientific writing, and basic biostatistical interpretation. Proficiency with presentation software, digital learning platforms, academic records, literature databases, and routine office applications is expected.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Essential behaviours include integrity, impartiality, discretion, attention to detail, calm decision-making, clear written and oral communication, and respect for legal and ethical boundaries. The incumbent must teach complex or sensitive material with maturity, collaborate effectively with students, clinicians, administrators, laboratory teams, law-enforcement personnel, and judicial stakeholders, and manage competing academic and medico-legal priorities. Reliability, empathy, cultural sensitivity, accountability, and commitment to continuous learning are central to success.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Preference may be given to candidates who have completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and relevant medical-education or faculty-development training; have verifiable publications, conference presentations, or student-guidance experience; and have handled court testimony, curriculum development, university examinations, accreditation documentation, or museum curation. Training in research ethics, good clinical practice, educational technology, simulation, or quality improvement will strengthen the candidature.

Professional Tenure and Background
An appropriate career path includes MBBS, recognized postgraduate specialization in Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, and qualifying post-PG experience. The preferred profile offers 2-4 years of relevant exposure in recognized medical colleges, teaching hospitals, authorized medico-legal services, or other institutions accepted under current NMC pathways. Progressively responsible teaching, autopsy, court, research, assessment, and departmental assignments are valued.

Compensation and Benefits
The appointment offers competitive, role-aligned compensation and faculty benefits governed by institutional policy, qualifications, verified experience, and internal parity. Applicable benefits and any professional-development, conference, or research support will be communicated during the selection process.

Application Instructions
Applicants should submit a curriculum vitae, qualification certificates, registration proof, eligibility and experience records, publication list, and verifiable evidence of teaching, autopsy, court, research, and academic administration. Applications must be accurate and complete; eligibility and experience will be verified.

Job Title: Head of Department (HoD) Psychology (Professor/Associate Professor)

Role Overview
The Head of the Department of Psychology will provide visionary leadership to build a high-impact, industry-relevant, and research-driven department. The role requires balancing academic rigor with innovation, student employability, and institutional growth, while ensuring compliance with UGC norms and alignment with NEP 2020.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic & Academic Leadership
Develop and execute a growth strategy for the department (new programs, student intake, branding)
Design industry-aligned curriculum (e.g., clinical practice, organizational psychology, behavioural data science, counselling)
Introduce value-added certifications and interdisciplinary courses
Drive NAAC/NIRF rankings contributions and accreditation readiness

2. Program Development & Innovation
Integrate technology in psychology (e.g., psychometrics tools, data analytics, AI applications in behaviour studies)

3. Faculty Leadership & Talent Building
Implement performance-driven culture (KPIs: teaching quality, publications, student feedback, placements)
Mentor faculty for research output, consulting, and executive education

4. Research, Consulting & Revenue Generation
Build a research and consulting ecosystem (corporate training, assessments, mental health services)
Secure funded projects, consultancy assignments, and collaborations
Establish labs/centres (e.g., Behavioural Lab, Counselling Centre)
Promote publications in Scopus/Web of Science indexed journals

5. Student Outcomes & Employability
Ensure strong placement and internship pipelines (Hospitals, NGOs, EdTech, corporates)
Develop career-oriented training (soft skills, psychometric testing, counselling skills)
Track and improve student success metrics (placements, higher education, certifications)

6. Industry & Institutional Partnerships
Build MoUs with hospitals, corporates, NGOs, schools, and wellness centers
Organize guest lectures, workshops, and live projects
Promote international collaborations and exchange programs

7. Administration & Operations
Manage departmental budgets with a focus on ROI and efficiency
Ensure smooth academic operations, timetabling, and compliance
Handle student grievances and maintain discipline
Contribute to university committees and strategic initiatives

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications
B.A/B.Sc & MA/M.Sc in psychology & Ph.D. in Psychology (mandatory, as per UGC/AICTE norms)
Minimum 815 years of experience in teaching/research/industry
At least 3–5 years in academic leadership roles (HoD/Program Head/Coordinator)
Strong research and publication record

Key Skills & Competencies
Leadership with a focus on growth and revenue generation
Strong networking and industry engagement skills
Ability to balance academic quality with market relevance
Data-driven decision-making and innovation mindset

Description:
Subham Safety Solutions is looking for Marketing Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
As a digital marketing manager, your role is to develop, implement, and manage marketing campaigns that promote a company's products or services through digital channels
Here are some key responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the role:
Strategy Development: Formulate digital marketing strategies aligned with the overall marketing goals and objectives of the company
Identify target audiences and develop customer personas to inform campaign planning
Campaign Planning and Execution: Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across various channels such as search engine marketing (SEM), search engine optimization (SEO), social media, email marketing, content marketing, display advertising, and more
Coordinate with internal teams or external agencies to create and optimize campaign assets
Content Marketing: Develop and manage a content marketing strategy that includes creating and distributing valuable, relevant, and consistent content to attract and engage the target audience

Social Media Management: Manage social media accounts, create engaging content, and interact with followers to build brand awareness and drive user engagement
Monitor social media trends, track metrics, and analyze data to optimize social media marketing efforts
Email Marketing: Plan and execute email marketing campaigns, including designing email templates, writing compelling copy, segmenting email lists, and analyzing campaign performance
Use marketing automation tools to optimize email workflows and increase conversions
Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve the company's organic search rankings
Conduct keyword research, optimize website content, perform technical SEO audits, and monitor website analytics to identify opportunities for improvement

Description:
Role Overview
The Librarian will be responsible for the overall management, development, digitisation, and effective utilisation of the University Library and its learning resources. The role goes beyond the traditional management of books and circulation. The Librarian is expected to develop the library as a student-centric Learning Resource Centre that actively supports teaching, research, skill development, employability, innovation, and lifelong learning. The Librarian will ensure that physical and digital resources are easily accessible, appropriately organised, effectively utilised, and continuously aligned with the academic programmes and evolving requirements of Medhavi Skills University.
Key Responsibilities
A. Library Administration & Operations
Manage the day-to-day functioning of the University Library and associated learning/resource facilities.
Develop and implement library policies, SOPs, circulation procedures, membership norms, and operating guidelines.
Ensure systematic acquisition, accessioning, classification, cataloguing, shelving, circulation, and preservation of library resources.
Maintain accurate records of books, journals, periodicals, newspapers, reports, reference materials, and other resources.
Ensure efficient issue, return, renewal, reservation, and recovery of library materials.
Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation of library resources.
Maintain appropriate systems for damaged, lost, obsolete, and withdrawn materials.
Ensure appropriate library timings based on student s and academic requirements, including during examinations and other high-demand periods.
B. Digital Library & Technology
Develop and strengthen the University s digital library ecosystem.
Manage e-books, e-journals, research databases, institutional repositories, online learning resources, and other digital subscriptions.
Ensure effective implementation and utilisation of the Library Management System (LMS/ILMS).
Facilitate remote and campus-based access to digital learning resources wherever applicable.
Promote awareness and usage of digital databases and online academic resources among students and faculty.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-enabled search, research and knowledge management tools, to enhance library services.
Maintain accurate digital catalogues and ensure easy discoverability of resources.
C. Academic & Student Support
Work closely with Heads of Schools, Programme In-Charges, faculty members, and academic teams to understand programme-specific resource requirements.
Ensure availability of textbooks, reference books, journals, case studies, reports, and digital resources required for different programmes.
Conduct library orientation programmes for newly admitted students.
Train students in effective use of catalogues, databases, e-resources, research platforms, and credible online information sources.
Support students in literature searches, assignments, projects, presentations, research, and academic referencing.
Develop initiatives to improve reading habits and library utilisation among students.
Organise book displays, reading campaigns, author interactions, knowledge sessions, quizzes, book reviews, and other library engagement activities.
D. Faculty & Research Support
Assist faculty and researchers in identifying relevant books, journals, databases, reports, and research materials.
Support literature review, reference management, citation practices, and information retrieval.
Facilitate awareness of research databases, open-access resources, institutional repositories, and scholarly publications.
Support the development and maintenance of an institutional repository for research papers, publications, reports, projects, dissertations, and other academic outputs, as applicable.
Coordinate with academic teams for continuous improvement of programme-wise library resources.
E. Acquisition & Resource Development
Prepare annual and periodic plans for acquisition of books, journals, databases, and other learning resources.
Collect recommendations from faculty, Schools, and academic departments.
Evaluate resource requirements based on curriculum, student strength, programme requirements, usage patterns, and applicable regulatory norms.
Coordinate with publishers, vendors, distributors, and service providers for procurement and subscriptions.
Support comparative evaluation and cost-effective procurement of library resources in accordance with University policies.
Monitor subscriptions and ensure timely renewal of essential databases, journals, magazines, and digital resources
F. Compliance, Accreditation & Documentation
Maintain all library documentation required for statutory, regulatory, accreditation, audit and quality-assurance purposes.
Support the University in documentation and data requirements relating to UGC,

Description:
Program Associate - District Coordination

Position Overview
The Program Associate will provide strategic and operational support to the District Administration, ensuring effective coordination and convergence among relevant departments across the assigned district and blocks.

Roles and Responsibilities
Conduct situational assessments and district-level gap analyses to identify challenges in child protection.
Undertake vulnerability mapping and facilitate the linkage of vulnerable children and families with appropriate central and state government welfare schemes.
Strengthen the functioning of child protection systems and institutions.
Support the protection and rehabilitation of children affected by child marriage, child trafficking, child labour, and other forms of exploitation.
Assist the District Administration in inspecting child protection institutions and schools to ensure compliance with applicable laws, standards, and safeguarding protocols.
Organize capacity-building workshops for government officials, frontline workers, and relevant stakeholders.
Conduct awareness and sensitization workshops at district and block levels on child protection issues, including child marriage, child labour, child trafficking, and child sexual abuse.
Facilitate interdepartmental coordination and convergence among stakeholders working on child protection.
Track progress on key indicators related to education, health, nutrition, and child protection to support timely corrective action.
Support data-driven planning, monitoring, and decision-making processes.
Document key learnings, insights, and best practices to improve programme implementation and outcomes.

Education and Experience
Graduate with 1 to 2 years of relevant work experience; or
Postgraduate/Masters degree with up to 1 year of relevant work experience.

Required Skills
Strong commitment to child protection and welfare initiatives.
Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
Analytical thinking and practical problem-solving abilities.
Fluency in the local language(s) spoken in the assigned community will be preferred.

Description:

An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing. Key Responsibilities : Property Maintenance : Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks. Ensure the property is clean, well - maintained, and aesthetically pleasing. Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities. Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly. Financial Management : Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance. Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records. Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost - effective services. Security and Safety : Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants. Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary. Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures. Tenant and Guest Relations : Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner. Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively. Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction. Staff Management : Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff. Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Administrative Tasks : Maintain accurate records of property - related activities, contracts, and expenses. Role Overview:
Medhavi Skills University is seeking a dynamic Senior Manager Placements to lead the university s corporate engagement and student placement strategy at the Sikkim campus. This leadership role will be responsible for building strong industry partnerships, managing the placement team, and ensuring high-quality placement opportunities for students through strategic recruiter engagement. He will be responsible for getting all eligible
students placed.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage the Campus Placement & Corporate Relations team to achieve placement goals.
Define KPIs, performance targets and accountability structures for the placement team.
Monitor team performance through regular reviews and ensure timely achievement of placement milestones.
Mentor team members and strengthen internal systems for effective placement management.
2. Industry Partnerships & Corporate Outreach for Placements
Develop and expand long-term partnerships with corporates, recruiters and industry bodies across sectors.
Identify and establish new recruitment partnerships for internships and final placements by frequent visits to Companies, Organizations PAN India.
Actively engage with industry leaders to position the university as a preferred talent sourcing partner.
Maintain strong relationships with existing recruiters to ensure recurring hiring engagements.
3. Placement Strategy & Performance Monitoring
Develop and implement the annual placement strategy for the campus.
Monitor placement progress across programs and ensure achievement of placement targets and quality benchmarks.
Establish systems for data-driven monitoring of placement performance, including placement dashboards and reports.
Provide periodic insights and updates to university leadership on placement outcomes.
4. Stakeholder Management
Work closely with academic leadership and faculty to align student skills with industry requirements.
Coordinate with internal teams to strengthen student employability and career readiness initiatives.
Ensure effective communication between students, recruiters, faculty, and the placement team.

Represent the university in corporate meetings, industry forums, and networking platforms.
Promote the university s talent pool to attract high-quality recruiters and hiring partners.
Strengthen the university s reputation as an industry-aligned institution with strong placement outcomes.
Qualifications & Skills Required:
Master s degree in Management, HR or related field.
8-12 years of experience in placements, corporate relations or industry partnerships.
Mandatory: Prior experience managing placements in universities or higher education institutions at least 3-5 years.
Proven experience in building corporate partnerships and managing recruitment engagements.
Candidates should be proficient in: Corporate relationship management
Team leadership and performance monitoring
Strategic planning and execution
Stakeholder management
Strong networking and negotiation skills
Data-driven monitoring and reporting

What We Offer
Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.
Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
A collaborative, mission-driven environment.
The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

A technical procurement specialist supports various business lines to identify, shortlist, select, and acquire suitable goods or services or works from a third-party vendor through a direct purchase while ensuring timely delivery of the right quality and quantity. Primary Responsibilities
Work closely with the operations teams to understand procurement requirements details and request vendor quotes.
Participate in the new vendor approval process.

Analyze technical and commercial information from SMEs required to create vendor service POs.

Determine the timing of placing orders for goods based on required dates and lead times.
Develop strong relationships with key suppliers and measure suppliers performance based on cost, quality, delivery, and service level.
Analyze the market to identify opportunities to expand the vendor base.
Determine vendors based on established criteria, negotiate the organization s purchasing agreements/contracts, and ensure their materials and products meet the company s specifications.

Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal

Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines

Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings

Description:
1. Job Purpose
To drive the growth of the Bed & Bath home linen business in Delhi NCR by strengthening the distribution network, driving secondary sales through appointed distributors, developing relationships with retailers and furnishing dealers, and expanding market penetration. The role will be responsible for establishing a strong market presence for Arvinds Home Linen products and achieving assigned sales and business development targets.


2. Key Responsibilities
A. Sales & Business Development
Drive primary and secondary sales of Bed & Bath products across the assigned territory.
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the Delhi NCR market.
Develop new business opportunities and expand the customer base across relevant sales channels.
Identify potential retailers, furnishing dealers, home dcor outlets, and institutional customers.
Implement sales strategies and promotional activities to increase product visibility and market share.
B. Distributor Management
Support the appointment, onboarding, and development of distributors in Delhi NCR.
Ensure effective distributor management to achieve sales targets and improve market coverage.
Drive secondary sales through regular engagement with distributors and their retail networks.
Monitor distributor inventory, stock availability, order fulfilment, and product assortment.
Review distributor performance periodically and take corrective actions to address sales gaps.
C. Market Development & Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with furnishing dealers, retailers, distributors, and other channel partners.
Leverage existing industry relationships to develop new accounts and strengthen business opportunities.
Conduct regular market visits to understand customer requirements, competitor activities, pricing, and emerging market trends.
Identify new market segments and opportunities for expanding the Bed & Bath product portfolio.
Ensure effective product placement, visibility, and availability at retail outlets.
D. Sales Planning & Execution
Prepare territory-wise sales plans and customer coverage plans aligned with business objectives.
Track sales performance against targets and implement action plans to address shortfalls.
Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, product availability, dispatches, and customer service.
Support the execution of product launches, trade schemes, and promotional campaigns.
Ensure timely collection of market feedback and communicate customer expectations to the relevant internal teams.
E. Reporting & Business Review
Maintain regular records of primary and secondary sales, distributor performance, market coverage, and customer development.
Submit periodic sales reports, market intelligence, and competitor updates to the reporting manager.
Monitor receivables and coordinate with distributors and internal teams for timely collections.
Participate in periodic business reviews and recommend actions to improve sales, distribution, and profitability.

Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Senior Smartsheet & Power BI Developer
The Senior Smartsheet & Power BI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise-wide Smartsheet solutions and Power BI analytics platforms to automate workflows, improve collaboration, enhance project/program management, and deliver actionable business insights. This role focuses on building executive-grade dashboards and reports, integrating Smartsheet with Power BI, and enabling data-driven decision-making through advanced reporting, automation, and system integrations.
Key

Roles & Responsibilities
Smartsheet Solution Development & Automation
Design, develop, and maintain scalable Smartsheet solutions utilizing Sheets, Workspaces, Reports, Forms, Dashboards, Dynamic Views, WorkApps, Pivot App, Functions, and Advanced Formulas.
Create automated workflows for approvals, notifications, reminders, status updates, and data validations using Smartsheet Automation.
Develop cross-sheet references and rollup solutions to consolidate project, program, and portfolio data into centralized views.
Build and optimize enterprise-wide project tracking, resource management, governance, and operational reporting solutions.
Configure Dynamic Views and WorkApps to deliver role-based access and personalized user experiences.
Design and implement governance standards, templates, and best practices for Smartsheet adoption.
Power BI Development & Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive leadership and business stakeholders.
Develop complex data models, DAX measures, KPIs, scorecards, and drill-through analytics using Power BI.
Create executive-level visualizations for project health, resource utilization, financial metrics, operational performance, and program governance.
Develop and optimize Power BI datasets, semantic models, and reporting frameworks for enterprise-scale analytics.
Implement Row-Level Security (RLS), workspace governance, and data refresh strategies.
Smartsheet - Power BI Integration
Integrate Smartsheet data with Power BI using native connectors, APIs, dataflows, and ETL pipelines.
Design automated data ingestion processes to combine Smartsheet data with enterprise systems such as SharePoint, SQL Server, Azure, Salesforce, and other business applications.
Build consolidated reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth across multiple business functions.
Develop data transformation and cleansing processes using Power Query, Power BI Dataflows, and ETL tools.
Integrations & Technical Enablement
Develop integrations using Smartsheet REST APIs, webhooks, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and middleware platforms.
Connect Smartsheet with Microsoft ecosystem tools including SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Outlook, and Excel.
Support implementation of third-party connectors and integrations with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, and other operational systems.
Troubleshoot and optimize dashboard performance, data refreshes, data models, and workflow automations.

The ideal candidate combines deep BTP operations experience with a solid Basis background and can work across cloud and on-premise SAP.
Responsibilities
SAP BTP Administration (primary focus)
Set up and govern the BTP global account structure: directories, subaccounts, and naming and tagging standards across development, test and production.
Manage entitlements, quotas and cost tracking, and raise capacity requests in line with project demand.
Administer Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces and Kyma environments, including deployments, service instances and runtime health.
Manage identity and access: trust configuration with SAP Cloud Identity Services and corporate identity providers, role collections, role templates and least-privilege access reviews.
Configure and maintain connectivity: Destinations, Cloud Connector setup and high availability, and private connectivity to on-premise systems.
Administer SAP HANA Cloud instances, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Build and Work Zone as required by the customer landscape.
Manage BTP transports and content movement through Cloud Transport Management.
Monitor services, audit logs and alerts; set up and maintain BTP audit log retention.
Maintain the BTP CLI and automation scripts for repeatable provisioning and housekeeping.
SAP Basis Administration (secondary)
Perform day-to-day Basis administration across development, test and production systems.
Handle system monitoring, performance tuning and optimization for ABAP and HANA systems.
Manage user administration, security, authorizations and transport management between systems.
Plan and execute OSS note implementation, BDLS, system copies, client copies and refreshes.
Support SAP HANA upgrades and perform post-upgrade checks.
Provide Basis expertise during project cutovers and ensure stability through critical transition periods.
Database Administration (secondary)
Administer database instances supporting SAP systems, including backup and recovery, space management and housekeeping.
Monitor database performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, and tune configurations.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Maintain database security, access controls and disaster recovery procedures, and test them periodically.
Communication and Documentation
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, changes, runbooks and procedures.
Communicate with project teams, stakeholders and end users, and provide regular status and health reports.
Work with customers to define BTP governance, onboarding and operating models.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in SAP technical administration, with at least 4 years in SAP BTP administration.
Hands-on experience with BTP global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry and role-based access control.
Experience with Cloud Connector, Destinations and connectivity to on-premise SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, CRM, SCM).
Strong working knowledge of SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA, including HANA Cloud.
Solid SAP Basis experience: monitoring, transports, user administration, OSS notes, BDLS, system copies and HANA upgrades.
Working knowledge of database administration for SAP-supported databases (backup, recovery, performance and patching).
Familiarity with cutover processes and Basis support during critical project phases.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently and lead a team.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BTP certification (for example, SAP Certified Technology Associate, SAP BTP) or SAP Basis certification.
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Integration Suite.
Experience with Kyma, Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for BTP.
Scripting skills in Shell, Python or the BTP CLI.
Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks.
Experience with hyperscaler landscapes (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) under BTP.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Junior Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

demands superior analytics acumen to identify areas / facilities which require extra emphasis on
training. The Manager Training will research, design, develop, deliver, and evaluates training
initiatives that promote people capabilities throughout the organization. This role also monitor the
effective roll out of training via 300+ Ops Coaches in the network.

by the organization.

preparation and/or other logistics related items. Ensures training records are maintained.

more relevant to the business objective.

improve the performance of Ops facilities First Mile, Middle Mile, Last Mile, Returns, FTL Ops, LTL
Ops, Fulfillment Ops.

learner performance and engagement. Work with team to enact any needed improvements or
changes needed.

8. Communicates with key stakeholders to obtain knowledge and understanding of business needs
and operations.

groups.

Position Summary:
The Security Officer acts as the operational lead at the site level, responsible for implementing security procedures, supervising guard personnel, coordinating with clients, and ensuring all security and safety standards are consistently met. This is a critical leadership role that bridges field operations and client expectations.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Command and Control:
Function as the second-in-command or site head (depending on site size).
Lead and monitor all security operations at the designated client site.
Ensure guards follow all post duties, site-specific instructions (SSIs), and G4S protocols.
2. Team Supervision:
Supervise the deployment and performance of Security Supervisors and Guards.
Conduct daily muster, uniform inspection, and tool checks.
Address absenteeism, disciplinary issues, and performance shortfalls.
3. Client Coordination:
Serve as the primary point of contact for the client at the site.
Conduct regular meetings with client representatives to address concerns or updates.
Ensure client satisfaction through prompt issue resolution and quality service delivery.
4. Operational Execution:
Ensure access control systems, patrolling routines, visitor management, and asset protection are functioning as per SOP.
Monitor surveillance systems and review CCTV footage in coordination with client security teams.
Supervise material movement, vehicle access, and contractor/staff entry protocols.
5. Incident Management:
Act promptly in case of incidents like theft, fire, medical emergencies, or safety violations.
Guide guards during emergencies and implement evacuation protocols as needed.
File detailed incident and investigation reports with photographic/log support.
6. Documentation & Reporting:
Maintain daily shift logs, occurrence reports, visitor data, and material movement records.
Prepare and submit weekly performance summaries and manpower deployment reports.
Ensure all statutory registers (muster rolls, PF, ESI) are updated and audit-ready.
7. Training & Compliance:
Conduct on-the-job training, drills, and refreshers for site guards.
Ensure adherence to G4S grooming, behavior, and discipline standards.
Support HR and compliance teams during audits, inspections, or client reviews.
