The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities

• Design and implement microservice-based applications using Python and
frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.

and code quality improvements.

Azure/AWS/GCP (PaaS and IaaS).
• Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate
models.
• Follow best practices for security and documentation.
Requirements:
• 6+ years as a full stack or backend developer with proficiency in Python; fair to
strong experience with JavaScript frameworks/libraries (Angular, React).
• Strong software development skills across design, development, testing,
deployment, and maintenance of large-scale applications.
• Experience with RESTful APIs, asynchronous request handling, and ORM.
• Ability to build feature rich full stack AI integrated applications.
• Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data storage solutions; data
processing/manipulation and bulk data operations.
• Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD.
• Working experience deploying to Azure, AWS, or GCP.
• Strong unit testing and debugging skills; strong experience with version control (Git).
• Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, multimodal
applications, agentic frameworks (fundamental level).
• Experience with data/ML frameworks and tools (PyTorch, LangChain, Autogen).
• Strong in data structures, architecture, and design; familiarity with Python threading
limitations and multi-process architecture.
• Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills; adherence to
security practices.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and cloud-native/serverless patterns (Azure
Functions, AWS Lambda).
• Experience exposing GenAI capabilities via APIs and embedding AI-driven UIs in
Angular/React.
• Experience with observability and basic telemetry for AI applications.
Good To have:
Certifications in AI/ML, Deep Learning and NLP from Learning platforms such as Coursera,
Udemy or equivalent.
Certifications on Cloud Architecture (GCP/Azure/AWS)
Experience building MCP servers or Agent to Agent applications.
Fine tuning LLMs and Hosting LLMs on Premises

Responsibilities

- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience

- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).
3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.
4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)
Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.
5. Document Generation
Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.
6. Salesforce Data Modelling
Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.
7. Salesforce Design & Configuration
Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)
8. Apex Development
Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.
9. Code Quality & Reviews
Run structured code reviews.
Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.
10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership
Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.

2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.

Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.

Job Summary
We are seeking a talented NICE CXone Support Engineer / Administrator with experience in NICE CXone Contact Center Platform, Studio, IVR, Routing, Agent Administration, Production Support, and Contact Center Operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for platform administration, troubleshooting, call flow management, incident resolution, and ensuring smooth operation of inbound and outbound contact center services.
Key Responsibilities
NICE CXone Administration
Administer and support the NICE CXone platform in production environments.
Create and manage users, agent profiles, teams, skills, campaigns, queues, and business units.
Configure roles, permissions, access controls, and user assignments.
Perform platform configuration changes based on business requirements.
Maintain platform availability, stability, and performance.
Contact Center Operations Support
Perform daily platform health checks and monitoring activities.
Monitor inbound and outbound contact center operations.
Troubleshoot platform, routing, telephony, and agent-related issues.
Ensure adherence to SLAs and operational standards.
Act as primary support contact for production incidents and service requests.
NICE CXone Studio & IVR Development
Create, modify, test, and maintain NICE CXone Studio scripts.
Develop and support IVR call flows based on business requirements.
Configure routing strategies, skills-based routing, and queue logic.
Validate script changes and routing configurations before production deployment.
Support call flow enhancements and optimization initiatives.
Incident Management & Troubleshooting
Analyze Studio traces and logs to identify root causes of routing failures.
Investigate call-flow issues, disconnected calls, and unexpected routing behavior.
Resolve production incidents related to agents, queues, campaigns, and telephony.
Troubleshoot MAX Agent login, session, connectivity, and performance issues.
Coordinate with telecom, networking, and infrastructure teams for issue resolution.
Voice & Telephony Support
Investigate voice quality issues, call drops, latency, and call-routing incidents.
Troubleshoot SIP and telephony-related issues impacting contact center operations.
Support inbound, outbound, callback, and blended contact center environments.
Validate voice configurations following platform changes and deployments.
Testing & Validation
Perform end-to-end testing of inbound and outbound call flows.
Validate routing behavior after configuration changes and production releases.
Support SIT, UAT, and Production testing activities.
Document test results and deployment validations.
Monitoring & Reporting
Monitor contact center performance and operational metrics.
Generate operational reports and dashboards.
Track incidents, service requests, and problem tickets.
Provide recommendations for process improvements and operational efficiency.
Documentation & Knowledge Management
Maintain SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge-base documentation.
Document troubleshooting procedures and platform configurations.
Participate in knowledge-transfer sessions and team training activities.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening

Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Job Title: Manager Strategy Consulting (Corporate Deals Technology)
Department: PwC Acceleration Center – Strategy Consulting
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview:

Join PwC’s Corporate Deals Technology (CDT) team to partner with global corporate clients and drive technology strategy that fuels business value and deal success in complex M&A transactions. Our CDT practice leverages deep industry knowledge and thought leadership to deliver consulting services focused on the technology elements of the value chain, enabling scalable and profitable business transformations.
As part of the Strategy platform, CDT supports corporate clients across industries by:

Developing M&A Technology Strategies for integrations, separations, carve-outs, and divestitures through collaboration with C-suite executives.
Conducting Technology Due Diligence to assess IT landscapes, identify risks, and uncover value creation opportunities.
Advising on Integration and Divestiture Planning to align technology strategies with business and operational goals.
Designing Future-State Technology Models and Architectures that support strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities:
As a Manager, you will lead a team of experienced consultants solving complex business challenges from strategy through execution. Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and supporting teams across the deal spectrum, including IT due diligence, integration, and separation activities.
Managing project delivery, guiding teams, and engaging in client and leadership communication.
Overseeing solution design and implementation, ensuring high quality deliverables within timeline and budget.
Planning and developing integration and separation plans covering Day One readiness, business process, and systems alignment.
Developing financial models related to IT synergies, one-time costs, standalone operations, and stranded costs.
Recommending enterprise architecture, solutions, and systems informed by industry best practices and past experience.
Advising on IT integration, separation, and carve-out strategies across various IT domains.
Mentoring and coaching senior associates and associates to consistently deliver impactful work.
Contributing to business development initiatives by identifying and researching opportunities with new and existing clients.
Building strong internal relationships and strengthening your personal brand within PwC.

Preferred Knowledge & Skills:

Must-Have:

Proven experience in IT M&A including IT due diligence, integration, separation planning, and execution.
Expertise in IT Strategy and Digital Transformation initiatives.
Technical proficiency in key IT pillars such as Application Rationalization, Infrastructure/Cloud Strategy, Cybersecurity, and ERP Transformation.
Demonstrated ability to lead large teams through end-to-end client engagements.
Strong project management, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Solid data and cost modeling capabilities.
Proficiency in leveraging Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) for efficient research and analysis.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Senior Manager – Human Resources (Corporate and Plant)
Lead end-to-end human resources, industrial/employee relations, statutory compliance, talent acquisition, and administration across both corporate offices and manufacturing/plant locations.
Reporting To: VP / Head of HR and Corporate Leadership
Key Focus: Aligning plant workforce productivity, blue-collar/white-collar management, and statutory laws with broader corporate goals.
Key Responsibilities
1. Plant & Blue-Collar / Staff HR Operations
F Manage end-to-end workforce planning, budgeting, recruitment, selection, onboarding, and deployment for both permanent and contractual/blue-collar labor.
F Monitor key plant metrics including absenteeism, attrition, overtime, workforce costs, and productivity.
F Oversee plant administration, security agencies, canteens, transport, and facility vendors.
2. Industrial Relations (IR) & Employee Relations
F Handle labor and industrial relations, worker grievances, disciplinary proceedings, domestic enquiries, and dispute resolution.
F Foster harmonious workplace relations, manage union/workmen interactions (where applicable), and support long-term settlement or negotiations.
F Act as an escalation point for employee relations and grievance handling across corporate and plant tiers.
3. Statutory Compliance & Legal Risk Management
F Ensure strict adherence to labor laws and statutory regulations (e.g., Factories Act, PF, ESI, Contract Labour Act, Payment of Wages Act, etc.).
F Coordinate labour inspections, statutory audits, and liaise with government and local regulatory authorities.
4. Talent Acquisition & Management (Corporate & Plant)
F Drive recruitment funnels from sourcing to joining for corporate roles and plant staff/shop-floor positions.
F Implement performance management systems (PMS), training and competency development plans, and succession planning.
F Support Corporate HR and L&D teams in rolling out organizational development and employee engagement initiatives.
5. Payroll Inputs & MIS Reporting
F Oversee monthly attendance, time-office data, and payroll inputs in coordination with Finance and Corporate HR.
F Prepare and present monthly HR Management Information Systems (MIS) dashboards, tracking KPIs, headcount budgets, and cost-reduction targets.

1. MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Personnel Management, or Industrial Relations (specialization in Labour Welfare is a strong plus with 10–18 years of progressive HR experience, with a blend of corporate HR and manufacturing/plant HR exposure.
2. Strong mastery of local labor legislation and statutory compliance.
3. Proficiency in HRMS, payroll systems, and MS Excel/MIS reporting.
4. Knowledge of HR technology and systems
5. Hands-on experience with blue-collar/contractual workforce management and industrial dispute handling.
6. Negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership.
7. Experience with applicant tracking systems and recruitment
8. Superb verbal and written communication abilities
9. Display proficiency in juggling multiple tasks and meeting multiple deadlines.
10. History of success in recruitment, problem-solving, and employee development
11. Ability to build strong relationships with all levels of management
12. Strong strategic thinking skills and the ability to drive change
13. Commitment to fostering employee engagement and satisfaction.

Description:
SAP RAR Consultant - Operations Support (Offshore)

Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Pune / Chennai/Hyderabad/ Bangalore
Role Type: AMS / Production Support


Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP Revenue Accounting & Reporting (RAR).
Handle incident management, problem resolution, and service requests.
Support end-to-end revenue recognition processes aligned with ASC 606 and IFRS 15.
Monitor and resolve issues related to:
Revenue Contracts
Performance Obligations (POBs)
SSP Allocation
Contract Modifications
Revenue Postings
Perform month-end, quarter-end, and year-end revenue close activities.
Reconcile and validate revenue accounting results.
Support integration between SAP RAR and SAP S/4HANA modules (FI, CO, AR, GL).
Troubleshoot data, posting, and reconciliation issues.
Maintain RAR configurations including business rules, account determination, and revenue recognition settings.
Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Accounting, Business, and IT teams.
Support SIT, UAT, enhancements, defect fixes, and release activities.
Prepare operational documents, RCA reports, and knowledge articles.
Drive process improvements and automation initiatives.

Must-Have Skills
SAP S/4HANA RAR (Revenue Accounting & Reporting)
SAP FI Integration (GL, AR)
Revenue Recognition & Revenue Reconciliation
AMS / Production Support experience
L2/L3 Support expertise
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Stakeholder management and communication skills

Preferred Skills
ASC 606 and IFRS 15 knowledge
SAP BRIM integration experience
Subscription Billing / SaaS business exposure

Ideal Candidate Profile
5-10 years of SAP experience with strong SAP RAR support expertise.
Hands-on experience supporting revenue accounting processes in production environments.
Good understanding of finance accounting concepts and revenue recognition standards.
Experience working with global stakeholders and managing critical support incidents.
Ability to independently analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex RAR issues.

Establish scalable delivery frameworks, SOPs, and governance models

Drive effective resource planning, utilization, and capacity forecasting

Track delivery KPIs, SLAs, and financial performance (margin, cost, productivity)

Lead client reviews, QBRs, and governance calls
Manage expectations, change requests, and long-term engagement growth
Partner with Sales/Presales for solutioning and transition of new projects
4. Team Leadership & Capability Building
Lead and mentor Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross-functional leads
Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability and outcomes
Drive capability development in instructional design, digital content, and learning technologies
Set performance goals and career paths for delivery teams
5. Process Excellence & Quality
Define and enforce delivery standards, quality frameworks, and review mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement using metrics, retrospectives, and automation
Implement tools and best practices in project tracking, collaboration, and reporting
Ensure compliance with client, data security, and process standards

6. Financial & Operational Ownership
Own delivery P&L levers: effort estimation, cost control, margin optimization
Improve productivity through process optimization and AI-enabled workflows where applicable
Support budgeting, forecasting, and revenue realization
Qualifications & Experience:
Bachelors degree
15–20 years of experience in Project / Program / Delivery Management
Digital learning / eLearning development
Curriculum and content production workflows
Proven experience managing large teams (30–100+) and multi-million-dollar portfolios
Experience working with global clients
Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models
Key Competencies
Strategic delivery leadership
Executive stakeholder management
Program & portfolio governance
Risk & escalation management
People, leadership, and talent development
Data-driven decision making
Operational excellence mindset

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP-BODS-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, asking questions, and using these moments as opportunities to grow. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS to provide advisory services, design data migration solutions, and support data cleansing activities.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
- Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration needs and challenges
- Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
- Managing data migration processes, including building, testing, and executing migrations with SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
- Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing requirements
- Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
- Developing data models and performing data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating technical specification documents for data services jobs based on migration experience and programming knowledge
- Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools like Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
- Providing advisory services to clients on data management strategies and techniques
- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration from source systems to S/4 HANA
- Building and maintaining client relationships to understand and address their data management needs

Role: Area Sales Manager
Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.
Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).
Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Description:
JOB OVERVIEW


We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML
Certifications:
BillingPlatform Partner Essential Certification (L1)
BillingPlatform Partner Pro Certification (L2)
BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to drive business transformation initiatives, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. You will engage with executive stakeholders, delivering large-scale digital transformation programs that optimize revenue operations and support enterprise growth.

As a Senior Manager, you will guide cross-functional teams, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to solve complex problems. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting impactful messages, validating outcomes with clients, and navigating challenging situations with composure. You will also contribute to practice development through thought leadership initiatives and capability building.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on implementing Oracle lead management and customer experience solutions, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Your leadership in project management, delivery governance, and stakeholder communication will drive successful project milestones and enhance delivery efficiency.

Responsibilities

- Leading the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle
- Translating complex business requirements into scalable and secure Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry practices
- Managing end-to-end implementation programs, including project planning, solution design, configuration, development, and deployment
- Engaging with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and provide strategic recommendations
- Overseeing the development of integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP
- Driving business transformation initiatives by leveraging functional, technical, and consulting skills
- Facilitating workshops and performing fit-gap analysis to develop scalable solution designs
- Contributing to practice development through pre-sales, capability building, and thought leadership initiatives
- Building and maintaining billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, and revenue-related processes
- Validating solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle and managing project risks and dependencies
- Leading business discussions with customers to discover requirements and deliver technical solutions
- Confirming compliance with architectural standards and driving successful milestone execution through proactive communication

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Lead-to-Revenue or related Oracle Customer Experience (CX) Revenue Cloud applications
- Possessing BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
- Demonstrating proficiency in API, SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, and XML
- Leading large-scale digital transformation programs in finance operations
- Excelling in client-facing communication and stakeholder engagement
- Developing scalable solution designs aligned with industry best practices

Payroll configurations

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles

Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience

Description:
Role & responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced SAP Change Management Lead to govern SAP changes, releases and transports across the landscape, ensuring controlled delivery, business continuity and compliance with ITIL, SOX and security requirements.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Change Management:
Oversee and manage SAP system changes, ensuring they align with business and compliance requirements.
Define and implement change control processes for SAP applications.
Work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and third-party vendors to evaluate, approve, and schedule changes.
Release Management:
Develop and manage the SAP release calendar to ensure seamless deployment of changes.
Plan and coordinate SAP upgrades, patches, and enhancements.
Ensure proper documentation and testing for all releases to minimize disruptions.
Governance & Compliance:
Ensure adherence to IT policies, regulatory requirements, and SAP best practices.
Implement ITIL-based change and release processes, ensuring compliance with audit and security policies.
Manage risk assessments and impact analyses for all SAP changes.
Collaboration & Communication:
Act as a liaison between business, IT, and SAP functional teams to coordinate change implementations.
Provide regular updates and reports on change and release activities to leadership and stakeholders.
Drive continuous improvement in SAP change and release management processes.

Required Skills & Leadership Capabilities

SAP Change Tools: Hands-on experience with SAP Solution Manager ChaRM and Rev-Trac for change control, workflow, approvals, audit trail and release governance.
Transport Management: Strong knowledge of SAP Transport Management System, transport sequencing, dependency management, import coordination, conflict resolution, retrofit and emergency transports.

You may also interact with other departments like Primary Engineering, Secondary engineering, Project Management and Production units.
Project Planning and coordination with various internal external stakeholders for a smooth project execution.
Preparation of Design calculation (in Staad. Pro, Idea-static Hilti profits) of Steel Support Structures for Gas Insulated Switchgears above 66kV. (Contribution to Tekla modelling will be mandatorily required in certain projects).
Ensure all necessary inputs are available from stakeholders.
Prepare project specific Civil plan for customer providing GIS loading for design of customer building floor, ceiling cranes etc., Influence of environmental conditions on GIS structure designs etc.
Self-review peer review of documents.
Delivery of designs on time with Quality and coordinating with the other team members and project lead engineer.
Directly responsible for maintaining and updating the documentation for respective projects as per quality process.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your background:
Years of experience: 8 - 10 years with B.E/M.E. in Civil Structural Engineering.
Hand on experience in Structural engineering using STAAD. Pro, Idea-static, Ansys Hilti Profits software's.
Hand on experience in Tekla, Navisworks and other modelling software's.
Familiarity with codes and applicable standards necessary for Structural Modelling Detailing (American, European, Canadian etc.) is Mandatory.
Team player with good communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge tools like AUTOCAD, MS Office etc.
Knowledge of Galvanization painting procedures.
Knowledge of HSE standards like OSHA, DIN etc.. is mandatory.
Knowledge of international standards such as IEC/ IEEE / ANSI is preferable.
Knowledge of HV substation / HV products preferable.
Working knowledge of Tekla structures is an added advantage.

Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus
A proven track record of moving rankings, traffic and leads, with case studies to show

KPIs:
Organic traffic and qualified leads from search
Rankings for priority keywords (India and GCC)
Brand mentions and citations in AI answer engines
Featured snippets and AI Overview inclusions
DA/DR and growth in high-quality backlinks
Measurable visibility gains for customer accounts

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.

The Role:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding 
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth 
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Job Description
Job Description
This role requires > 8 years of experience working in the areas of pesticide/agrochemical formulation development and able to work in the formulation lab.
Lead the development of Crop Protection formulations
To formulate, generate scientific / technical data using established systems, procedures, and protocols in an area of work delegated by the manager.
Define the experimental programme that include the development of new pesticide formulations, procedures/standards.
To interpret data in order to make contributions to decisions in the work programme content, procedures, or problem solution.
Engages directly with other functions to co-ordinate delivery of project outputs (e. g. product biology, regulatory, procurement team, engineering team, packaging etc) with the support of a leader.
Report on work, including recommendations to project team or sub-project team leader.
Participate in regional and global technical / project teams
Will represent the formulation development work/status at every developmental stage to global peer review team and adhere to project timelines.
ACCOUNTABILITIES
To plan, organise and carry out the work programmes at the laboratory, semi-technical, pilot plant or manufacturing scale to design novel pesticide formulation options in order to:
Prove the suitability for progression through Stage C and D Evaluation and Development
Provide Product Chemistry type and or supporting data, and
Provide the formulation design input required to define the process equipment and quality assurance requirements to timescales and specifications agreed with the team or group leader.
Ensure the quality of Evaluation and Development formulations by arranging for biological efficacy, toxicology, and hazard assessment studies to be carried out in other Functions.
Provide advice and recommendations to allow appropriate selection of formulation manufacturing sites for individual products, together with the product design inputs required to define the process equipment and quality assurance requirements.
To interpret and represent to project members external to the function, experimental data and report results and conclusions obtained both orally and in written form to allow cogent and timely Stage C and D project decisions, Regulatory submissions and accurate information archiving and transfer for future commercial manufacturing activities.
To ensure that work by the job holder and subordinate staff comply with Syngenta standard operating procedures and statutory regulations (e. g. GLP or similar).
To ensure that the jobholder and subordinate staff work safely and healthy with due care for others, so that compliance with Syngenta s HSE Policy is achieved.
To invest in personal and professional development and growth, undertaking, where appropriate, training and development activities and ensuring familiarity with new research and literature.
Ensure maintaining complete confidentiality of all Syngenta intellectual property.
Interact with the global formulation community in order to better solve common problems and to define improved processes Qualifications
Qualifications
KNOWLEDGE EXPERIENCE and CAPABILITIES:
Critical knowledge and experience
Master s degree in Pesticide/Agrochemical chemistry must/preferable from reputed universities with strong academic records and good communication skills with > 8 years of industrial experience in field of pesticide formulation development as a formulation development chemist preferred.
Thorough knowledge of pesticides, pesticide formulation types and techniques required in formulation development.
Sound understanding of agrochemical formulations / Coformulations / Fillers is a must
Critical technical, professional, and personal capabilities
Ability to efficiently build up laboratory works and experiments
Ability to effectively participation in- and contribute to regional / global multi-functional teams
Ability to deliver to agreed timelines
Excellent operational, organisational, interpersonal and computer skills
Sensitive to different cultural environments
Self-motivating
Critical leadership capabilities
Communicative

This role will involve taking a lead role in the development of new formulations by generating potential formulation options through the design of appropriate experimental work programs to thoroughly optimise and test these according to the formulation development process.
This will include the analysis of experimental data in order to make inputs to the decisions on the direction of the work programmes within the project.
The job holder will need to have experience of different formulation types as well as a full range of broader requirements in formulation development such as product application, manufacturing processes, etc.

Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities.

Description:
The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers.
Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel.
This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness.
This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons.
As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization.
This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel.
Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
Required:
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Hotel Marketing and Advertising
- Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.
- Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.
- Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.
- Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.
- Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups
- Executes email marketing, and display advertising.
- Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.
- Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.
Social Media Content Management
- Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites).
- Develops and executes promotions campaign in F&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.
- Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.
Public Relations and Visual Asset Management
- Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM.
- Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.
- Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.
- Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.
- Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.
- Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy & activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives.
- Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution.
- Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s).
- Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.
- Supports the co-ordination of photography for F&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.
- Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.
- Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice.
Direct Marketing and Collateral Development
- Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials.
- Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.
- Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.
- Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.
- Manages the execution of F&B direct marketing activities.
- Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).
General
- Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F&B promotions and campaigns.
- Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s).
- Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.
- Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F&B promotions.
- Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.
- Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy.
- Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.
- Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance.
- Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.
