Job Description: Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: AVP Commercial

Department: Stores & Inventory Management

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores to lead inward storekeeping, engineering spares custody, consumable inventory, and yard storage operations at our Paonta Sahib manufacturing facility.

The AGM Stores will hold full operational ownership of inventory custody, storage optimization, material issuance, scrap segregation, and system stock reconciliation. The role requires close coordination with Plant Production, Maintenance, Quality, and Central/Local Procurement to eliminate production downtime caused by material shortages, maintain 100% stock accuracy in the ERP system, and implement robust material handling, preservation, and internal audit controls.


Key Responsibilities
1. Inward Logistics & Material Receipt
Direct gate entry verification, weighbridge reconciliation, unloading, and staging for all incoming consignments:


Raw Materials: Stainless steel melting scrap, ingots, billets, HR/CR master coils, and raw pipe shells.

Consumables & Spares: Refractories, mill rolls, lubricants/cutting oils, electrical/mechanical spares, pickling acids/chemicals, grinding wheels, and packaging materials.

Manage the Goods Receipt Note (GRN) workflow in ERP, ensuring physical inspection, chemical/physical test clearance from Quality Control (QC), and vendor delivery challan reconciliations are completed within defined turnaround times.

Coordinate rejected material handling, debits, vendor return gate passes, and replacement follow-ups in close coordination with Local and Corporate Procurement.

2. Inventory Control & ERP Reconciliation
Maintain real-time stock ledger accuracy across all plant sub-stores (Raw Material Yard, Engineering Spares Store, Consumables Store, Scrap Yard).

Enforce Min-Max levels, Reorder Points (ROP), and Safety Stock levels for critical plant operational spares and consumables to prevent stockouts while optimizing working capital.

Conduct continuous cycle counts, monthly reconciliations, and bi-annual/annual full physical stock verifications alongside Internal and Statutory Audit teams; investigate and resolve book-to-physical variances.

Categorize and review inventory using ABC, VED, and FSN analyses; identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete (SLOB) items with concrete salvage or liquidation plans.

3. Material Storage, Preservation & Issuance
Design and implement scientific warehouse layouts, 5S standards, racking systems, bin allocation, and barcode/QR identification tags across all storage bays.

Ensure proper preservation of critical spares, sensitive instrumentation, and materials against weather, rust, acid fumes, or physical handling damage.

Supervise disciplined material issuance against approved Material Requisitions / Job Orders on a FIFO (First-In, First-Out) basis.

Manage hazardous material storage (pickling acids, industrial gases, furnace oils) ensuring mandatory safety measures, MSDS adherence, and spillage containment protocols.

4. Scrap Yard Management & Returnable Material Tracking
Oversee collection, segregation, and weighment of production process scrap (shearing scrap, end-cuttings, rolling scale, rejected mother pipes) and maintain heat-wise/grade-wise scrap accounting for furnace remelting or disposal.

Track Returnable Gate Passes (RGP) and Non-Returnable Gate Passes (NRGP) for plant equipment, rolls, and spares sent out for machining, calibration, or motor rewinding, ensuring strict adherence to return timelines.

5. Team Leadership & System Audits
Lead and supervise storekeepers, yard supervisors, crane operators, forklift drivers, and material handlers.

Enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all shifts, ensuring zero safety incidents during heavy lifting and yard handling.

Provide routine Management Information System (MIS) reporting on stock valuation, non-moving inventories, pending GRNs, and consumption trends to the GM Commercial and Corporate Management.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Science (B.Sc), Commerce (B.Com), or Engineering (Diploma/B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgy).

Post-Graduate Diploma / MBA in Materials Management or Supply Chain Management is preferred.

Experience:


1216 years of hands-on stores and warehouse management experience in heavy manufacturing, with at least 35 years at a Senior Manager / Manager level.

Essential industry background: Steel Melting Shops (SMS), Stainless Steel Rolling Mills, Tube/Pipe Mills, or Heavy Engineering Fabrication.

Technical & System Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP MM module, Oracle SCM, or TallyPrime).

In-depth knowledge of inventory management methodologies (ABC/VED/FSN, FIFO, 5S, Kaizen).

Solid understanding of weighbridge operations, metallurgical grade differentiation, and traceability marking systems.

Key Competencies:


High personal integrity and strict adherence to internal audit controls.

Strong team supervision and contractor-labor management skills.

Detail-oriented tracking of incoming consignments and rigorous stock reconciliation discipline.

D. Receivables Payables

Job Description: AVP Commercial
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: Director Plant

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is seeking an experienced, proactive, and commercially astute AVP Commercial to head commercial operations at our manufacturing facility in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh.

The GM Commercial will oversee plant accounting and financial controls, inventory and store operations, local procurement, logistics, and commercial statutory compliance. The role acts as the primary operational bridge between the manufacturing plant and the Corporate Head Office in New Delhi, ensuring cost efficiency, seamless supply chain execution, rigorous internal controls, and statutory compliance.


Key Responsibilities
1. Plant Accounts & Financial Controls
Direct and monitor day-to-day plant accounts, cost accounting, billing, invoicing, and petty cash management.

Oversee stainless steel manufacturing cost accounting (yield, conversion costs, scrap reconciliation, and power/fuel consumption).

Ensure strict internal financial controls, conduct regular internal audits, and coordinate with statutory auditors.

Manage plant-level GST, TDS, e-Way bills, TCS, and ensure timely filing in close coordination with the Corporate Finance team in New Delhi.

Monitor plant operational expenditures (OPEX) and capital expenditures (CAPEX), preparing monthly variance analyses against approved budgets.

2. Stores & Inventory Management
Oversee comprehensive store operations across raw materials (SS scrap, ingots, billets, flats, coils), consumables, spare parts, rolls, refractories, and finished goods (pipes, coils, flats).

Implement rigorous systems for material receipt (Gate Pass, Weighbridge, Inspection/GRN), issue, and bin card tracking.

Conduct periodic physical inventory audits, reconciliation against ERP/books, and minimize inventory shrinkage or carrying costs.

Identify and manage non-moving, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; establish scrap handling and disposal protocols.

3. Local Procurement & Vendor Management
Formulate and execute local procurement strategies for mechanical and electrical spares, refractories, consumables, oils/lubricants, packaging materials, and general site services.

Evaluate local vendor proposals, negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment schedules, and delivery timelines to optimize working capital.

Implement vendor evaluation metrics, fostering reliable local supplier networks while enforcing vendor compliance.

Coordinate with Central Corporate Procurement (New Delhi) for high-value raw material intake, ensuring smooth site delivery schedules.

4. Logistics, Dispatch & Weighbridge Commercial Operations
Supervise inbound raw material arrivals and outbound dispatches of finished flats, coils, and pipes.

Exercise commercial control over weighbridge operations, tare/gross weight verifications, and freight audits.

Manage transporter contracts, freight negotiation for local movements, vehicle turnaround times, and transit compliance.

5. Head Office Coordination & Reporting
Act as the nodal contact at the Paonta Sahib unit for all commercial matters directed from the Corporate Office in New Delhi.

Prepare and submit regular Management Information System (MIS) reports, including daily fund requirements, monthly commercial MIS, inventory valuations, and cost-variance reports.

Align plant commercial targets and working capital requirements with corporate business goals.

6. Commercial Statutory Compliance
Ensure adherence to state and central commercial regulations, including GST compliance, e-Way billing rules, and tax documentation.

Monitor commercial documentation related to interstate dispatches, raw material transit permits, and statutory commercial records.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Commerce (B.Com) / Inter CA / Inter ICWA / MBA in Finance or Operations / B.Tech with an MBA. Full CA / ICWA (CMA) qualification is an added advantage.

Experience:


1520+ years of proven commercial management experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 57 years in a senior leadership role (DGM/GM).

Direct experience in Steel Manufacturing, Stainless Steel, Rolling Mills, Tube Mills, or Heavy Industrial Fabrication is highly preferred.

Technical Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, or TallyPrime).

Strong mastery of GST, indirect taxation, inventory accounting, and Excel-based financial reporting.

Competencies:


Strong commercial negotiation and contract management skills.

Strong leadership with the ability to manage commercial, accounts, and stores teams.

Clear, structured communication skills for multi-location reporting and commercial coordination.

Job Description:- General Trade.

Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Location: Shimla, Himachal Pardesh
Reporting To: National Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment
Based at: State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) State Programme Management Unit (SPMU) office
Project Duration: 3 Years (annual contract, renewable based on performance and availability of funds)
Background
HelpAge India, in partnership with DAY-NRLM and participating SRLMs, is implementing a multi-state pilot to integrate elderly care, active ageing, and community-based caregiving within the Food, Nutrition, Health, and Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (FNHW) framework. The initiative aims to build scalable, community-led elderly inclusion systems through SHG-VO-CLF platforms, strengthen government convergence, and develop caregiving cadres and care economy approaches. To support state-level implementation, a Project Manager- Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will be positioned within the respective SRLM SPMU.
Purpose
The State Project Manager - Elderly Inclusion Empowerment will provide state-level technical, operational, and coordination support for implementing the Operational Framework under the MoU between HelpAge India and the respective SRLM. The role includes integrating elderly-focused interventions within SRLM systems, strengthening implementation across pilot districts and blocks, facilitating government convergence, and supporting institutionalisation within DAY-NRLM, while guiding district/block teams, community institutions, and caregiving cadres to deliver agreed programme outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Programme Coordination and Implementation: Lead coordination and implementation of the Operational Framework across pilot districts and blocks, ensuring alignment with state plans and the HelpAge India-SRLM MoU.
Coordination Engagement: Act as the key liaison between HelpAge India and SRLM, coordinating across state, district, and block levels, and driving convergence with relevant departments.
Technical Support Capacity Building: Develop and deliver guidelines, tools, and trainings; strengthen elderly inclusion, caregiving systems, and integration of ESHGs within NRLM platforms.
Monitoring Reporting: Track progress, conduct field visits, and lead reporting, evaluations, and documentation of programme outcomes.
Community Systems Convergence: Strengthen Elders Self Help Groups (ESHGs), community caregiving systems and enable elderly access to entitlements, health, social protection, and livelihoods through stakeholder convergence.
Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.
Requirements
Desired Qualifications, Competencies Experience
Masters degree in Social Work, Rural Development, Development Studies, Public Health or related disciplines.
Minimum 4 - 6 years of relevant experience in rural livelihoods, SHG promotion, social inclusion, public health or community development programmes.
Prior experience of working with SRLMs, NRLM institutional platforms or large-scale government programmes will be preferred.
Experience in programme coordination, capacity building and stakeholder engagement.
Understanding of elderly inclusion, social protection, community caregiving or FNHW-related programmes will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, coordination and documentation skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.
Strong programme coordination and facilitation skills.
Ability to work with government systems and community institutions.
Good training and mentoring abilities.
Strong analytical, reporting and documentation skills.
Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multi-stakeholder implementation processes.

Product Development - RD
Function: Research Development / Product Development
Experience: Minimum 8 years
Reporting To: Mandeep (AGM - NPD)
Location: Gagret
Company: Luminous


Key Responsibilities
Prepare battery layouts, assembly drawings, component drawings and detailed manufacturing drawings.
Support Design and develop flooded tubular lead-acid batteries for inverter, solar, industrial and other deep-cycle applications.
Design and optimize components such as containers, lids, terminal arrangements, handles, vent plugs, gauntlets, grids, spines, straps and associated parts.
Develop accurate 2D drawings and 3D models using AutoCAD and Creo.
Define critical dimensions, tolerances, materials and technical specifications.
Maintain drawing accuracy, revision control and standardization across product families.
Convert product requirement specifications into design concepts and engineering specifications.
Conduct design calculations covering battery capacity, plate configuration, acid volume, component fitment, terminal arrangement, weight and dimensional compliance.
Support prototype development, pilot builds and production trials.
Coordinate with testing teams to prepare DVPR and validation plans.
Support design verification, validation and release through the company stage-gate NPD process.
Ensure completion of design reviews, technical risk assessments and product-release documentation.
Perform tolerance stack-up, fitment and interface analysis for battery components.
Identify opportunities for weight reduction, material optimization, improved performance and cost reduction.
Conduct Design FMEA and participate in Process FMEA reviews.
Evaluate product failures and implement corrective design actions.
Apply design-for-manufacturing, design-for-assembly and mistake-proofing principles.
Support value-engineering and product-standardization initiatives.
Prepare technical inputs for moulds, dies, fixtures and inspection gauges.
Participate in mould trials, component trials and sample approval.
Work with suppliers to resolve dimensional, material, fitment and manufacturing concerns.
Support component qualification, pilot-lot evaluation and production approval.
Coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Testing, Purchase, Marketing, Service and Supplier Development teams.
Provide technical support during product industrialization and production ramp-up.
Support investigation of field complaints and warranty failures related to product or component design.
Provide technical inputs for product specifications, catalogues, manuals and regulatory submissions.
Prepare and maintain drawings, specifications, bills of materials, engineering change notes and technical reports.
Ensure proper document control and traceability of design changes.
Support internal, customer and certification audits relating to product design and development.
Follow applicable safety, quality and environmental management systems.


Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.
A diploma or advanced qualification in Tool and Die Making, CAD/CAM or Product Design will be an advantage.


Required Experience
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in product or component design.
Practical experience in the design and development of flooded tubular lead-acid batteries is strongly preferred.
Experience in plastic components, lead-alloy components, tooling, mould development and manufacturing drawings will be valuable.
Exposure to battery manufacturing processes and new-product industrialization is required.

design-for-manufacturing
design-for-assembly
Microsoft Excel

Word


Behavioural Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Attention to detail and commitment to drawing accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple development projects simultaneously.
Effective cross-functional and supplier coordination.
Good written and verbal communication skills.

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Customer focus

He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You assist in planning, developing and execution of capital projects, technical development, feasibility perspectives of engineering-related activities in the supply chain and capital-expense project execution to support growth, world-class manufacturing and productivity with the highest level of quality, safety and environmental requirements. You help ensure sure that Mondel z business and innovation processes in project management and Mondel z standards in execution are followed.
How you will contribute
The role supports capital project execution, and you will be accountable for the quality of the results and execution of capital projects using Mondel z standards, and business and innovation processes in project management. You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices.
What you will bring
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Engineering or operations
Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
Analysis
Project management
More about this role
Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for new capacity expansion.

What you need to know about this position:
Experience
5-6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food beverage preferred).
PLC / SCADA
Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of batch processes and Pack-ML Standards.
Electrical
Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives.
Instrumentation
Good knowledge of instruments, selection, and Calibration processes, including legal meteorology.
Digital and Cybersecurity
Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations.
OT infrastructure - Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools.
Process and Equipment Safety.
Hands-on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment Safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes.
Leadership
Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting.
Project Mgmt
Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope).
Communication
Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English.

Education / Certifications:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.

Job specific requirements:
Electrical Systems
Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion Plant projects.
Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e.g., NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements).
Automation for plant projects
Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc.), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion.
Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps.
Project Delivery
Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects - from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover.
Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification.
Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the EA scope.
People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers.
Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments.
Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and the Electrical Maintenance team for project shutdown and integration planning.
Safety Compliance
Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits.
Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements.
Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation.

Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.
Apply PDCA, TPM/IL6S and other continuous improvement methodologies to address recurring equipment and maintenance issues.
Capability Building & Stakeholder Management
Coach and support operating and maintenance teams on routine maintenance, equipment care, breakdown prevention and CIL (Cleaning, Inspection & Lubrication) practices.
Support development of technical capability within operating teams and work process owners.
Interface with internal stakeholders including Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Quality, HSE and Supply Chain, as well as external service providers and OEMs.
Ensure adherence to manufacturing standards, governance, compliance requirements and applicable legal regulations.
What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career, along with the following experience and knowledge:
Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.
Good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, asset reliability and maintenance planning.
Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and track performance.
Computer proficiency, including MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience in ERP systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across maintenance, MRO, infrastructure, facilities, inventory and budget management.
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.

Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :

Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.

1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.

Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has

returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently

He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills

Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

AboutCompany:
DBS Bank Limited is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the Marina Bay Financial Centre in the Marina Bay district of Singapore. Description:
What you ll do:
Manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
"-Supervise VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
-Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
-Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
-Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
-Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
-Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations."

To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.

Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch

Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies

Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.

Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager

To take complete ownership and achievement of the Sales targets in the assigned area.

Description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Sr Supply Chain Executive to join our dynamic team at Unilever Plc. This role is crucial in optimizing our supply chain operations, ensuring efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery of products to our global customers.

Job Responsibilities

Develop and implement supply chain strategies to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels.
Manage end-to-end supply chain processes, including demand planning, procurement, logistics, warehousing, and inventory management.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e. g. , manufacturing, marketing, sales) to align supply chain activities with business objectives.
Lead and mentor a team of supply chain professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
Identify and mitigate supply chain risks, including supplier disruptions, transportation issues, and inventory obsolescence.
Analyze supply chain data to identify trends, opportunities for optimization, and areas for improvement.
Negotiate contracts with suppliers and logistics partners to ensure favorable terms and conditions.
Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, quality standards, and company policies throughout the supply chain.
Drive the adoption of new technologies and best practices in supply chain management.
Prepare and present regular reports on supply chain performance to senior management.

Job Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. Masters degree preferred.
Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive experience in supply chain management, preferably within the FMCG sector.
Proven track record of successfully managing complex supply chain operations and achieving measurable results.
Strong understanding of supply chain principles, methodologies, and best practices (e. g. , S&OP, Lean, Six Sigma).
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.
Proficiency in supply chain planning software (e. g. , SAP, Oracle, JDA) and advanced Excel skills.
Exceptional leadership and team management abilities, with experience in mentoring and developing staff.
Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills, capable of building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and innovation in supply chain processes.

Role & responsibilities

1.Responsible to follow GLP compliance, right from first time.
2. Responsible to complete the assigned work along with proper documentation.
3.Responsible for review of log books.
4.Responsible for Analysis of cleaning verification samples, in process, stability samples intermediates, bulk, as well as finished products and others as required by chemical method and instruments such as HPLC, Analytical Balance, pH & Conductivity meter, UV, Dissolution tester, Disintegration, friability, Vernier caliper and hardness tester.

7. Responsible for monitoring the temperature and relative humidity in the quality control lab and ensure the records are updated.
8. Responsible to follow approved standard operating procedures, specifications and other standard test procedures of the department SOP.

About Big7 Solutions
Big7 Solutions is a digital solutions and marketing company that helps businesses grow through creative, technology-driven, and data-focused strategies. Our services include digital marketing, SEO, website design and development, social media marketing, graphic design, and web and mobile app development.
We believe in creativity, innovation, and delivering impactful digital experiences that help brands build a strong online presence.

About the Role
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Creative Video Editor with 1-2 years of experience in video editing, motion graphics, and visual storytelling. The ideal candidate should have a strong sense of creativity, understand social media trends, and be able to transform ideas and raw footage into engaging video content.
The candidate should also have basic graphic design skills to support the creation of social media creatives, promotional videos, advertisements, and other digital marketing content.

Key Responsibilities
Edit engaging videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social media platforms.
Create promotional videos, brand videos, advertisements, and marketing content.
Add transitions, animations, motion graphics, sound effects, and background music to enhance video quality.
Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling approaches for video content.
Create AI-assisted video content using relevant AI tools when required.
Design basic graphics, thumbnails, titles, and other visual assets for digital platforms.
Ensure consistent branding, visual quality, and storytelling across all video content.
Optimise videos for different social media platforms, formats, and aspect ratios.
Collaborate with the design, content, and digital marketing teams to understand project requirements.
Stay updated with video editing techniques, social media trends, and emerging creative tools.
Manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications
12 years of professional experience in video editing and content creation.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Filmora, CapCut, or similar editing software.
Basic knowledge of graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva.
Understanding of motion graphics, transitions, colour correction, audio synchronisation, and pacing.
Ability to create engaging short-form videos and promotional content.
Familiarity with social media formats, trends, and platform-specific content requirements.
Knowledge of AI video generation and editing tools is an added advantage.
Strong creative thinking, visual storytelling, and attention to detail.
Good time management skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team.
A portfolio showcasing previous video editing and creative projects is preferred.

What We’re Looking For
A creative thinker who can turn ideas into engaging visual content.
Someone who takes initiative and brings fresh ideas to projects.
A candidate who balances creativity with brand consistency and project requirements.
Someone who is eager to learn new tools, techniques, and AI-powered creative workflows.
AboutCompany:
Big7 Solutions is a digital solutions and marketing company based in Puducherry, India, helping businesses strengthen their online presence and achieve sustainable growth. We offer a range of services, including Search Engine Optimization (SEO), website design and development, social media marketing, Google Ads, graphic design, and web and mobile app development.
Our team combines creativity, technical expertise, and data-driven strategies to improve online visibility, generate quality leads, and deliver effective digital solutions for businesses across various industries.
At Big7 Solutions, we believe in continuous learning, innovation, collaboration, and delivering quality results that help our clients grow.

Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

Description:
Position Overview:
HIAL is looking for a dynamic and people-centered HR Manager who can lead and manage the institute's human resource functions in a proactive, empathetic and organized manner. The ideal candidate should be passionate about creating an inclusive, growth-oriented and values-driven work culture while aligning HR practices with the institute's mission.

Key Responsibilities:

1. HR Strategy & Policy Development:
Design, review and implement HR policies and procedures that reflect the institute's ethos and ensure legal compliance.
Support long-term HR planning, including workforce planning, succession planning and talent development.
2. Recruitment & Onboarding:
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process for faculty, administrative and support staff.
Develop effective strategies for talent acquisition, including campus outreach and collaborations.
Ensure smooth onboarding and orientation of new employees.
3. Performance Management & Capacity Building:
Design and implement fair and constructive performance appraisal systems.
Identify training needs and coordinate internal and external capacity-building initiatives.
Support managers in developing individual growth plans for their teams.
4. Employee Engagement & Culture:
Foster a healthy, inclusive and collaborative work environment rooted in mutual respect and collective purpose.
Plan and execute employee engagement activities, feedback mechanisms and team-building initiatives.
Serve as a bridge between staff and leadership, ensuring two-way communication.
5. HR Operations & Compliance:
Maintain accurate and confidential employee records including attendance, leave and service history.
Manage HR-related documentation, including contracts, policies and compliance with labor laws.
Oversee payroll coordination, benefits and timely employee reimbursements in collaboration with the Finance team.
6. Conflict Resolution & Welfare:
Address staff grievances with empathy and fairness, ensuring timely resolution.
Promote mental health and staff well-being initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Organizational Development, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience; prior experience in an academic or social sector organization is preferred.
Strong understanding of HR laws, best practices and systems.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a multicultural, high-altitude and mission-driven environment.
Desirable Attributes:
Sensitivity to local culture and a passion for sustainable development in the Himalayan region.
Adaptability and willingness to live and work in a remote, cold desert setting.
Experience with HR tech platforms and digital tools.
Ability to handle both strategic HR planning and hands-on operational tasks.

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate

Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward
the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the
customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick-
up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of
the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is
expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the
overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of
stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include
prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards
achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level
of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:Driving NetPromoter Score
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs plan
Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development (Attrition Control)
Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company
training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to
execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions
are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision
Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality
standards
SOP adherence & implementation
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other
equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Graduate
Ability to act as a link between strategy and execution
Ability to develop and inspire people to achieve their best
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand stated and unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to a changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Profile Summary

Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Driving Sales and Customer Service

a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually

b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store

c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership

d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.

e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.

f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.

g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.

h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

Manpower Planning & People Development

a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates

c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.

d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives

e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.

f. Overall responsibility for associate development

Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores

a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level

b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores

c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage

d. Managing the productivity of the staff

e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory

Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations

a. Regular Store Visits to:


Audit stores

Coaching the Store Managers

Motivate staff through sales discussions

Check VM, stock availability

Check store hygiene, grooming

Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.


b. Analyze data before Store Visits


Monitoring Sales through data.

Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores

Store Staffing levels.

Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.

NPS and MC scores

Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets


a. Bridge communication between Management and floor


Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.

Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.

Implementing and enforcing company regulations

Implement process change

Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets


Inventory Management

a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores

b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores

c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores

d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed

e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner

f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level

g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Key Personal and Professional Attributes:

a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.

b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.

c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.

d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.

e) Extroverted Personality

f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached

g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient

h) Passionate

i) Energetic

j) Positive Attitude

k) Ability to handle stressful situations

l) Problem Solving & Decision Making

m) Assertive

n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player

Candidate Profile:

a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry

b) Post-Graduation is a must

c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator

d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word

e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)

f) Sales oriented

g) Strong Management/leadership skills.

h) Strong organizational skills.

i) Strong team builder

Required Managerial Competencies

People Management

a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.

b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.

c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.

d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner

Proactive Problem Solving Skills

a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.

b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.

c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.

d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation

Commercial Savviness

a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.

b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.

c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints

Customer Expectation Management

a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer

b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests

c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required

Planning and Organizing

a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments

b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches

c) Delegates work effectively among team members

Required Personality Traits

a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves

b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior

c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings

d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.

e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern

f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc
