Description:
Senior Manager - Technology M&A Advisory


Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting opportunity to help leading global organizations navigate the technology dimensions of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, and joint ventures.


Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network |

Area of Work: Technology M&A |

Level: Senior Manager |

Location: Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Pune/ Chennai/ Hyderabad/ Kolkata |

Years of Experience: 12-18 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture


Do you enjoy solving complex business and technology challenges? Are you passionate about helping clients create value through successful integrations and separations? Do you thrive in fast-paced transaction environments and enjoy partnering with C-suite executives to drive critical business outcomes?

Then this is the right place for you.


The Practice - A Brief Sketch


The Technology M&A team helps clients navigate the technology implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, joint ventures, and business transformations. We work across the transaction lifecycle, with a strong focus on post-deal signing activities including sign-to-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy and exit planning, and execution through Integration Management Offices (IMO) and Separation Management Offices (SMO).

Our professionals help clients identify and realize transaction value while managing technology risks, operational dependencies, and transformation opportunities. We work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to design and execute integration and separation strategies that enable successful transaction outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


Lead large-scale Technology M&A programs across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, and joint ventures.

Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and senior technology executives on transaction-related technology decisions.

Lead sign-to-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy, and TSA exit execution.

Oversee Integration Management Office (IMO) and Separation Management Office (SMO) governance, execution, and value realization activities.

Define technology integration and separation strategies across applications, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, ERP, and operating models.

Drive synergy identification, value capture, risk mitigation, and transaction execution planning.

Lead multi-disciplinary consulting teams and provide overall engagement leadership, quality assurance, and stakeholder management.

Build executive-level business cases, steering committee materials, and transformation roadmaps.

Support business development, proposal creation, thought leadership, and practice growth initiatives.

Develop and mentor managers and consultants within the Technology M&A practice.


Bring Your Best Skills Forward


Deep experience leading Technology M&A engagements including integrations, separations, carve-outs, Day 1 readiness, TSA management, and post-merger integration programs.

Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders.

Proven ability to manage large, complex, global programs with multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.

Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting sales, account growth, and client relationship development.

Ability to translate transaction objectives into actionable technology strategies and execution plans.


Technology Domain Experience


Candidates should possess practical experience in at least one of the following technology domains and understand how these capabilities evolve during M&A transactions, integrations, and separations:



IT Infrastructure & Cloud



Infrastructure integration and separation planning.

Cloud migration and cloud operating model considerations.

Data center, network, workplace, hosting, and end-user computing environments.

Infrastructure TSA planning and exit execution.



ERP



Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP platforms.

ERP integration, harmonization, migration, or carve-out activities.

Understanding of business process impacts, reporting, controls, and data migration considerations during transactions.



Enterprise Architecture & IT Operating Model Transformation



Enterprise architecture assessments and target-state design.

Application portfolio rationalization and technology roadmap development.

IT operating model design and transformation.

Technology governance, capability models, and organizational design considerations during integrations and separations.

Candidates should possess a strong understanding of how technology environments, operating models, applications, and infrastructure are impacted during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and carve-outs. They should be comfortable advising clients on transaction implications, identifying risks and dependencies, and shaping integration and separation strategies across the deal lifecycle.


What-s in it for You?


Opportunity to work on high-profile global M&A transactions and transformative business programs.

Exposure to senior client executives and strategic decision-making processes.

Collaboration with leading practitioners across Technology Strategy, M&A, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Industry groups.

Personalized training and development programs to strengthen transaction, consulting, and leadership capabilities.

A diverse and inclusive culture focused on innovation, growth, and continuous learning.


Qualification

Your Experience Counts


MBA from a Tier 1 institute preferred.

12-18 years of consulting, deal advisory, technology advisory, transformation, or industry experience.

Demonstrated experience leading Technology M&A transactions and large-scale integration or separation programs.

Strong experience across sign-to-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy, and IMO/SMO leadership.

Experience leading client engagements, managing senior stakeholders, and overseeing delivery teams.

Experience in at least one of the following domains: IT Infrastructure & Cloud, ERP, or Enterprise Architecture & IT Operating Model Transformation.

Proven ability to originate opportunities, contribute to sales pursuits, and support practice growth.

Strong understanding of modern enterprise technologies including cloud, cybersecurity, AI, data, and digital platforms.

We are looking for an experienced UX Architect to lead the definition and execution of user experience strategies for enterprise and customer-facing digital products. UX Strategy & Architecture

Simplify complex workflows into intuitive user experiences.

Interaction Design

Develop low-fidelity and high-fidelity prototypes.
Create design specifications and interaction guidelines for development teams.
Ensure accessibility and usability best practices are embedded in solutions.
Design Systems & Governance
Establish and maintain enterprise-wide design systems.
Promote reusable design components and UX standards.
Drive UX governance, design reviews, and quality audits.
Ensure compliance with accessibility standards (WCAG).
Collaboration & Leadership
Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Stakeholders, Engineers, and Designers.

Facilitate workshops, design thinking sessions, and stakeholder reviews.
Advocate for user-centric design across the organization.

Engagement and people leadership
Own engagement planning, budgets, resourcing, work allocation, milestones, quality review, issue resolution and senior stakeholder reporting across concurrent projects.
Coach and review multidisciplinary teams; set clear expectations for documentation, evidence sufficiency, technical accuracy, productivity, and timely delivery.
Build trusted relationships with overseas engagement teams, client process owners, SAP functional and technical leads, compliance teams, and program management offices.
Contribute to proposals, solution development, methodology improvement, knowledge assets, reusable testing accelerators and practice growth.

Description:
Electrical Supervisor

Job Overview

We are seeking a results-driven Electrical Supervisor to join our Engineering & Projects Department at Phoenix Electricals. In this role, you will lead and manage on-site electrical infrastructure operations, ensuring high-quality field execution, technical compliance, and strict
adherence to safety standards across assigned project locations.
This position reports directly to the Project Head and plays a vital role in delivering our infrastructure projects on time and within specification across our Pan-India operational footprint.
Key Responsibilities
1. On-Site Field Execution & Operations

Direct and supervise daily on-site electrical works, including overhead transmission line installation, underground cabling, substation equipment setup, and distribution infrastructure.
Coordinate field labor, riggers, fitters, and specialized sub-contractors to maintain daily execution targets.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, and tracking of project materials, heavy machinery, and specialized field equipment on site.
2. Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance
Verify that all field installation work complies with approved single line diagrams (SLDs), route layouts, engineering drawings, and quality assurance plans.
Conduct stage-wise inspections, cable insulation testing (Megger), earth resistance testing, and pre-commissioning checks.
Maintain site quality records, track punch lists, and manage request-for-inspection (RFI) procedures with client or utility representatives.

3. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Compliance
Enforce strict compliance with site safety regulations, permit-to-work (PTW) protocols, and risk assessment procedures.
Conduct regular morning toolbox talks (TBT) covering site-specific hazards, high-voltage risks, and working-at-height safety.
Ensure 100% compliance with mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE) across all field personnel.

4. Progress Tracking & Site Coordination
Prepare and submit daily progress reports (DPR), material consumption logs, and site activity records to project management.
Assist in local site management, including Right-of-Way (RoW) clearances, utility coordination, and landowner interactions along project corridors.
Support senior engineers in measuring executed quantities for billing and subcontractor reconciliation.

Required Qualifications & Credentials
Education: ITI Or Diploma
Experience: Proven field execution experience in electrical infrastructure projects, transmission lines, cabling, or substations.

Licenses/Certifications: Valid Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate / License issued by a State Electrical Licensing Board preferred.
Core Skills:
Strong technical understanding of high-voltage systems, earthing, stringing, and cable jointing procedures.
Ability to read and interpret complex electrical engineering drawings and site schematics.

Strong team leadership, local workforce management, and field problem-solving skills.
Physical fitness to manage active field operations under remote or outdoor site conditions.

Description:
Role Purpose
Own and drive the complete Water Purifier Service across the product lifecycle, ensuring superior customer experience, service excellence, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and profitability. The role will work closely with Product Management, R&D, Quality, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Service teams from product conception to end-of-life support.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Excellence
Ensure achievement of category service SLAs, TAT, FFR, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets.
Drive operational excellence through Daily Work Management (DWM), Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Monitor installation, complaints, warranty, and preventive maintenance performance across Direct Service Centers (DSC) and ASP networks.
Ensure effective CRM utilization, customer registration compliance, and consumer database management.

Category Ownership & Business Responsibility
Own the overall Water Purifier Service Category performance, including customer satisfaction, operational KPIs, revenue, cost management, and profitability.
Manage end-to-end service P&L, including warranty cost, spare parts profitability, AMC business, accessories sales, installation revenue, and finished goods referrals.
Develop and execute category service strategy aligned with business growth objectives.

Product Development & NPD Support
Represent Service as a key stakeholder in New Product Development (NPD) and stage-gate reviews.
Provide field insights, voice of customer, serviceability inputs, reliability requirements, and cost optimization recommendations during product design.
Drive service readiness activities before product launch, including service manuals, spare parts planning, troubleshooting tools, training modules, and SOPs.
Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions through RCA and CAPA initiatives.

Product Quality & Process Improvement
Analyze field failures, recurring complaints, and service trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and collaborate with Quality, R&D, and Supplier Development teams for corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor product reliability, warranty performance, spare consumption trends, and service cost optimization.

Training & Capability Development
Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for Direct service technicians, Service managers, call center teams, and ASP partners.
Create technical training modules, e-learning content, SOPs, installation guides, service advisories, videos, and knowledge repositories.
Drive capability enhancement through field coaching, skill assessments, certification programs, and performance monitoring.

Service Content & Knowledge Management
Develop and maintain service documentation, troubleshooting guides, installation procedures, technical bulletins, warranty policies, and service advisories.
Ensure timely communication of product updates and service process changes to all stakeholders.

Spare Parts & Supply Chain Management
Own spare parts strategy, forecasting, inventory planning, availability, and lifecycle management.
Optimize spare parts cost, fill rate, inventory health, and service readiness across the network.
Drive standardization and cost-effective sourcing initiatives.

Customer Experience & Digital Service
Drive NPS, CSAT, customer retention, and service experience enhancement programs.
Monitor customer feedback from CRM, contact center, MTRSS customer and marketplaces.
Lead digital initiatives related to service automation, field mobility, self-service tools, customer communication, and analytics.

Revenue & Business Growth
Drive AMC, accessories, consumables, spare parts, upgrades, and installation revenue growth.
Develop service-led business opportunities and customer lifecycle monetization programs.
Enable referral generation and conversion for Water Purifier finished goods sales.
Monitor revenue realization, margins, and profitability across all service revenue streams.

Partner & Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with DSC team, Branch CS team, ASP partners, Category Business lead, Digital marketing team, Ecom partners, and KAMs.
Ensure alignment between service operations and business objectives through regular reviews and governance mechanisms.
Drive marketplace ratings, reviews, and service performance metrics.

Performance Management & Reporting
Establish and monitor category KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
Review business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
Prepare periodic MIS, management reviews, business forecasts, and performance reports for leadership.

Key KPIs
NPS / CSAT
Service SLA & TAT Achievement
First-Time Fix (FTFR)
Installation Success Rate
Warranty Cost % to Sales
Spare Parts Availability & Fill Rate
AMC Revenue Growth
Accessories & Consumables Sales
Service Revenue & Profitability
Field Productivity
Field Failure Rate (FFR)
Marketplace Ratings & Reviews
Product Reliability & Quality Metrics
Overall Category P&L Performance

Preferred Experience

10+ years of experience in Service Operations, Product Support, Consumer Durables, Water Purifiers, Appliances, or Similar Categories.
Strong exposure to Product Development, Service Operations, Quality, Spare Parts Management, Revenue Generation, and Business Management.
Proven experience in leading large field service networks and driving customer experience transformation.
Strong analytical, commercial, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

Education Qualification:
Bachelors degree, MBA with any specialization

Key Skills/Competencies:
Global mindset - Ability to understand different markets, competitor overview and set the differentiated trend for Vguard
Excellent domain knowledge
Problem Solving & Decision making
Influencing
Business Acumen
Strategic Thinking
Interpersonal Relationships
Effective Decision Making
Enabling Change Management and Developing People
Familiarity with MS office, CRM systems and other CRM related practices
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Self-motivated and proactive approach to work.

Description:
Picture yourself brightening someones day. When you join our Hotels team, thats exactly what youll do every time you come to work. As a Food Beverage Attendant, youll play an essential role in delivering friendly, attentive, and efficient service across our dining outlets.
Whether welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, or ensuring the outlet is ready for service, youll help create experiences that make every stay special.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or customer service is preferred.
A passion for delivering friendly and attentive guest service.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable approach.
Well-presented, reliable, and committed to maintaining high service standards.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Deliver warm and attentive service: Welcome guests, take orders accurately, serve food and beverages, and respond promptly to guest requests.
Create memorable guest experiences: Build positive relationships with guests, anticipate their needs, and handle feedback professionally.
Maintain service excellence: Follow Hiltons service standards and ensure food and beverages are presented and delivered to the highest quality.
Support smooth outlet operations: Assist with table setup, clearing, resetting, cleaning, and preparing the outlet before, during, and after service.
Work effectively as a team: Coordinate closely with colleagues, supervisors, kitchen teams, and other departments to ensure seamless service.
Support revenue and efficiency: Promote menu items and special offers where appropriate, process orders accurately, and minimize wastage.
Uphold health and safety standards: Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, alcohol awareness, and workplace safety procedures at all times.
Develop your skills: Participate in training and continuously build your knowledge of menus, service techniques, and hospitality standards.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Support
About EY
At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
The Opportunity
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement - Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility - the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Operations
Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.
Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.
Support preparation of leadership - ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.
Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.
Operational Excellence
Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.
Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.
Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.
Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.
Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.
Assist the triage of requests for ad - hoc analysis, reporting, and information, helping to embed new ways of working and reinforcing self - service where possible.
Stakeholder Engagement
Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.
Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.
Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow - through on actions and high - quality execution.
Participate actively in regular update calls and forums, contributing insights and supporting other team members as needed.
Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.
Skills & Attributes for Success
Good analytical and problem - solving skills, with attention to detail.
Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.
Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering high - quality outputs under tight timelines.
A client - focused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.
Clear, confident communicator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.
Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.
Familiarity with AI/other automation to enhance processes, project outcomes and personal deliverables
What we offer you
At EY, we ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence Apply today.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
About Company

Implant Genesis (a unit of JJ Group of Companies) is a brand focused on dental implant manufacturing and related products, known for its commitment to quality and ethical practices. They also offer educational resources and workshops, including collaborations with institutions like Ramiah College.

Job description:
The Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving the sales and market development of the company's dental implant products by developing strong relationships with dentists, implantologists, oral and maxillofacial surgeons, dental clinics, hospitals, dental laboratories, distributors, and other relevant stakeholders.

The role involves identifying new business opportunities, acquiring and retaining customers, achieving sales targets, expanding the company's market presence, and building long-term professional relationships within the dental industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITY:

A. Business Development & Sales
Develop and implement strategies to achieve assigned sales and business development targets.
Identify and generate new business opportunities in the assigned territory.
Develop a strong network of dentists, implantologists, oral surgeons, prosthodontists, dental clinics, hospitals, and dental institutions.
Conduct regular visits to dental professionals and key decision-makers to promote the company's dental implant systems and related products.
Understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate products and solutions.
Convert prospective customers into active customers and develop long-term business relationships.
Increase product adoption among dental professionals through regular product demonstrations, presentations, and clinical discussions.
Explore opportunities for institutional and bulk sales.
B. Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
Regularly follow up with dentists and clinics to understand their requirements and ensure customer satisfaction.
Address customer queries, complaints, and product-related concerns promptly in coordination with the relevant internal teams.
Maintain regular communication with key customers to increase customer retention and repeat purchases.
Identify high-potential customers and develop them into long-term accounts.
C. Product Promotion & Clinical Engagement
Promote the company's dental implant systems, prosthetic components, surgical kits, and other related products.
Conduct product presentations and demonstrations for dentists and implantologists.
Coordinate with clinical/technical teams for product demonstrations, workshops, seminars, and hands-on training programs.
Support doctors during product trials, where required, in coordination with qualified clinical/technical personnel.
Communicate product features, benefits, applications, and competitive advantages effectively.
Keep updated on developments and trends in dental implantology and competing implant systems.
D. Distributor & Channel Development
Identify and appoint suitable distributors/dealers in assigned territories, where applicable.
Develop and manage relationships with distributors and channel partners.
Monitor distributor performance, stock levels, sales activities, and market coverage.
Ensure effective product availability and distribution within the assigned territory.
Develop new markets and expand the company's distribution network.
Work closely with distributors to achieve territory-wise sales targets.
E. Market Intelligence
Conduct regular market visits and gather information regarding:
Competitor products and pricing
Market trends
Customer preferences
New clinics and hospitals
Emerging dental implant markets
Competitor activities and promotions
Provide regular market feedback to management.
Identify potential areas for geographical and product-line expansion.
Monitor competitor activities and recommend appropriate business strategies.
F. Events, Conferences & Training Programs
Participate in dental conferences, exhibitions, trade shows, seminars, and workshops.
Assist in organizing CDE programs, implantology workshops, study clubs, hands-on courses, and doctor engagement programs.
Develop relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), leading implantologists, and dental institutions.
Coordinate with doctors and professional associations for educational and promotional activities.
G. Sales Administration & Reporting
Maintain accurate records of customer visits, leads, opportunities, orders, and follow-ups.
Prepare periodic sales and business development reports.
Maintain an updated customer database and sales pipeline.
Use the company's CRM system or other reporting tools effectively.
Submit territory-wise sales forecasts and business plans to management.
Ensure timely collection of payments in coordination with the finance/accounts team.
Track sales performance against monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.

Job Title: Technical Test Engineer - Analyst -ACS SONG

Management Level:Level 11 - Analyst

Location: Kochi

Must have skills: Cypress/Playwright - Javascript

Good to have skills: API automation

Experience: 1.5-3 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)

Job Summary
At Accenture Song, delivering top-notch solutions means ensuring development outcomes align with expectations. While manual testing is still important, there''s an increasing focus on automating various testing types - functional, regression, visual, performance, and compatibility. As a Technical Test Engineer, you will contribute to our automation efforts, helping enhance overall quality and efficiency.

Roles and Responsibilities
Work in Agile environments, preferably using Scrum or Kanban methodologies.
Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for web applications using Playwright and Cypress.
Assist in creating and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and acceptance criteria.
Perform UI, functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QA team members to understand requirements and report issues effectively.
Execute automated test suites and analyze test results to identify defects and improve software quality.
Log defects and provide clear, concise documentation of test execution results.
Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of existing automation frameworks and reusable test components.
Demonstrate a proactive mindset, willingness to learn, and continuously improve automation and testing skills.
Maintain high standards of professionalism, ownership, and quality throughout the Software Testing Life Cycle.



Qualification

Professional and Technical Skills
1.53 years of experience across the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
Hands-on experience with both Playwright and Cypress for UI automation.
Basic knowledge of developing and maintaining automation frameworks.
Proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript; experience with Java is an added advantage. Knowledge of Python is a plus.
Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and coding best practices.
Familiarity with automation frameworks such as Cucumber, JUnit, or TestNG.
Basic understanding of RESTful API testing.
Experience working with Git-based version control systems such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
Good understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Additional Information
Good to have experience in API testing and API automation using tools/frameworks such as Playwright API, Karate, Rest Assured, or Postman.
Familiarity with AI-assisted Software Testing and AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
Exposure to build tools such as NPM, Maven, or Gradle.
Experience with Selenium and Java-based automation will be an added advantage
Exposure to cloud testing platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or AWS Device Farm.
Basic experience with mobile automation tools such as Appium.
Understanding of performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or Gatling.
Experience generating reports using Allure Reports, Extent Reports, or equivalent.
Awareness of Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized environments.
Basic understanding of application security testing practices and tools such as OWASP ZAP.
Good to have knowledge or experience in the E-commerce domain.

Ability to work in a global environment with multiple stakeholders and time zones.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into SAP solutions.
Proactive approach to identifying risks and resolving issues.

Good documentation and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.

Description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP BTP BASIS Administrator to manage, secure, monitor, and optimize SAP cloud and on-premises landscapes. The role covers SAP BTP administration, BASIS operations, HANA database support, service provisioning, integrations, security, governance, monitoring, and L2/L3 technical support across Development, QA, and Production environments.
Responsibilities
Administer SAP BTP Global Accounts, Directories, Subaccounts, entitlements, quotas, environments, and service subscriptions.
Provision and support Cloud Foundry, SAP Integration Suite/CPI, SAP Build, ADS, DMS, Cloud ALM, and other BTP services.
Manage IAS, IPS, SSO, MFA, Role Collections, RBAC, user provisioning, and platform access.
Configure SAP Cloud Connector, Destinations, trust configurations, certificates, and SAP/non-SAP system connectivity.
Monitor BTP platform health, applications, service utilization, audit logs, alerts, and operational metrics.
Manage BTP consumption, licensing, capacity, account entitlements, cost optimization, and governance standards.
Troubleshoot BTP, integration, security, certificate, authentication, and connectivity issues, including root cause analysis.
Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain SAP S/4HANA, Solution Manager, and Cloud ALM landscapes.
Perform SAP kernel upgrades, system refreshes, client copies, OS/DB upgrades, migrations, and post-activity validation.
Administer SAP HANA databases, tenant databases, backups, availability, performance, and capacity.
Manage CTS/TMS transport landscapes and coordinate application deployments across Development, QA, and Production.
Configure and support SAP Web Dispatcher, SAProuter, SNC, SSL, ICM, SAP Gateway/OData, and Fiori infrastructure.
Administer background jobs, spool systems, RFC/BG RFC, SMTP, interfaces, and technical communication services.
Perform system monitoring, workload analysis, performance tuning, capacity planning, and availability management.
Implement SAP Security Notes, vulnerability remediation, audit controls, certificate renewals, and compliance requirements.
Provide L2/L3 support for SAP BTP, BASIS, HANA, integrations, and platform-related incidents and service requests.
Collaborate with Security, Development, Integration, Infrastructure, and Architecture teams on projects and cloud adoption.
Qualifications
Bring 6+ years of SAP BASIS and 3+ years of SAP BTP administration experience, with strong hands-on knowledge of HANA, S/4HANA, Fiori, CPI, IAS, IPS, ADS, DMS, and Cloud Connector.
Experience with SAP RISE, automation, DevOps, PowerShell, Python, or Shell scripting is preferred; relevant SAP BTP, HANA, or SAP Technology certifications are an advantage.

Description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) business partners with healthcare professionals across India to expand access to therapies that help diagnose and treat cardiac rhythm disorders. This role is part of the downstream marketing function, responsible for developing and executing portfolio strategy, supporting product launches, driving therapy adoption, and enabling commercial success across a diverse healthcare landscape. The position works closely with regional sales teams and cross-functional partners to execute market development initiatives, strengthen customer engagement, and support business growth for the CRM portfolio.
This position can be based in Gurgaon or Mumbai and follows a Flex work model. Travel up to 10% is required to support customer engagement, field collaboration, industry events, and strategic business initiatives across India.
As a Senior Marketing Specialist, you will lead downstream marketing initiatives for the Cardiac Rhythm Management portfolio across India. The role combines strategic planning, commercial execution, market development, and stakeholder engagement to drive portfolio growth. You will collaborate with global and regional teams, translate market insights into actionable strategies, and partner with sales teams to improve customer engagement, therapy adoption, and business performance.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
Develop and execute portfolio marketing plans, including competitive positioning, pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, budget management, and brand initiatives.
Partner with global marketing teams to adapt regional strategies and implement market-specific growth plans.
Lead product launch activities, including clinical messaging, pricing recommendations, sales enablement, and customer engagement programs.
Manage inventory planning, demand forecasting, and portfolio performance to support business objectives and minimize obsolescence.
Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, market trends, and customer needs.
Drive market development and patient awareness initiatives through physician engagement, digital campaigns, educational programs, and therapy adoption activities.
Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, healthcare stakeholders, and industry partners to support therapy expansion and portfolio growth.
Collaborate with sales, regulatory, legal, clinical, public relations, and research and development teams to ensure aligned and effective execution of marketing strategies.
Required Qualifications
Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. • 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience.
Experience developing and executing marketing strategies, product launches, and commercial growth initiatives.
Experience in market analysis, forecasting, pricing strategy, and business planning.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders.
Experience presenting business insights and recommendations to customers, sales teams, or leadership audiences.
 Preferred Qualifications
Master of Business Administration.
Experience in medical devices, cardiovascular therapies, cardiac rhythm management, or related healthcare markets.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint for business analysis and presentations.
Experience leading physician engagement, therapy awareness, or market development initiatives.
Experience working with global teams and supporting regional portfolio growth strategies.

Description:
At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology, therapies, and services can do to help alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. As a Senior Compliance Specialist, you will serve as a strategic compliance business partner responsible for supporting the development, implementation, and oversight of an effective compliance program that promotes ethical business conduct and mitigates compliance risks across commercial operations.
You will provide expert compliance guidance to business leaders and employees, support risk assessments and monitoring activities, oversee channel partner compliance programs, and help ensure adherence to company policies, industry codes, and applicable laws and regulations. The role requires the ability to influence stakeholders, balance business objectives with compliance requirements, and drive a strong culture of integrity throughout the organization.  
This is an individual-contributor role and the position will be in Mumbai in India and has responsibility mainly for India Subcontinent (subject to changes). The position will report directly to the India Subcontinent Compliance Officer.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

Strategic Business Partnership
Serve as a trusted advisor to commercial and functional stakeholders on compliance and data privacy matters. Understand business strategies, operating models, commercial priorities, and emerging initiatives to provide timely and practical compliance guidance.
Advise on Global Business Conduct Standards/Compliance Policy such as HCP/HCO interactions, sponsorships, educational grants, consulting arrangements, and promotional activities, in adherence with applicable laws, codes, regulations, and company policies.
Clearly document compliance advice, risk assessments, approvals, exceptions, and agreed mitigation actions.
Monitor regulatory and industry developments and support the implementation of relevant changes in policies, processes, systems, training, and business practices.
Support the integration of privacy principles into business processes, digital initiatives, customer programs, vendor arrangements, and projects involving personal or sensitive data.
Promote privacy-by-design principles by encouraging teams to consider data minimization, purpose limitation, appropriate access, retention, security, transparency, consent, and individual rights at the beginning of an initiative.
Data Analytics and Risk Insights
Develop dashboards, metrics, and reports for management and compliance leadership to analyse trends.
Translate analytical findings into clear risk insights, recommendations, and action plans for business and compliance stakeholders, for continuous improvement of the compliance program.
Utilize data analytics to identify opportunities for process and control enhancements.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators supporting continuous improvement.
Track remediation activities and evaluate whether implemented actions have appropriately addressed identified risks.
Compliance Monitoring and Process Reviews
Support in developing and executing risk-based compliance monitoring plans aligned with country, business, and program priorities.
Conduct risk-based compliance reviews and assessments, analyse findings, root causes and risk trends.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve compliance concerns and track timely closure.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve documentation, and enhance the effectiveness of the Compliance Program.
Third-Party Compliance
Support the third party compliance program for India SubCon such as due diligence, training, monitoring, remediations and lifecycle-management processes.
Review third-party due-diligence / screening results, red flags, design appropriate remediations and supporting documentation.
Conduct or support audits/monitoring, remediations, process assessments, and other risk-based oversight activities.
Training
Support in design, develop, and deliver engaging compliance training for employees, managers, Business Units, functional teams, distributors, dealers, and other third parties.
Tailor training and communication to the specific risks and promote awareness of compliance requirements, culture of integrity and ethical decision-making.

Required Qualifications:
Requires advanced knowledge of job area combining breadth and depth, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience. May have practical knowledge of project management.
Requires a Baccalaureate degree with minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years relevant experience.

Preferred:
Experience in the healthcare, medical-device, pharmaceutical, life-sciences, or another highly regulated industry.
Knowledge of Indian healthcare compliance requirements, UCMPMD, data-protection requirements, and applicable anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws.
Experience managing distributor, dealer, channel-partner, consultant, vendor, or other third-party compliance risks.
Experience conducting investigations, monitoring activities, and compliance risk assessments.
Proficiency in Excel and experience with Power BI, data visualization, dashboards, or other analytical tools.
Relevant professional qualification or certification in compliance such as CCEP, law, audit, privacy such as CIPM, fraud examination, risk management, accounting, or data analytics.

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Job Title: Admission Counsellor / Business Development Executive / Senior Learning Consultant EdTech

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Position Title: Area HR Partner- Upper North (Third Party Contractual)

Reports to: Lead HR Retail (North and East)

Note: This role is on one year contract. Based on performance we can convert this role on-rolls, but if not then after one year the contract will terminate after one year

Location: Chandigarh (First two months in Gurgaon office)

Position Summary:
The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region

Key Objectives:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people-related decisions across stores.
Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies Required:
MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
2-4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing industries.
Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.

Department: Customer Service
Location: Branch Based

Role Purpose
To manage end-to-end customer service operations at the branch level, ensuring excellent customer experience, timely resolution of service requests, compliance with regulatory and internal policies, and effective coordination with Sales, Credit, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Service & Operations

Act as the primary customer service representative for the branch.
Support branch management in resolving operational and customer-related issues.
Team Management
Lead and coach branch customer service executives.
Monitor individual and team productivity.
Conduct regular reviews and capability-building sessions.
Foster a customer-centric culture within the branch.
MIS & Reporting
Track service-related KPIs and branch performance metrics.
Prepare periodic reports for management review.
Analyze trends in complaints, service requests, and operational issues.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Complaint Resolution TAT
Service Request Closure TAT
Audit & Compliance Scores
Customer Retention Metrics
Branch Service Quality Parameters
Process Adherence and Accuracy

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline.
2-6 years of experience in customer service, branch operations, banking, NBFC, HFC, or financial services.
Strong understanding of home loan servicing and branch operations.
Good knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage teams and drive service excellence.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Description:
F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.
Whether setting tables and event materials communicating with the kitchen, interacting, and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the F&B Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.

Key Responsibilities
Review documents, emails, and datasets as part of data breach review projects.
Identify and classify Personally Identifiable Information (PII), Protected Health Information (PHI), financial information, and other sensitive data.
Conduct quality control and quality assurance checks to ensure review accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
Validate review decisions against established project protocols and client guidelines.
Escalate exceptions, inconsistencies, and complex findings to project leads.
Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with applicable data security requirements.
Meet defined productivity, quality, and turnaround expectations.
Required Qualifications and Skills
LL.B. degree from a recognized university.
6-12 months of experience in data breach review, document review, eDiscovery, or a similar legal review role.
Strong attention to detail and analytical ability.
Ability to review large volumes of information accurately and efficiently.
Good written communication and documentation skills.
Ability to work effectively in a deadline-driven environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Preferred Experience
Exposure to data breach review matters.
Understanding of PII, PHI, financial information, and other sensitive data categories.
Experience performing quality checks or second-level reviews.
Familiarity with document review platforms or legal technology tools.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What Youll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.

Overview:
We are seeking a motivated and experienced Senior Education Counsellor to guide students in their pursuit of education and careers in the hospitality sector. The ideal candidate will possess strong interpersonal skills, a results-driven mind set, and a passion for helping students achieve their goals.
Key Responsibilities:

Student Counselling: Provide expert guidance to students regarding course selection and
career opportunities within the hospitality industry.
Walk-In Engagement: Attend to walk-in students and their parents, offering informative
consultations and addressing queries effectively.
Lead Conversion: Convert leads into confirmed admissions by implementing strategic follow-
up and persuasive communication.
Regular Follow-Ups: Maintain ongoing communication with students and parents, conducting
regular follow-up sessions and doubt-clearing discussions to ensure clarity and confidence in
their educational choices.
Target Management: Achieve and maintain performance goals by converting potential
students into confirmed admissions and tracking progress.
Coordination with Hotels: Collaborate with hospitality partners to monitor and support student
progress and internship placements.
Initiatives and Marketing: Actively participate in marketing activities and initiatives to enhance
enrolment and promote school and college campaigns and outreach campaigns.

Qualifications:
Bachelor degree in Education, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related
field.
Proven experience in student counselling, sales, or related fields, preferably in the education or
hospitality sector.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
Results-oriented with a track record of meeting or exceeding performance targets.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities.

The Executive at ORRA Fine Jewellery is responsible for providing exceptional customer service, driving sales conversion, and building long-term customer relationships. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in retail sales.

Brief Job Description (just an indicative list and not limited to the following)
1. Attend to customer requirements with a focus on driving sales conversion and delivering excellent customer experiences.
2. Inform customers about new designs, schemes, and offers to promote sales and customer engagement.
3. Support local area activities in collaboration with the Relationship Executive.
4. Assist with the try-at-home scheme based on instructions from the Store Manager.
5. Follow up with potential customers and visit them to close sales.
6. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
Desired Skills
1. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in retail sales.
2. Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
3. Proven track record of meeting sales targets.
4. Detail-oriented and organized.
5. Ability to work well in a team.
6. Flexible availability, including weekends and holidays.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh.


Your key responsibilities
Work closely with clients to understand their business challenges and provide practical, data-driven solutions.
Support government, public sector, and private sector projects from planning through implementation.

Build and maintain strong client relationships and contribute to business development initiatives.
Support proposal preparation, opportunity identification, and pursuit of new assignments.
Ensure timely delivery of projects while maintaining high standards of quality and professionalism.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and engage with senior stakeholders.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools.
Self-driven, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
Exposure to government advisory, public sector consulting, economic development, policy, or transformation projects will be an advantage.


Qualifications
Bachelor of Engineering
Master of Business Administration


Experience
4+ years of Experience
