The role involves supporting procurement and tendering activities for utility projects, ensuring compliance with procurement procedures, facilitating bid management, vendor coordination, contract finalization, and monitoring procurement-related project deliverables.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on procurement and tendering functions. Key responsibilities include:

Procurement & Tendering Support
• Provide day-to-day support to MeECL and its subsidiaries on procurement and tendering activities.
• Review the existing Operating Procedure of MeECL for bidding of services and goods.
• Prepare Request for Proposals (RFPs) for procurement of materials and services as per client requirements and in line with the State and Central Procurement Guidelines.
• Coordinate with the State E Procurement management team.
• Advise the client from time to time on updation of the procurement process and digital intervention in the procurement.

Vendor Identification & Bid Management
• Identify and facilitate the selection of suitable vendors in line with MeECL procurement processes.
• Support release of RFPs and tender documents.
• Coordinate pre-bid meetings and manage clarifications with prospective bidders.
• Facilitate all procurement activities through to contract award.

Bid Evaluation
• Review all the technical and commercial bids.
• Find out the deviations in the submitted bids from the conditions in the RfP.
• Prepare comparative statements, bid evaluation reports, and recommendations for tender finalization.
• Support evaluation committees during the bid assessment process.

MIS & Reporting
• Prepare, review, and validate MIS reports, dashboards, progress reports, and periodic submissions.
• Prepare a database for the bids with details of technical requirement, deviations allowed, revisions in the tenders done if any etc.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure timely reporting to the Client.
• Ensure quality and accuracy of reports, presentations, and Minutes of Meetings (MoMs).

Stakeholder Coordination
• Coordinate with officials MeECL, contractors, vendors, and internal consulting teams.
• Monitor procurement milestones and facilitate timely resolution of issues.

Additional Responsibilities
• Prepare a Standard Operating Procedures with timelines for each type of procurement and ensure compliance of the approved procedure.
• Support any other procurement and tendering activities assigned by the Client.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and procurement best practices within the project.

C. Required skill set:
• Strong understanding of procurement and tendering processes in the Power Sector including, distribution, generation and transmission.
• Experience in preparation of RFPs, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract award processes.
• Knowledge of public procurement procedures and utility procurement practices.
• Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
• Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
• BE/ B. Tech or MBA (Candidates with B.Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
• Atleast 5 Years experience in Procurement, Tendering & Contracts Management in a Power Utility / Discom company or Power utility consultancy company.

E. Location:
• Shillong, Meghalaya.
• The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
• We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

Preferred candidate profile
Under general direction, manage all laboratory aspects of assigned clinical trial projects for a Customer or a specific program for a Customer. May have responsibility for a specific Customer, drug program, indication or drug compound. Acts as the main point of contact for the Customer after study award and throughout the entire study lifecycle (startup, maintenance, closeout). Essential Functions
Study Setup and Planning:
Facilitate seamless study set-up including Protocol and Budget review, leading meetings, develop and implement project plans, milestone, risk, issue and action logs. Partner with Study Setup team to ensure quality database set-up, oversee preparation of protocol specific documentation. Will prepare and present protocol-specific materials at Kick Off and Investigator meetings
May participate in the proposal and business development process including bid defence meetings. Support development of Customer standards
Study Activity Monitoring and Closeout:
Will monitor the Project Management Plan, timelines and deliverables, manage study documentation throughout the Project lifecycle including filing into eTMF, oversee study monitoring and reporting, conduct meetings to meet needs of the Study and Customer requirements
Will manage study scope changes and budget monitor quality of the study and any service-related issues, implementing changes as required. Lessons learnt will be reviewed and shared
Proactive Lines of Communication:
Build and own the Customer relationship, facilitate communication, collaborate with all operational areas within the company
Will serve as an escalation point for study level issues and will coordinate and triage study-specific issues
Coordinates customer survey follow up and ongoing health checks to support Customer relationship building
Meetings, Initiatives and Training Activities:
Will represent the company at Investigator meetings and other internal / external face to face meetings. Will participate in audits and inspections as required
Will provide study training to sites, CRAs and customers
Will establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage on-going project expectations and issues. Will participate in improvement projects as needed
Will assist in training of less experienced staff.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree Life Sciences and/or related field preferred Req
2-3 years of experience in clinical trials/ hospital-funded research, project management or laboratory environment preferred. . Equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Strong interpersonal and customer management skills.
Working understanding of medical and clinical research terminology.
Working knowledge of Project Management processes, the company laboratory processes, and/or equivalent working knowledge of central laboratory operations (kits/supplies, logistics, laboratory operations, specimen storage, data reporting and transfers, site alerts, etc.) preferred.
Demonstrated computer proficiency with Microsoft Office and the company systems, or equivalent experience with similar Centralized Laboratory systems preferred.
Experience in successfully leading Phase I-IV clinical trials preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment while possessing strong organizational skills and a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. In certain geographies where communication in local language is desired (e.g. Japan, China), excellent command of local language with reasonable proficiency in English preferred.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and customers.

Job Description: Sales and Back Office Executive
Company Name: Aditya Tech Mech
Job Location: Silvassa
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Work from Office
Salary: 15,00025,000 per month, depending on experience and skills

About the Company

Aditya Tech Mech is a manufacturer of Diesel Generator (DG) Sets and containers, providing reliable power solutions for industrial and commercial applications. With decades of industry experience, we are committed to delivering quality products, dependable service, and customer satisfaction.

Job Summary
We are looking for a confident, proactive, and target-oriented Sales and Back Office Executive to join our team in Silvassa. The candidate will handle incoming sales enquiries, communicate with prospective customers, understand their requirements, follow up on leads, prepare quotations, and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a strong sales mindset, and the ability to manage leads independently from the initial enquiry to the final sales closure.

Key Responsibilities
Handle incoming sales leads and enquiries received through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and digital marketing platforms.
Contact prospective customers, understand their requirements, and explain the company's products and solutions.
Follow up consistently with potential customers to convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
Prepare and share quotations, proposals, and product information with customers.
Negotiate with customers and coordinate with the internal team to close sales.
Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, quotations, follow-ups, and order status.
Update the company's CRM or task management system regularly.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely responses to customer enquiries.
Maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective customers.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth.
Prepare daily and periodic sales reports for the reporting manager.
Perform sales-related back-office activities and documentation as required.

Educational Qualification
BBA or MBA graduates preferred.
Graduates with a strong interest in sales and customer relationship management may also be considered.

Experience
15 years of experience in sales, inside sales, tele sales, or lead management preferred.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong willingness to learn may also apply.
Experience in B2B sales, industrial sales, or manufacturing will be an added advantage.

Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Confidence in communicating with customers over phone calls, WhatsApp, and email.
Strong follow-up, negotiation, persuasion, and sales-closing abilities.
Ability to handle multiple leads and prioritise enquiries effectively.
Basic computer proficiency, including MS Excel, email, and CRM tools.
Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
Self-motivated, customer-focused, and target-driven.
Ability to take ownership of leads and work with minimal supervision.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be evaluated based on:
Timely response to incoming leads.
Consistency and effectiveness of customer follow-ups.
Lead conversion rate and number of orders closed.
Accuracy and regularity of CRM updates and sales reports.
Customer relationship management and overall sales contribution.

Role Title Sr. Engineer IE - Plant

Function/ Department Industrial Engineering
1. JOB PURPOSE
To execute engineering improvements in current product lines at plant through existing process improvements, layout changes, automation, manpower saving & participate in MOST Study to achieve PQCDSM targets
3. PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
(Accountabilities associated with the job)
1. Process Improvements & Cost Optimization:
Execute debottlenecking projects as given by Cluster ME Head.
Achieve Quality Improvements by doing defect analysis with QA and take actions on root cause by providing Preventive & Detective countermeasures. Fill PCRN, get it approved and implement
Do process capability & Process qualification studies as and when required
Productivity Improvement and Reduce direct manpower by low cost automation solutions, alternate process recommendation, conveyorization for material movement, layout improvement etc.
Reduce indirect consumable material wastage by finding alternate low-cost material like cutting inserts, cutting oil, or with increased life
Find and propose alternate process with lower process cost
Drive productivity and flow Improvements through industrial engineering effort of line balancing, material flow, man motion, station design study .
Analyze opportunities and flow for improvement of workstation ergonomics and implement necessary actions
2. Industrial engineering
Prepare and maintain updated cell-wise and product-wise line capacity sheets, and review them with the Plant Head / Cluster ME Head for adequacy of current products
Keep latest shop floor layout ready with due approvals
Provide production manpower estimation as per indent plan after analyzing opportunities and flow for improvement of workstation ergonomics and implement necessary actions
Study production process at granular level and do time study using MOST methodology for new products as well as current products as and when requested
3. 5s Implementation & Audit:
Preparing and update the standard formats & master plan
Preparing Annual Audit Plan
Scheduling monthly cross Audit
Monitoring the monthly audit plan implementation status
Compilation of Section wise audit reports
Scheduling 5s audit review meeting with plant head, capturing MOM and preparing action plan
Monitoring the action plan status against the action plan
Plant section wise 5s measurable result capturing & verifying
Maintaining plant operations as per the 5s standards and facing external 5s audit.
Preparing action plan as per NCs & monitoring the status till NC closer.

The opportunity
Design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. How you'll make an impact
Review of Tender document, technical specifications and preparation of Design Intent Document. Preparation of Protection SLD showing principles, relays and meters.
Preparation of Functional Design Standards/Descriptions. Preparation of Signal list, trip matrix, Logics Interlocks.
Review of Vendor drawings and documents (technical vetting of Control Relay panels, Auxiliary System). Preparation of schematic diagrams for the interface's equipment in Control Relay Panel scheme thus providing completeness.
Preparation of relay ordering information and of circuit diagrams - New Existing Set-up (applicable for retrofit projects). Preparation of Cable block diagram.
Preparation of Cable Schedule BoQ estimation for ordering and Wiring/Termination diagrams. Preparation of Core sheets and SCS IO Schedule.
Panel Engineering Expertise (Layouts, circuit diagram, wiring table, terminal table etc.,) preferred. Preparation of Voltage drop calculation - Trip Close coil, LVAC power cable.
Identification of existing drawings and modifying them using red and green markups as per standard requirements. Interface knowledge with Primary Equipment, Bay Controller Units /SCADA/RTU/Tele protection are essential.
Auxiliary Power System design like Low Voltage AC Panel DC Panel requirements, Aux Tr and Battery Charger Sizing, ACDC Cable sizing CB selectivity study, CT / VT Sizing. Relay configuration (Preferred).
Excellent knowledge in AIS GIS secondary designs. As Built documentation. Co-ordination with other departments like primary, lead engineer, sourcing, CR factory counterpart own department control and protection etc. for design progress completion.
Vendor Offer Evaluations. FAT / SAT of primary secondary equipment, system as and when needed. Ensure Ontime delivery of design deliverables to be vigilant on project schedule impacts. Responsible for obtaining customer approvals for the designs and drawings.
Technical risk and opportunity assessment and validation. Take part in customer meetings / site visits for tender/project clarifications. Support and act as interface engineer during erection commissioning.
Estimation of engineering effort for each project for costing at tender stage. Innovative ideas to reduce Engineering effort. Plan, implement, review and continuously improvise quality system.
Ensure the Safety through design principles which meant for complete project lifecycle.
Responsible for maintaining and updating the documentation for respective tenders and projects as per quality process.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
Bachelors Engineering in electrical, should have 2 to 15 years' experience.
Proficiency in required CAD design tools and E3. Knowledge of relevant international standards ex. IEEE, IEC etc.
Knowledge in substation tendering and project engineering activities (technical commercial).
Individual contributor using in-depth knowledge in a specific area to execute complex or specialized projects / challenges often thinking independently to challenge traditional solutions.
Comprehensive knowledge of related disciplines in the organization. Works independently, applying established standards.
Excellent English speaker, good communication skills. Dynamic and Proactive, willing to grow in the organization.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for the general work order maintenance work assigned by your superior, or assisting the Engineering department s maintenance team in completing other maintenance work. As an Engineering Associate , you re not just responsible for ensuring the normal operation of hotel equipment - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Familiar with the operation principle and fault judgment method of large data centre infrastructure (power supply, air conditioning, fire control, security, monitoring, network, etc. ).
Willing to be engaged in the monitoring post for day shift and night shift for a long period, and have enough time to study.
Strong sense of responsibility, teamwork, professionalism, and learning ability.
Active and motivated in work, with a good sense of service.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, able to work independently.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Regulatory Compliance: Strictly adhere to staff rules, regulations, and management commands, ensuring careful operation and safe equipment use.
Operational Management: Ensure the normal operation of the hotel s power, water, gas, heating, and cooling equipment.
Record Keeping: Promptly and accurately inspect equipment operation records and shift handover records.
Equipment Maintenance: Inspect and maintain equipment and facilities under your jurisdiction, ensuring they are in good working condition.
Energy Management: Save energy and control energy consumption, implementing measures to enhance efficiency.
Event Support: Follow up on maintenance works for banquets and meetings, ensuring all related equipment functions well.
Emergency Preparedness: Regularly test-run the generator to ensure power generation and transmission during power failures.
Fire Safety Supervision: Supervise and inspect the hotel s fire preventive works, taking measures to stop any violations.
Training & Development: Supervise and train technicians and apprentices, developing their skills.
Tool Management: Manage working tools, registering team members names upon usage, and recommend disciplinary actions for subordinates as needed.

Secure Meters Limited is looking for a skilled and dedicated Plumber to support the maintenance and smooth operation of the Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) and Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) at our Sanand facility. Qualifications

Experience

Plumbing installation and maintenance

Knowledge of pumps, valves, and water treatment systems
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Basic understanding of safety practices in industrial environments

Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments.
Willingness to work in shifts if required.
Team player with a proactive approach toward maintenance activities.

AEL is DMarts ecommerce venture which is engaged in the business of online grocery retail under the brand name DMart Ready. AEL currently operates its business in select areas of Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat & is poised to launch its operations in Indore & Bhopal. 1. GST Compliance & Filings
Manage multi-state GST compliance frameworks across retail channels.
Oversee the timely filing of monthly, quarterly, and annual returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-8 (e-commerce), and GSTR-9/9C.
Execute 3-way reconciliations across Sales Registers vs. GSTR-1, Purchase Registers vs. GSTR-2B, and ERP ledger balances to optimize Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilization.
Monitor e-Way bill issuance, e-invoicing workflows, and GST rates.

2. Direct Tax & Regulatory Compliances
Oversee end-to-end Direct Tax, including monthly TDS/TCS deduction, deposit, quarterly return filings (Form 26Q/27Q), and annual Form 16/16A issuance.
Assist in annual Tax Audits (Form 3CD), corporate tax computations, advance tax forecasting, and tax provision reviews in coordination with statutory auditors.

3. Litigation & Dispute Resolution
Draft robust technical replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), audit inquiries, assessment orders, and notices from State/Central GST authorities.
Represent the company before tax officers, appellate authorities, and auditors during assessments, proceedings, and personal hearings.
Partner with external legal counsel, tax advisors, and consultants for high-stakes litigation, appeals, and legal opinions.

Experience: Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience in Indirect Taxation.

JOB TITLE: Senior Design Manager (Architecture)
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Tribeca is the largest branded luxury developer in India! Established in 2012, we have grown to become the largest developer of Trump-branded properties in the world (after the Trump Organization). Our current employee strength comprises more than 250+ associates across Mumbai, Pune, Delhi-NCR, Kolkata, and Bangalore, and we have a team of incredibly talented, hungry, bright, and passionate folks, including IIT, IIM, Wharton, and SPA toppers and industry stalwarts.

At Tribeca, we are focused on creating world-class products and customer experiences. We pioneered the concept of branded residences in India and are developing over 6 million square feet of branded residential projects in India. We are also proud to be developing the world's largest rooftop terrace.

ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced architect to lead design development and consultant coordination for our residential, mixed-use, and redevelopment projects across India. The role combines hands-on design work, from early-stage building massing through design refinement, with the management of a multidisciplinary consultant team. The ideal candidate understands Indian building regulations across different states and cities, and can translate local regulatory constraints into efficient, marketable design solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Massing
Prepare building massing studies and design options at the feasibility and concept stage, optimising FSI/FAR, unit mix, and aleable area within the applicable local regulations.
Review and refine architectural designs at each stage to improve planning efficiency, buildability, and product quality.
Evaluate design proposals from consultants and suggest improvements aligned with project and business objectives.

Consultant Coordination
Coordinate with all project consultants, including the Architect, Structural, MEP, Landscape, Rendering, and Model Making agencies, across multiple project locations.
Conduct design review meetings, track action items, and ensure timely delivery of drawings and deliverables.
Ensure design integration across disciplines and resolve conflicts between architectural, structural, and services drawings.

Regulatory Compliance
Ensure designs comply with the National Building Code (NBC 2016) and the development control regulations of the respective state or city, such as DCPR 2034 (Mumbai), UDCPR (Maharashtra), and building bye-laws of other states and development authorities.
Quickly study and interpret the local regulations applicable to new project locations.
Factor in statutory requirements such as fire NOC norms, height clearances (AAI), environmental clearance, and RERA area definitions at the design stage.
Support the approval process by reviewing submission drawings and addressing authority queries in coordination with the liaison team.

Document and Data Management
Maintain an organised folder structure for all project design documentation.
Keep a drawing register tracking all files received from and issued to consultants, including revisions and dates.
Ensure version control so that the team always works from the latest approved drawings.

Presentation and Visualisation
Prepare design presentations for management review and decision-making.
Coordinate renders, walkthroughs, and physical models for marketing and approvals, and use 3D and AI rendering tools for quick design visualisation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelors degree in Architecture (B.Arch); registration with the Council of Architecture is preferred.
Minimum 7 years of experience in an architectural or design firm, preferably on high-rise residential, mixed-use, or redevelopment projects.
Working knowledge of NBC 2016 and development control regulations in at least one major Indian city, with the ability to adapt to regulations in other states.

MANDATORY SOFTWARE SKILLS

AutoCAD
SketchUp
Adobe Photoshop
Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
3D rendering tools such as D5 Render and V-Ray
AI rendering and image-generation tools

DESIRABLE SKILLS

Experience on projects in multiple Indian cities or states.
Experience working on the developer side, or on redevelopment schemes such as SRA, MHADA, or cessed-building projects.
Familiarity with Revit or BIM workflows.
Understanding of RERA carpet area calculations and FSI/FAR computations, including premium and fungible components where applicable.

KEY COMPETENCIES

Strong design sense with a practical, cost-conscious approach.
Excellent coordination and follow-up skills across multiple stakeholders and locations.
Clear communication, both verbal and written.
Highly organised, with attention to detail in documentation.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at the same time.
Willingness to travel to project sites and consultant offices across India as required.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

The project includes setting up a 1 MTPA grinding unit and associated facilities.

Job Description
Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Navi Mumbai
Shift: Covering AU, UK, US (Rotational Shifts)
Work Mode: Remote
Reports To: Manager

Role Overview:
The Data Analyst works with other Data Analysts, Data Developers, Product Managers, and Client Support Specialists to ensure C&E collects and distributes accurate, reliable, and timely data to our clients. You will monitor and support automated collection and extraction processes within the C&E data warehouse and respond to any problems or client questions that arise. As of this posting, the role will be partially remote and partially in person in our Mumbai office.
Responsibilities:
Monitor automated data collection processes using proprietary data management tools, Unix scripting, and SQL query language
Resolve collection problems by analyzing logs, determining root cause, and implementing corrective actions
Perform data quality analysis and validation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of delivered data
Investigate and resolve data discrepancies identified through QA checks or client inquiries
Correspond by email with our data vendor partners to resolve file problems or content questions
Escalate data file processing issues to the Data Development Team, working closely with them to confirm and QA any required collection process code changes
Research and answer escalated data content questions from Client Support Specialists
Review and update data feed QA checks to improve data quality
Audit, update, and create data feed documentation
Track and manage data issues and requests through internal ticketing systems
Understand how clients use ZEMA C&E Data

Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics or Statistics
Fresh graduates and candidates with up to 1 year of experience in data analysis are encouraged to apply
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with internal teams and external data vendors
Experience with the Microsoft Office suite of software, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint
Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities and deadlines

Work Schedule & Location Requirements:
This role is currently remote; however, employees are expected to come at our Navi Mumbai office at least once per quarter. Travel and related expenses for these quarterly office visits are the responsibility of the employee.
Additional office attendance may be required when business needs arise, including visits from overseas colleagues, leadership teams etc
Employees should be prepared to work from the office for multiple days as needed. We support a 24x7 operation. Candidates must be willing to work in rotational shifts and support changing business requirements
Weekly offs will be on any two days of the week and are not guaranteed to fall on Saturdays and Sundays.
Current shift coverage includes:
AU Shift: 05:30 – 14:30 IST
UK Shift: 14:00/15:00 – 23:00/00:00 IST
US Shift: 20:30 – 05:30 IST

Shift timings may vary based on business requirements, and employees should be flexible to accommodate changes of approximately 1–2 hours when necessary
Preferences:
Basic knowledge of data warehousing concepts
Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, MySQL)
Knowledge of SQL query language and Unix/Linux environments
Familiarity with ETL or data ingestion processes
Familiarity with Java, python, PBI, JIRA will be a plus

*** No visa sponsorship is available for this position ***

Equality and Diversity: Zema Global is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and do not discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected status

Job Details:
The Design Technology Platform team at Intel Foundry India is chartered with process technology definition, advanced methodology development, and design prototyping on Intel's latest process nodes. We support Intel's internal and external design customers and offer a unique opportunity to be among the first engineers working on cutting-edge process technologies.We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead - APR Design Automation to develop and optimize RTL-to-GDS (R2G) flows primarily using Cadence Innovus Implementation System, while supporting test chip and foundry IP needs. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Cadence Innovus-based PnR flow development, with working knowledge of Synopsys Fusion Compiler being a strong added advantage. A key aspect of this role will be enabling, deploying, and supporting Cadence Innovus-based APR flows for Intel's internal product design teams as well as external foundry customers who are leveraging Intel's process technology - ensuring robust, scalable, and production-ready flow solutions that meet the design and performance requirements across a diverse customer base.This is an individual contributor (IC) technical leadership role focused on physical design automation tools, flows, and methodologies on leading-edge process nodes.
Lead the development, deployment, and continuous improvement of RTL-to-GDS flows using Cadence Innovus as the primary PnR platform
Define and drive physical design tools, flows, and methodologies including:oBlock-level implementation and integrationoFloorplanning, placement, CTS, and routing automationoTiming closure methodologies
Develop and maintain Tcl-based scripting and automation to enhance layout productivity within Innovus and related Cadence tools
Evaluate and benchmark Cadence Innovus vs. Synopsys Fusion Compiler flows; provide data-driven recommendations on tool and methodology selection
Enable and support industry-standard static timing analysis (STA) tools for test chips and Foundry IPs (FIPs), and ensure continued support and enhancement
Collaborate with central CAD, design teams, local CAD teams, and EDA vendors (Cadence, Synopsys) to define next-generation PnR methodologies
Work closely with internal and external design customers to understand requirements and deliver robust, scalable automation solutions

Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company. Promotions: Employees are promoted annually, with outstandingperformers eligible for promotions every 6 months. Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers. Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2years. Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing forall employees.

Education: Graduation or HSC qualified. Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills. Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred. Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word). Work schedule: day shift (9 hours between 10AM - 7 PM), andcomfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.

Job Summary
The Research Associate II is responsible for creating and delivering high-quality financial content from sell-side research, leveraging both advanced data extraction technologies and domain expertise. This role plays a critical part in delivering accurate and actionable financial insights that empower clients to make well-informed investment decisions.
By ensuring the highest standards of data quality and reliability, this position strengthens the credibility and usability of consensus data - directly contributing to client satisfaction, business success, and a strong presence in the financial markets.
Note: This is not an Equity Research or Financial Modeling role. The team does not write research reports or create sell-side models. The role provides an opportunity to deeply learn businesses and financial models by studying the work of leading sell-side analysts across sectors, geographies, and business models.
Responsibilities Operational Delivery
Prepare insightful financial content from sell-side research using a mix of extraction technologies and sector knowledge.
Develop and demonstrate a strong understanding of diverse business models for public-listed companies.
Track events for a set of companies - starting with corporate earnings and MA transactions - with a focus on changes in models.
Identify and flag errors in financial models using structured rules and statistics-based tools.
Process Excellence
Collaborate actively within the team to continuously improve the efficiency of the overall data collection process.
Apply knowledge of financial statements, GAAP/Recurring income, and other financial concepts to ensure data accuracy.
Break down and interpret financial models to understand the building blocks of a company's business model.
Apply an eye for detail and leverage structured tools to identify and correct modeling errors proactively.
Quickly learn the end-to-end process and build the capability to take on a reviewer role.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborating on model interpretation, sharing knowledge on sector-specific nuances, supporting consistency in output.
Highlight critical errors or modeling anomalies to team leads and cross-functional partners to improve decision-making inputs.
Partner with cross-functional teams to share best practices and align quality, and operational standards.
Articulate findings and insights clearly to stakeholders across the organization, both verbally and in written form.
Engaging actively during onboarding and training, raising process-related queries, contributing to knowledge-sharing sessions.
How Impact Will Be Measured (Success Metrics)
Accuracy and quality of financial content processed from sell-side research (error rate / quality score).
Timeliness of output delivery against defined SLAs and production targets.
Reduction in errors identified in consensus models over time, reflecting improved data quality.
Depth and breadth of company/sector coverage handled independently.
Progression toward reviewer readiness - ability to independently review and validate peer output.
Stakeholder feedback on communication clarity and cross-functional collaboration.
Effective handling of complex tasks and ownership of challenging assignments.
Skills Technical Skills
Understanding of financial statements (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement).
Knowledge of GAAP and non-GAAP/Recurring income concepts.
Familiarity with financial concepts and ratio analysis.
Ability to interpret and deconstruct sell-side financial models.
Experience with data extraction tools and technologies (preferred).
Proficiency in Excel and financial data platforms.
Understanding of consensus model creation and management (a plus).
Familiarity with AI/ML-based data extraction workflows (a plus).
Functional Skills
Strong analytical skills with the ability to apply structured frameworks to complex financial data.
Ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and errors in financial models.
Knowledge of diverse business models across sectors, industries, and geographies.
Understanding of corporate events (earnings, MA, restructuring) and their modeling implications.
Capability to learn the full end-to-end process and independently take on a reviewer function.
Deep sector expertise in specific industries (a plus).
Prior experience in creating or validating consensus models (a plus).
Behavioral Skills
Positive attitude with a high level of attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting mindset.
Excellent critical thinking and analytical aptitude.
Effective communication skills - able to clearly articulate findings and insights to stakeholders.
Collaborative team player who actively contributes to shared team goals.
Willingness to work across shifts on a rotational basis (Day / Morning / Night shifts as required).
Self-motivated with the ability to quickly adapt and upskill in a fast-paced environment.
Qualifications
Post Graduate CFA Level 2 cleared (a plus); or Undergraduate with CFA Level 3 cleared (a plus).
0-2 years of experience in financial research, data operations, or related roles. Fresher candidates with strong academic background and interest in financial markets are encouraged to apply.
Key Interfaces Stakeholders
Research Associates and Specialists within the Data Research Operations team.
Cross-functional teams including Data Quality, Technology, and Process Excellence.
Internal stakeholders across the investing community who rely on accurate financial content.
Sector and domain experts providing guidance on financial models and research methodologies.

Job Description Enterprise Sales


About the Team


The Enterprise Sales team at Redington focuses on driving businessgrowth by engaging directly with enterprise customers, understanding theirbusiness and technology requirements, and delivering comprehensive ITsolutions. The team leverages Redingtons extensive technology portfolio andpartner ecosystem to address customer needs across IT infrastructure, hardware,software, cloud, cybersecurity, and other technology solutions.


Who Were Looking For


We are looking for a dynamic and customer-focused Enterprise Salesprofessional with experience in B2B sales, solution selling, and managingenterprise customer relationships. The ideal candidate should be capable ofengaging directly with end customers, identifying business opportunities,understanding complex IT requirements, and positioning the right solutions fromRedingtons diverse technology portfolio.


The candidate should have a consultative sales approach, strongrelationship-building skills, and the ability to drive revenue growth byleveraging Redingtons broad distribution portfolio, including ITinfrastructure solutions.


Your Role


As an Enterprise Sales professional, you will be responsible for drivingrevenue growth by managing end-customer relationships, identifying new businessopportunities, and offering end-to-end IT solutions aligned with customerrequirements. You will leverage Redingtons comprehensive technology portfolioto develop strategic customer relationships, drive solution-led sales, andmaximize business opportunities across enterprise accounts.


Key Responsibilities


Drive enterprise sales by identifying, developing, andmanaging business opportunities across enterprise customers.


Engage directly with end customers to understand theirbusiness objectives, technology requirements, and IT challenges.


Adopt a consultative and solution-selling approach torecommend relevant IT solutions that address customer needs.


Promote and sell Redingtons complete IT productportfolio, including IT infrastructure, servers, storage, networking, end-usercomputing, software, cloud, cybersecurity, and other relevant technologysolutions.


Identify opportunities to cross-sell and upsellproducts and solutions across Redingtons distribution portfolio.


Develop and maintain strong relationships withenterprise decision-makers, IT teams, procurement teams, and other keystakeholders.


Work closely with OEMs, technology partners, andinternal teams to design and deliver customer-specific solutions.


Prepare proposals, solution presentations, commercialoffers, and sales plans based on customer requirements.


Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline, achieverevenue targets, and drive profitable business growth.


Track market trends, competitor activities, andemerging technology requirements to identify new business opportunities.


Ensure effective account management, customersatisfaction, and long-term business relationships.


Youre the Right Fit If


You have experience in enterprise sales, B2B sales, orIT solutions sales.


You have the ability to engage directly with endcustomers and manage relationships with enterprise accounts.


You understand solution selling and can translatecustomer business requirements into appropriate technology solutions.


You have knowledge of IT products and solutions,particularly IT infrastructure, hardware, networking, servers, storage,software, cloud, and cybersecurity.


You can position and sell a broad portfolio of ITproducts rather than focus on a single product or technology category.


You have strong business development, negotiation, anddeal-closure skills.


You can identify cross-selling and upsellingopportunities and develop strategic customer accounts.


You are comfortable working with OEMs, channelpartners, and internal stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions.


You have a target-oriented mindset and the ability tomanage sales pipelines and achieve business objectives.


Core Competencies


Enterprise Sales and Business Development


End-Customer Relationship Management


Consultative and Solution Selling


IT Infrastructure and Technology Solutions


Portfolio-Based Selling and Cross-Selling


Strategic Account Management


Sales Pipeline and Revenue Management


Commercial Negotiation and Deal Closure


Market Intelligence and Opportunity Identification


Partner and Stakeholder Management


Behavioral Skills


Excellent communication and presentation skills


Strong interpersonal and relationship-buildingabilities


Customer-centric and consultative mindset


Proactive approach to identifying and developingbusiness opportunities


Strong negotiation, influencing, and problem-solvingskills


Ability to collaborate effectively withcross-functional teams


Adaptability to evolving customer requirements andtechnology trends


Results-oriented approach with a strong sense ofownership and accountability


Tools & Processes (Optional)


CRM tools for customer relationship and sales pipelinemanagement


Sales forecasting, account planning, and opportunitytracking


IT solution proposals, presentations, and commercialquotations


OEM and technology partner engagement processes


Internal sales reporting and revenue performancetracking


About Redington


Redington is one of the largest technology solutions orchestratorsacross India, the Middle East, and Africa. Today, we are a $11.8 billionorganization with strong foundations in distribution, cloud, cybersecurity, andemerging technologies.


We are evolving from a successful legacy business into a next-generationtechnology enablement powerhouseunlocking new revenue streams, transformingour operating model, and building an enterprise that is more digital, moreagile, and future-ready.


Redington is recognized for its:


Deep and extensive distribution network


Strong presence in high-growth emerging markets


Unmatched breadth of technology ecosystem partnerships

Description:
What you ll do:
The Modeling & Simulation Center of Excellence for ES Americas is seeking an Engineer - Electromagnetics to support the design and development of electrical products, including switchgear, busway, switches, UPS, circuit protection devices, and related assemblies. The incumbent will develop and validate Electromagentic models to predict Magnetostatic & Dielectric performance. The role requires close collaboration with product engineering, test, and global technical teams to understand design intent, define analysis requirements, interpret results, and provide practical design recommendations. The engineer will contribute to Eaton s Analysis First strategy by independently executing moderately complex analyses by applying electromagnetics simulation methods, while delivering high-quality results within agreed project timelines.
"- Collaborate with product engineering and global stakeholders to translate design questions into clear electromagnetic analysis requirements.
- Perform electromagnetic analyses for switchgear, busway, switches, UPS systems, circuit protection devices, and associated components and assemblies.
- Develop appropriate electrostatic, magnetostatic, eddy-current, transient electromagnetic, and coupled electro-thermal models based on the engineering requirement.
- Prepare geometry, generate meshes, assign material properties, define excitations and boundary conditions, and establish appropriate solver settings.
- Evaluate quantities such as current density, magnetic flux density, induced currents, electromagnetic forces, losses, electric-field distribution, and dielectric stress as applicable.
- Review model assumptions and perform engineering checks to confirm that simulation results are physically reasonable and suitable for design decisions.
- Interpret and summarize analysis results, identify electromagnetic risks, and provide technically sound design recommendations to local and global teams.
- Develop verification and validation plans, correlate simulation predictions with test data, document gaps, and improve model fidelity.
- Create clear technical reports and presentations that document inputs, assumptions, methods, results, conclusions, limitations, and recommendations.
- Support parametric studies, design optimization, and sensitivity assessments to improve product performance, reliability, cost, and development cycle time.
- Contribute to reusable simulation templates, best practices, automation scripts, and standard work that improve analysis speed, consistency, and repeatability.
- Participate in technical reviews and proactively communicate progress, dependencies, technical risks, and schedule risks."

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset

About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Position description: Join Jindal Ferrous Limited's Blast Furnace Mechanical Department as an entry-level engineer, where you will contribute to the efficient operation and maintenance of blast furnace equipment critical to our mining and metals production processes. This role involves hands-on mechanical engineering tasks, supporting senior engineers in ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of blast furnace machinery. The position offers a unique opportunity to develop technical expertise in heavy industrial equipment within a leading mining and metals company, fostering growth in a dynamic and safety-focused environment.

Primary Responsibilities:
Assist in the routine inspection, maintenance, and repair of blast furnace mechanical systems to ensure optimal operational efficiency.
Support the implementation of preventive maintenance schedules and procedures for critical blast furnace equipment.
Collaborate with senior engineers to troubleshoot mechanical failures and develop corrective action plans.
Monitor equipment performance data and report anomalies to the maintenance team for timely intervention.
Participate in the installation and commissioning of new mechanical components and systems within the blast furnace department.
Ensure compliance with safety standards and company policies during all mechanical operations and maintenance activities.
Maintain accurate documentation of maintenance activities, equipment history, and technical reports.
Assist in coordinating with procurement and inventory teams to ensure availability of necessary spare parts and tools.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing equipment reliability and reducing downtime.
Support training programs for operational staff on mechanical system awareness and safety practices.

Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. Description:
WE ARE HIRING
Business Head Operations Supermarket Retail
Company: Chaspa Supermart Pvt. Ltd.
Brand: FOR YOU MART
Location: DLF Cybercity, Bhubaneswar, with frequent travel to stores and the Distribution Centre across Odisha
Reporting to: Managing Director
Employment: Full-time, on-site
COMPENSATION
Fixed gross salary: 50,000–65,000 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
• Additional monthly performance incentive: Up to 10,000 against an approved KPI scorecard.
• Statutory benefits as applicable.
• Approved official travel expenses reimbursed separately under company policy.
Performance incentives are conditional and separate from fixed salary. The final salary structure and CTC will be communicated in the offer letter.
ABOUT FOR YOU MART
FOR YOU MART is a growing supermarket retail chain serving semi-urban and rural markets in Odisha. We are looking for an experienced retail operations leader to strengthen store performance, inventory controls, supply-chain execution and team accountability.
THE ROLE
You will lead day-to-day business operations across company-operated stores, the Distribution Centre and assigned Head Office functions.
You should be able to resolve routine operational issues, execute approved business plans and develop responsible teams. Decisions must remain within approved budgets and delegated authority.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Sales and profitability
Drive store-wise sales, customer footfall, conversion, basket value, gross margin and controllable expenses. Identify performance gaps and implement measurable corrective actions.
Store operations and customer experience
Lead Area Managers and Store Managers in product availability, merchandising, customer service, store readiness, offer execution and SOP compliance. Conduct regular store visits and operational reviews.
Inventory and procurement coordination
Improve stock accuracy, replenishment, purchasing discipline and product availability. Monitor out-of-stock items, excess stock, slow-moving products and supplier follow-ups within approved budgets.
Distribution Centre and supply chain
Oversee inward accuracy, storage, picking, dispatch, transport and timely store replenishment. Resolve recurring delivery delays, shortages and coordination failures.
Loss and expiry control
Strengthen stock-count practices, FIFO/FEFO, damage controls, short-expiry monitoring, approved clearance activities and supplier settlements. Track corrective actions until closure.
People and departmental execution
Guide operational teams and coordinate HR, administration, purchasing, marketing execution, MIS and new-store readiness. Improve staffing, training, productivity and management follow-up.
MIS and operating reviews
Use GoFrugal ERP, the For You Team app and Accounts-validated figures to review performance. Maintain accurate dashboards, assign action owners and follow up deadlines through daily, weekly and monthly reviews.
New-store execution
Coordinate store-opening readiness, manpower, stock, training, operating checklists and the handover to the store team.
Governance and financial controls
Operate within approved budgets and written authority. Finance and Accounts retain responsibility for accounting, treasury, statutory payments, payment processing and banking. Escalate strategic decisions and exceptions to the Managing Director.
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS
At least 8 years of relevant experience in organised supermarket, grocery, hypermarket or FMCG retail operations.
• At least 3 years directly leading multiple outlets.
• Experience managing five or more outlets is preferred.
• Demonstrated responsibility for sales, store profitability, inventory, manpower and operating standards.
• Practical understanding of retail replenishment, warehouse/DC coordination, shrinkage and expiry control.
• Ability to interpret ERP/POS reports and work confidently with Excel and operational dashboards.
• Strong people-management, problem-solving and execution skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with store teams in Odia and Hindi, with working English for reports and business communication.
• Willingness to work from Bhubaneswar and travel frequently across Odisha.
EDUCATION
Graduation is required. An MBA or relevant qualification in Retail, Operations or Business Management is preferred.
INITIAL EXPECTATIONS
First 30 days: Assess stores, the DC, operating data and team capability; identify priority gaps and immediate actions.
By 60 days: Implement agreed improvement plans, reporting routines, accountability and operating controls.
By 90 days: Demonstrate measurable progress against agreed business and operational targets.
HOW TO APPLY
Apply through this LinkedIn job listing with your updated CV.
Please clearly mention:
Number of outlets and employees directly managed.
• Relevant supermarket or grocery retail experience.
• One measurable operational achievement.
• Expected fixed monthly gross salary.
• Notice period and earliest available joining date.
Immediate and short-notice candidates will be given preference.
AboutCompany:
Our Mission & Vision

For You Mart is a purpose-driven supermarket chain based in Odisha, built on the belief that quality, dignity, and a modern shopping experience should be accessible to everyone regardless of whether they live in a city, town, or rural area.
In many rural and semi-urban regions, women often have limited mobility and fewer opportunities to travel to distant markets or large city stores. For You Mart brings the city-style shopping experience closer to home, allowing women and families to shop comfortably, safely, and confidently within their own locality.
Our stores are designed to offer a clean, organized, and respectful environment where customers — especially women — can experience the convenience, choice, and confidence usually associated with urban retail spaces. By placing our outlets within reach of local communities, we help customers enjoy a modern retail experience without the need to travel far, making everyday shopping easier and more dignified.
Beyond convenience, our mission is rooted in service, not just sales. We provide a wide range of daily-need grocery and essential products under one roof, ensuring better quality at more affordable prices than both large chains and local markets, with special focus on everyday household needs.
To support monthly budgeting, we run a Super Savings Week from the 4th to 10th of every month, including unique offers such as 1 kg sugar at just 9 on a minimum purchase of 1499, enabling families to plan their expenses better at the beginning of the month.
Every purchase also earns reward points, and customers shopping for 1999 or more receive a Scratch Card with assured rewards ranging from 500 to 1,00,000 — creating real value and excitement for our customers.
Our vision is to grow as a trusted neighborhood supermarket brand that blends service, affordability, inclusivity, and innovation, while empowering communities, supporting women shoppers, and expanding responsibly across Odisha.
For You Mart is more than a supermarket — it is a promise to bring city-level quality, comfort, and respect to every neighborhood we serve.
